Bava Metzia 59a:3-11: Veamar mar zutera bar toviyya amar rav, veamri la: amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida, veamri lah: amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: noach lo leadam sheyyappil atzmo lechivshan haesh veal yalbin pene chavero barabbim. mena lan? mittamar, dichtiv: "hi mutzet vehi shalcha el chamiha".

Amar rav chinnana bereh derav idi: may dichtiv "velo tonu ish et amito"? am sheittecha betora uvammitzvot, al tonehu. amar rav: leolam yehe adam zahir beonaat ishto, shemmittoch sheddimatah metzuya, onaatah kerova.

Amar rabbi elazar: miyyom shennechrav bet hammikdash, ninalu shaare tefilla, shenneemar: "gam ki ezak vaashavvea satam tefillati". veaf al pi sheshshaare tefilla ninalu, shaare demaot lo ninalu, shenneemar: "shima tefillati Adonai veshavati haazina, el dimati al techerash".

Veamar rav: kol haholech baatzat ishto nofel begehinnam, shenneemar: "rak lo haya cheachav vegomer". amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: veha amri inashe, ittetach gutza – gechen vetilchosh lah! la kashya: ha bemille dealma, veha bemille deveta. lishshana acharina: ha bemille dishmayya, veha bemille dealma.

Amar rav chisda: kol hashshearim ninalim, chutz mishshaare onaa, shenneemar: "hinne Adonai nitztzav al chomat anach uveyado anach". amar rabbi elazar: hakkol nifra bide shaliach, chutz meonaa, shenneemar: "uveyado anach".

Amar rabbi avahu: shelosha en happargod ninal bifnehem: onaa, vegazel, vaavoda zara. onaa, dichtiv: "uveyado anach". gazel, dichtiv: "chamas vashod yishshama bah al panay tamid". avoda zara, dichtiv: "haam hammachisim oti al panay tamid vegomer".

Amar rav yehuda: leolam yehe adam zahir bitvua betoch beto, sheen meriva metzuya betoch beto shel adam ella al iske tevua, shenneemar: "hassam gevulech shalom chelev chittim yasbiech". amar rav pappa, hayeynu deamri inashe: kemishlam seare mikkadda, nakesh veate tigra beveta.

Veamar rav chinnana bar pappa: leolam yehe adam zahir bitvua betoch beto, shello nikreu yisrael dallim ella al iske tevua, shenneemar: "vehaya im zara yisrael vegomer", uchetiv: "vayyachanu alehem vegomer", uchetiv: "vayyiddal yisrael meod mippene midyan".

Veamar rabbi chelbo: leolam yehe adam zahir bichvod ishto, sheen beracha metzuya betoch beto shel adam ella bishvil ishto, shenneemar: "uleavram hetiv baavurah". vehayeynu daamar lehu rava livne machoza: okiru linshayychu, ki hechi detitatteru.
Berakhot 6b:29-37: Veamar rabbi chelbo, amar rav huna: kol hannehene misseudat chatan veeno mesammecho over bachamishsha kolot, shenneemar: "kol sason vekol simcha kol chatan vekol kalla kol omrim hodu et Adonai tzevaot".

Veim mesammecho ma secharo? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: zoche lattora shennittena bachamishsha kolot, shenneemar: "vayhi vayyom hashshelishi bihyot habboker vayhi kolot uverakim veanan kaved al hahar vekol shofar vegomer. vayhi kol hashshofar vegomer vehaelohim yaanennu vekol".
Inni? veha ketiv "vechol haam roim et hakkolot"!
Otan kolot, dekodem mattan tora havo.

Rabbi avahu amar: keillu hikriv toda, shenneemar: "meviim toda bet Adonai". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: keillu bana achat mechurevot yerushalayim, shenneemar "ki ashiv et shevut haaretz kevarishona amar Adonai".
Veamar rabbi chelbo, amar rav huna: kol adam sheyyesh bo yirat shamayim — devarav nishmain, shenneemar: "sof davar hakkol nishma et haelohim yera vegomer".
May "ki ze kol haadam"? amar rabbi elazar, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: kol haolam kullo lo nivra ella bishvil ze.
Rabbi abba bar kahana amar: shakul ze keneged kol haolam kullo, rabbi shimon ben azzay omer, veamri la rabbi shimon ben zoma omer: kol haolam kullo lo nivra ella litzvot laze.

Veamar rabbi chelbo, amar rav huna: kol sheyyodea bachavero shehu ragil litten lo shalom, yakdim lo shalom, shenneemar: "bakkesh shalom verodfehu". veim natan lo velo hechezir — nikra "gazlan", shenneemar: "veattem biartem hakkerem gezelat heani bevattechem".
Jeremiah 46:13-18: Haddavar asher dibber Adonai el-yirmeyahu hannavi lavo nevuchadretztzar melech bavel lehakkot et-eretz mitzrayim
Haggidu vemitzrayim vehashemiu vemigdol vehashemiu venof uvetachpanches imru hityatztzev vehachen lach ki-achla cherev sevivecha
Maddua nischaf abbirecha lo amad ki Adonai hadafo
Hirba koshel gam-nafal ish el-reehu vayyomru kuma ׀ venashuva el-ammenu veel-eretz moladtenu mippene cherev hayyona
Karu sham paro melech-mitzrayim shaon heevir hammoed
Chay-ani neum-hammelech Adonai tzevaot shemo ki ketavor beharim uchecharmel bayyam yavo
Jeremiah 46:19-22: Kele gola asi lach yoshevet bat-mitzrayim ki-nof leshamma tihye venitztzeta meen yoshev {s}
Egla yefe-fiyya mitzrayim keretz mitztzafon ba va

Kolah kannachash yelech ki-vechayil yelechu uvekardummot bau lah kechotve etzim
Jeremiah 46:23-27: Kartu yarah neum-Adonai ki lo yechaker ki rabbu mearbe veen lahem mispar
Amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael hinni foked el-amon minno veal-paro veal-mitzrayim veal-eloheha veal-melacheha veal-paro veal habbotchim bo
Unetattim beyad mevakshe nafsham uveyad nevuchadretztzar melech-bavel uveyad-avadav veachare-chen tishkon kime-kedem neum-Adonai {p}
Veatta al-tira avdi yaakov veal-techat yisrael ki hinni moshiacha merachok veet-zaracha meeretz shivyam veshav yaakov veshakat veshaanan veen macharid
Jeremiah 46:28-47:5: Atta al-tira avdi yaakov neum-Adonai ki ittecha ani ki eese chala bechol-haggoyim ׀ asher hiddachticha shamma veotcha lo-eese chala veyissarticha lammishpat venakke lo anakkekka {p}
Asher haya devar-Adonai el-yirmeyahu hannavi el-pelishtim beterem yakke faro et-azza
Ko ׀ amar Adonai hinne-mayim olim mitztzafon vehayu lenachal shotef veyishtefu eretz umeloah ir veyoshve vah vezaaku haadam vehelil kol yoshev haaretz
Mikkol shaatat parsot abbirav meraash lerichbo hamon galgillav lo-hifnu avot el-banim merifyon yadayim
Al-hayyom habba lishdod et-kol-pelishtim lehacherit letzor uletzidon kol sarid ozer ki-shoded Adonai et-pelishtim sheerit i chaftor

En od tehillat moav becheshbon chashvu aleha raa lechu venachritenna miggoy gam-madmen tiddommi acharayich telech charev
Kol tzeaka mechoronayim shod vashever gadol
Menachot 11a:5-17: Amar leh abbaye lerava: ketzad komtzin? amar leh: kidkamtzi inashe. etiveh: zo zeret, zo kemitza.
Zo amma, zo etzba, zo gudal.
Ella lehashevot, (kelomar, kometz melo hayyad kede shello yehe chaser, veachar kach mochek beetzba ketanna millematta).
Hechi aved? amar rav zutera bar toviyya, amar rav: chofe shelosh etzbeotav, ad shemmaggia al pas yado, vekometz.
Tanya name hachi: "melo kumtzo" – yachol mevoratz? talmud lomar "bekumtzo".
I bekumtzo, yachol berashe etzbeotav? talmud lomar: "melo kumtzo", ha ketzad? chofe shelosh etzbeotav al pas yado vekometz.
Bemachavat uvemarcheshet, mochek begudalo millemala uveetzbao ketanna millematta, vezo hi avoda kasha shebbammikdash.
Zehu vetu la? vehaikka melika, vehaikka chafina! ella zo hi achat meavodot kashot shebbammikdash.
Amar rav pappa: peshita li, "melo kumtzo" kidkamtzi inashe. bae rav pappa: kamatz berashe etzbeotav, may?
Min hatztzedadin, may? mimmatta lemala, may? teku.
Amar rav pappa: peshita li, "melo chofnav" kidchafni inashe. bae rav pappa: chafan berashe etzbeotav mahu? min hatztzedadin mahu? chafan bezo uvazo vekervan zo etzel zo mahu? teku.
Bae rav pappa: dabbekeh lekometz bedafneh demana, may? toch keli baenan, vehaikka, o dilma hannacha betocho baenan, velekka? teku.
Bae mar bar rav ashe: hafecheh lemana, vedabbekeh lekometz bearita demana, may? hannacha betocho baenan, vehaikka, o dilma ketikno bainan, velekka? teku.
Mishnah Kinnim 1:1-4: Chattat haof naaset lematta, vechattat behema lemala. olat haof naaset lemala, veolat habbehema lematta. im shinna baze uvaze, pasul. seder kinnim kach hu. hachova, echad chattat veechad ola. bindarim unedavot, kullan olot. ezehu neder, haomer hare alay ola. veezo hi nedava, haomer hare zo ola. ma ben nedarim lindavot. ella shehannedarim, metu o nignevu, chayyavim beacharayutam. unedavot, metu o nignevu, en chayyavim beacharayutan:

Chattat shennitarva veola veola vechattat, afillu echad beribbo, yamutu chullam. chattat shennitarva vechova, en kasher ella cheminyan chattaot shebbachova. vechen ola shennitarva vechova, en kasher ella cheminyan olot shebbachova, ben shehachova merubba vehannedava memuetet, ben shehannedava merubba vehachova memuetet, ben sheshshetehen shavot:

Bamme devarim amurim, bechova uvindava. aval bechova shennitarva zo vazo, achat lazo veachat lazo, shetayim lazo ushetayim lazo, shalosh lazo veshalosh lazo, mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. achat lazo ushetayim lazo, veshalosh lazo, veeser lazo, umea lazo, hammuat kasher, ben mishshem echad, ben mishshene shemot, ben meishsha achat, ben mishshete nashim:

Ketzad mishshem echad, leda veleda, ziva veziva, mishshem echad. mishshene shemot, leda veziva. ketzad shete nashim, al zo leda veal zo leda, al zo ziva veal zo ziva, mishshem echad. mishshene shemot, al zo leda veal zo ziva. rabbi yose omer, shete nashim shellakchu kinnehen beeruv, o shennatnu deme kinnehen lakkohen, leezo sheyyirtze chohen yakriv chattat, uleezo sheyyirtze chohen yakriv ola, ben mishshem echad, ben mishshene shemot:
Mishnah Kinnim 2:1-4: Ken setuma shepparach mimmenna gozal laavir, o shepparach ben hammetot, o shemmet achad mehen, yikkach zug lashsheni. parach leven hakkerevot, pasul ufosel echad kenegdo, shehaggozal happoreach, pasul ufosel echad kenegdo:

Ketzad. shete nashim, lazo shete kinnim velazo shete kinnim, parach mizzo lazo, posel echad bahalichato. chazar, posel echad bachazirato. parach vechazar, parach vechazar, lo hifsid kelum, sheafillu hen meoravot, en pachot mishshetayim:

Lazo achat, lazo shetayim, lazo shalosh, lazo arba, lazo chamesh, lazo shesh, lazo sheva. parach min harishona lashsheniyya, lashshelishit, larviit, lachamishit, lashshishshit, lashsheviit, chazar, posel echad bahalichato veechad bachazirato. harishona vehashsheniyya en lahem kelum, hashshelishit yesh lah achat, harviit yesh lah shetayim, hachamishit yesh lah shalosh, hashshishshit yesh lah arba, hashsheviit yesh lah shesh. parach vechazar, posel echad bahalichato veechad bachazirato. hashshelishit veharviit en lahem kelum, hachamishit yesh lah achat, hashshishshit yesh lah shetayim, hashsheviit yesh lah chamesh. parach vechazar, posel echad bahalichato veechad bachazirato, hachamishit vehashshishshit en lahem kelum, hashsheviit yesh lah arba. veyesh omrim, hashsheviit lo hifsida chelum. veim parach mibben hammetot lechullam, hare chullam yamutu:
Ken setuma veken meforeshet, parach min hassetuma lamforeshet, yikkach zug lashsheni. chazar, o shepparach min hameforeshet rishon, hare chullan yamutu:
Mishnah Middot 3:2-6: Uvekeren maaravit deromit hayu shene nekavim, kemin shene chotamin dakkin, shehaddamim hannittanin al yesod maaravi veal yesod deromi, yordin bahen umitarvin baamma, veyotzin lenachal kidron:

Lematta varitzfa beotah hakkeren, makom haya sham amma al amma, vetavla shel shayish, vetabbaat hayta kevua vah, shebbo yordin lashshit umenakkin oto. vechevesh haya lidromo shel mizbeach, sheloshim ushetayim al rochav shesh esre, urevuva hayta lo bemaaravo, sheshsham hayu notnim pesule chattat haof:

Echad avne hakkevesh veechad avne hammizbeach, mibbikat bet karem. vechofrin lematta mehabbetula, umeviim mishsham avanim shelemot, shello hunaf alehen barzel, shehabbarzel posel bingia. uvifgima lechol davar. nifgema achat mehen, hi fesula vechullan kesherot. umelabbenim otan paamayim bashshana, achat bappesach veachat bechag. vehahechol, paam achat, bappesach. rabbi omer, kol erev shabbat melabbenim oto vemappa mippene haddamim. lo hayu sadin otan bechafis shel barzel, shemma yigga veyifsol, shehabbarzel nivra lekatztzer yamav shel adam, vehammizbeach nivra lehaarich yamav shel adam, eno vadin sheyyunaf hamekatztzer al hammaarich:

Vetabbaot hayu litzfono shel mizbeach, shishsha sedarim shel arba arba, veyesh omrim, arbaa shel shesh shesh, shealehen shochatin et hakkodashim. bet hammitbachayim haya litzfono shel mizbeach, vealav shemona ammudim nannasin, ureviin shel erez al gabbehen, veunkelayot shel barzel hayu kevuin bahem, ushelosha sedarim hayu lechol echad veechad, shebbahem tolin. umafshitin al shulchanot shel shayish shebben haammudim:

Hakkiyyor haya ben haulam velammizbeach, umashuch kelappe haddarom. ben haulam velammizbeach, esrim ushetayim amma. ushetem esre maalot hayu sham, rum maala chatzi amma, veshilchah amma. amma amma veroved shalosh, veamma amma veroved shalosh. vehaelyona, amma amma veroved arba. rabbi yehuda omer, haelyona, amma amma veroved chamesh:
Mishnah Middot 3:7-4:2: Pitcho shel ulam, gavho arbaim amma, verachbo esrim amma. vechamesh malteraot shel milat hayu al gabbav. hattachtona odefet al happetach amma mizze veamma mizze. shellemala mimmenna odefet aleha amma mizze veamma mizze. nimtzet haelyona sheloshim amma. venidbach shel avanim haya ven kol achat veechat:

Uchelonasot shel erez hayu kevuin mikkatlo shel hechol lechatlo shel ulam, kede shello yivat. vesharsherot shel zahav hayu kevuot betikrat haulam, shebbahen pirche chehunna olin veroin et haatarot, shenneemar (zecharya 6), vehaatarot tihye lechelem uletoviyya velidaya ulechen ben tzefanya lezikkaron behechal Adonai. gefen shel zahav hayta omedet al pitcho shel hechol, umudla al gabbe chelonasot. kol mi shehu mitnaddev ale, o gargir, o eshkol, mevi vetole vah. amar rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok, maase haya, venimnu aleha shelosh meot kohanim:

Pitcho shel hechol, gavho esrim amma verachbo eser ammot. vearba delatot hayu lo, shetayim bifnim ushetayim bachutz, sheneemar (yechezkel ma), ushetayim delatot lahechol velakkodesh. hachitzonot niftachot letoch happetach lechassot avyo shel kotel, vehappenimiyyot niftachot letoch habbayit lechassot achar haddelatot, shekkol habbayit tuach bezahav, chutz meachar haddelatot. rabbi yehuda omer, betoch happetach hayu omdot, uchemin itzteramita hayu, venikpalot laachorehen, ellu shete ammot umechetza, veellu shete ammot umechetza, chatzi amma mezuza mikkan, vachatzi amma mezuza mikkan, shenneemar (sham), ushetayim delatot laddelatot shetayim musabbot delatot, shetayim ledelet echat ushete delatot laacheret:

Ushene fishpashin hayu lo lashshaar haggadol, echad batztzafon, veechad baddarom. shebbaddarom, lo nichnas bo adam meolam, vealav hu meforash al yede yechezkel, shenneemar (sham 44), vayyomer elay Adonai hashshaar hazze sagur yihye lo yippateach veish lo yavo vo ki Adonai elohe yisrael ba vo vehaya sagur. natal et hammafteach ufatach et happishpash, venichnas lehatta, umehatta lahechol. rabbi yehuda omer, betoch avyo shel kotel haya mehallech, ad shennimtza omed ben shene hashshearim, ufatach et hachitzonot mibbifnim veet happenimiyyot mibbachutz:
Mishnah Middot 4:3-6: Usheloshim ushemona taim hayu sham, chamishsha asar batztzafon, chamishsha asar baddarom, ushemona bammaarav. shebbatztzafon veshebbaddarom, chamishsha al gabbe chamishsha, vachamishsha al gabbehem. veshebbammaarav, shelosha al gabbe shelosha, ushenayim al gabbehem. ushelosha fetachim hayu lechol echad veechad, echad latta min hayyamin, veechad latta min hassemol, veechad latta sheal gabbav. uvekeren mizrachit tzefonit hayu chamishsha fetachim, echad latta min hayyamin, veechad latta sheal gabbav, veechad lammesibba, veechad lappishpash, veechad lahechol:

Hattachtona, chamesh, veroved shesh. vehaemtzait, shesh, veroved sheva. vehaelyona, sheva, shenneemar (Melachim 1 6), hayyatzia hattachtona chamesh baamma rachbah vehattichona shesh baamma rachbah vehashshelishit sheva baamma rachba:

Umesibba hayta ola mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit lekeren tzefonit maaravit, shebbah hayu olim legaggot hattaim. haya ole bammesibba ufanav lammaarav. halach al kol pene hatztzafon, ad shehu maggia lammaarav. higgia lammaarav, vehafach panav laddarom. halach kol pene maarav ad shehu maggia laddarom. higgia laddarom, vehafach panav lammizrach. haya mehallech baddarom, ad shehu maggia lefitchah shel aliyya, sheppitchah shel aliyya patuach laddarom. uvefitchah shel aliyya hayu shene chelonasot shel erez, shebbahen hayu olin legaggah shel aliyya. verashe fispasin mavdilim baaliyya ben hakkodesh leven kodesh hakkodashim. velulin hayu fetuchin baaliyya levet kodesh hakkodashim, shebbahen hayu meshalshelin et haummanim betevot, kede shello yazunu enehen mibbet kadshe hakkodashim:

Vehahechol mea al mea, al rum mea. haotem shesh ammot, vegavho arbaim amma, amma kiyyur, veammatayim bet dilfa, veamma tikra, veamma maaziva, vegova shel aliyya arbaim amma, veamma kiyyur, veammatayim bet dilfa, veamma tikra, veamma maaziva, veshalosh ammot maake, veamma kale orev, rabbi yehuda omer, lo haya chale orev ole min hammidda, ella arba ammot haya maake:
Mishnah Middot 4:7-5:4: Mehammizrach lammaarav mea amma, kotel haulam chamesh, vehaulam achad asar, kotel hahechol shesh, vetocho arbaim amma, amma teraksin, veesrim amma bet kodesh hakkodashim, kotel hahechol shesh, vehatta shesh, vechotel hatta chamesh. min hatztzafon laddarom shivim amma, kotel hammesibba chamesh, vehammesibba shalosh, kotel hatta chamesh, vehatta shesh, kotel hahechol shesh, vetocho esrim amma, kotel hahechol shesh, vehatta shesh, vechotel hatta chamesh, uvet horadat hammayim shalosh ammot, vehakkotel chamesh ammot. haulam odef alav chamesh esre amma min hatztzafon, vachamesh esre amma min haddarom, vehu haya nikra bet hachalifot, sheshsham gonzim et hassakkinim. vehahechol tzar meacharav, verachav millefanav, vedome laari, shenneemar (yeshaya 29), hoy ariel ariel kiryat chana david, ma haari tzar meacharav verachav millefanav, af hahechol tzar meacharav verachav millefanav:

Kol haazara hayta orech mea ushemonim vasheva al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh. min hammizrach lammaarav mea ushemonim vasheva, mekom derisat yisrael achat esre amma, mekom derisat hakkohanim achat esre amma, hammizbeach sheloshim ushetayim, ben haulam velammizbeach esrim ushetayim amma, hahechol mea amma, veachat esre amma laachore vet hakkapporet:

Min hatztzafon laddarom mea usheloshim vechamesh, hakkevesh vehammizbeach shishshim ushetayim. min hammizbeach lattabbaot shemone ammot, mekom hattabbaot esrim vearba, min hattabbaot lashshulchanot arba, min hashshulchanot velannannasin arba. min hannannasin lechotel haazara shemone ammot, vehammotar ben hakkevesh lakkotel umekom hannannasin:

Shesh leshachot hayu vaazara, shalosh batztzafon veshalosh baddarom. shebbatztzafon, lishkat hammelach, lishkat happarva, lishkat hamedichim. lishkat hammelach, sham hayu notnim melach lakkarban. lishkat happarva, sham hayu molchin orot kadashim, veal gaggah haya vet hattevila lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim. lishkat hamedichin, sheshsham hayu medichin kirve hakkodashim. umishsham mesibba ola legag bet happarva:

Shebbaddarom, lishkat haetz, lishkat haggola, lishkat haggazit. lishkat haetz, amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, shachachti me hayta meshammeshet. abba shaul omer, lishkat kohen gadol, vehi hayta achore shetehen, vegag shelashtan shave. lishkat haggola, sham haya vor kavua, vehaggalgal natun alav, umishsham maspikim mayim lechol haazara. lishkat haggazit, sham hayta sanhedri gedola shel yisrael yoshevet vedana et hakkehunna, vechohen shennimtza vo fesul, lovesh shechorim umitattef shechorim, veyotze veholech lo. veshello nimtza vo fesul, lovesh levanim umitattef levanim, nichnas umeshammesh im echav hakkohanim. veyom tov hayu osim, shello nimtza fesul bezaro shel aharon hakkohen, vechach hayu omrim, baruch hammakom baruch hu, shello nimtza fesul bezaro shel aharon. uvaruch hu, shebbachar beaharon uvevanav laamod lesharet lifne Adonai bevet kadshe hakkodashim:
Mishnah Sotah 6:2-7:1:
Amar ed echad, ani reitiha shennitmet, lo hayta shota. velo od ella afillu eved, afillu shifcha, hare ellu neemanin af lefaslah mikketubbatah. chamotah uvat chamotah vetzaratah vivimtah uvat balah, hare ellu neemanot, velo lefaslah mikketubbatah, ella shello tishte: 
Shehaya vedin, uma im edut rishona sheen osartah issur olam, enah mitkayyemet befachot mishshenayim, edut acharona sheosartah issur olam, eno din shello titkayyem befachot mishshenayim, talmud lomar veed en bah, kol edut sheyyesh bah. kal vachomer laedut harishona meatta, uma im edut acharona sheosartah issur olam, hare hi mitkayyemet beed echad, edut harishona sheen osartah issur olam, eno din shettitkayyem beed echad, talmud lomar (Devarim kad) ki matza vah ervat davar, ulehallan hu omer (sham 19), al pi shene edim yakum davar, ma lehallan al pi shenayim edim, af kan al pi shenayim edim: 
Ed omer nitmet veed omer lo nitmet, ishsha omeret nitmet veishsha omeret lo nitmet, hayta shota. echad omer nitmet ushenayim omrim lo nitmet, hayta shota. shenayim omrim nitmet veechad omer lo nitmet, lo hayta shota: 
Ellu neemarin bechol lashon, parashat sota, uvidduy maaser, keriat shema, utefilla, uvirkat hammazon, ushevuat haedut, ushevuat happikkadon:
Mishnah Sotah 7:2-6:
Veellu neemarin bilshon hakkodesh. mikra vikkurim, vachalitza, berachot ukelalot, birkat kohanim, uvirkat kohen gadol, ufarashat hammelech, ufarashat egla arufa, umeshuach milchama beshaa shemmedabber el haam: 
Mikra vikkurim ketzad, (Devarim 26) veanita veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha, ulehallan hu omer (sham 27) veanu haleviyyim veamru, ma aniyya haamura lehallan bilshon hakkodesh, af kan bilshon hakkodesh: 
Chalitza ketzad, (sham 25) veanta veamra, ulehallan hu omer veanu haleviyyim veamru, ma aniyya haamura lehallan bilshon hakkodesh, af kan bilshon hakkodesh. rabbi yehuda omer, veanta veamra kacha, ad shettomar ballashon hazze: 
Berachot ukelalot ketzad. kevan sheavru yisrael et hayyarden uvau el har gerizzim veel har eval shebbeshomron shebbetzad shechem shebbeetzel elone more, shenneemar (sham 11) halo hemma beever hayyarden vegomer, ulehallan hu omer (Bereshit 12) vayyaavor avram baaretz ad mekom shechem ad elon more, ma elon more haamur lehallan shechem, af elon more haamur kan shechem. shishsha shevatim alu lerosh har gerizzim veshishsha shevatim alu lerosh har eval, vehakkohanim vehaleviyyim vehaaron omdim lematta vaemtza, hakkohanim makkifin et haaron, vehaleviyyim et hakkohanim, vechol yisrael mikkan umikkan, shenneemar (yehoshua 8) vechol yisrael uzekenav veshotrav veshoftav omdim mizze umizze laaron vegomer. hafchu fenehem kelappe har gerizzim ufatchu vabberacha, baruch haish asher lo yaase fesel umassecha, veellu vaellu onin amen. hafchu fenehem kelappe har eval ufatchu vakkelala, (Devarim 27) arur haish asher yaase fesel umassecha, veellu vaellu onin amen, ad sheggomrin berachot ukelalot. veachar kach heviu et haavanim uvanu et hammizbeach vesaduhu vesid, vechatvu alav et kol divre hattora beshivim lashon, shenneemar (sham) baer hetev, venatlu et haavanim uvau velanu vimkoman: 
Birkat kohanim ketzad, bammedina omrim otah shalosh berachot, uvammikdash beracha echat. bammikdash omer et hashshem kichtavo, uvammedina vechinnuyo. bammedina kohanim nosim et yedehen keneged kitfehen, uvammikdash al gabbe rashehen, chutz mikkohen gadol sheeno magbiah et yadav lemala min hatztzitz. rabbi yehuda omer, af kohen gadol magbiah yadav lemala min hatztzitz, shenneemar (Vayikra 9) vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayvarchem:
Mishnah Sotah 7:7-8:2:
Birchot kohen gadol ketzad. chazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotnah lerosh hakkeneset, verosh hakkeneset notnah lassegan, vehassegan notnah lechohen gadol, vechohen gadol omed umekabbel vekore omed, vekore achare mot (sham 16), veach beasor (sham 23). vegolel et hattora umannichah becheko veomer, yoter mimma shekkariti lifnechem katuv kan. uveasor shebbechummash happikkudim (Bamidbar 29) kore al pe, umevarech aleha shemone verachot, al hattora, veal haavoda, veal hahodaya, veal mechilat heavon, veal hammikdash, veal yisrael, veal hakkohanim, veal shear hattefilla: 
Parashat hammelech ketzad. motzae yom tov harishon shel chag, bashshemini bemotzae sheviit, osin lo vima shel etz baazara, vehu yoshev aleha, shenneemar (Devarim lo) mikketz sheva shanim bemoed vegomer. chazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora venotnah lerosh hakkeneset, verosh hakkeneset notnah lassegan, vehassegan notnah lechohen gadol, vechohen gadol notnah lammelech, vehammelech omed umekabbel vekore yoshev. agrippas hammelech amad vekibbel vekara omed, veshibbechuhu chachamim. ucheshehiggia (sham 17) lelo tuchal latet alecha ish nachri, zalgu enav demaot. amru lo, al tityare agrippas, achinu atta, achinu atta, achinu atta. vekore mittechillat elle haddevarim (Devarim 1:1) ad shema, ushema (sham 6), vehaya im shamoa (sham 11), asser teasser (sham 14), ki techalle laser (sham 26), ufarashat hammelech (sham 17), uverachot ukelalot (sham 28), ad sheggomer kol happarasha. berachot shekkohen gadol mevarech otan, hammelech mevarech otan, ella shennoten shel regalim tachat mechilat heavon: 
Meshuach milchama, beshaa shemmedabber el haam, bilshon hakkodesh haya medabber, shenneemar (Devarim 20) vehaya kekaravchem el hammilchama veniggash hakkohen, ze kohen meshuach milchama, vedibber el haam, bilshon hakkodesh. veamar alehem (sham) shema yisrael attem kerevim hayyom lammilchama al oyvechem, velo al achechem, lo yehuda al shimon, velo shimon al binyamin, sheim tippelu veyadam yerachamu alechem, kema shenneemar (11 28) vayyakumu haanashim asher nikkevu veshemot vayyachaziku vashshivya vechol maarummehem hilbishu min hashshalal vayyalbishum vayyanillum vayyaachilum vayyashkum vaysuchum vaynahalum bachamorim lechol koshel vayvium yerecho ir hattemarim etzel achehem vayyashuvu shomron. al oyvechem attem holchim, sheim tippelu veyadam en merachamin alechem. al yerach levavchem al tiru veal tachpezu vegomer (Devarim 20). al yerach levavchem, mippene tzoholat susim vetzichtzuach charavot. al tiru, mippene hagafat terisin veshifat hakkalgassin. al tachpezu, mikkol keranot. al taartzu, mippene kol tzevachot. ki Adonai elohechem haholech immachem, hen bain benitzchono shel basar vadam, veattem baim benitzchono shel makom. pelishtim bau venitzchono shel galyat, me haya sofo, lesof nafal bacherev venaflu immo. bene ammon bau venitzchono shel shovach, me haya sofo, lesof nafal bacherev venaflu immo. veattem i attem ken. ki Adonai elohechem haholech immachem lehillachem lachem vegomer, ze machane haaron: 
Vedibberu hashshotrim el haam lemor mi haish asher bana vayit chadash velo chanacho yelech veyashov leveto vegomer (sham). echad habbone vet hatteven, bet habbakar, bet haetzim, bet haotzarot. echad habbone, veechad hallokeach, veechad hayyoresh, veechad shennittan lo mattana. umi haish asher nata kerem velo chillelo vegomer (sham). echad hannotea hakkerem veechad hannotea chamishsha ilane maachol, vaafillu mechameshet minin. echad hannotea, veechad hammavrich, veechad hammarkiv, veechad hallokeach, veechad hayyoresh, veechad shennittan lo mattana. umi haish asher eras ishsha vegomer (sham). echad hameares et habbetula, veechad hameares et haalmana, afillu shomeret yavam, vaafillu shama shemmet achiv bammilchama, chozer uva lo. kol ellu shomin divre chohen meerche milchama vechozrin, umesappekin mayim umazon umetakkenin et hadderachim:
Mishnah Sotah 8:3-6:
Veellu sheenan chozrin. habbone vet shaar, achsadra, mirpeset. hannotea arbaa ilane maachol, vachamishsha ilane serak. hammachazir et gerushato. almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin, lo haya chozer. rabbi yehuda omer, af habbone vayit al mechono, lo haya chozer. rabbi eliezer omer, af habbone vet levenim bashsharon, lo haya chozer: 
Veellu sheen zazin mimmekoman. bana vayit vachanacho, nata kerem vechillelo, hannose et arusato, hakkones et yevimto, shenneemar (Devarim kad), naki yihye leveto shana echat. leveto, ze beto. yihye, ze karmo. vesimmach et ishto, zo ishto. asher lakach, lehavi et yevimto. enan maspikin mayim umazon veenan metakkenin et hadderachim: 
(Sham 20) veyasfu hashshotrim ledabber el haam veamru mi haish hayyare verach hallevav yelech veyashov leveto. rabbi akiva omer, hayyare verach hallevav, kemashmao, sheeno yachol laamod bekishre hammilchama velirot cherev shelufa. rabbi yose haggelili omer, hayyare verach hallevav zehu hammityare min haaverot shebbeyado, lefichach talta lo hattora et kol ellu, sheyyachazor biglalan. rabbi yose omer, almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin, hare hu hayyare verach hallevav: 
(Sham) vehaya kechallot hashshotrim ledabber el haam ufakdu sare tzevaot berosh haam, uvaakevo shel am. maamidin zekifin lifnehem, vaacherim meachorehem, vechashshilin shel barzel bidehen, vechol hamevakkesh lachazor, harshut beyado lekappeach et shokav, shettechillat nisa nefila, shenneemar (Shmuel 1 4) nas yisrael lifne felishtim vegam maggefa gedola hayta vaam, ulehallan hu omer (sham lo) vayyanusu anshe yisrael mippene felishtim vayyippelu chalalim vegomer:
Mishnah Sotah 8:7-9:4:
Bamme devarim amurim, bemilchemet harshut. aval bemilchemet mitzva, hakkol yotzin, afillu chatan mechedro vechalla mechuppatah. amar rabbi yehuda, bamme devarim amurim, bemilchemet mitzva. aval bemilchemet chova, hakkol yotzin, afillu chatan mechedro vechalla mechuppatah: 
Egla arufa, bilshon hakkodesh, shenneemar (Devarim 21) ki yimmatze chalal baadama vegomer veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha, shelosha mibbet din haggadol shebbirushalayim hayu yotzin. rabbi yehuda omer chamishsha, shenneemar zekenecha, shenayim, veshoftecha, shenayim, veen bet din shakul, mosifin alehen od echad: 
Nimtza tamun begal, o taluy beilan, o tzaf al pene hammayim, lo hayu orfin, shenneemar (sham) baadama, velo tamun begal. nofel, velo taluy beilan. bassade, velo tzaf al pene hammayim. nimtza samuch lassefar, o leir sherubbah nachrim, o leir sheen bah bet din, lo hayu orfin. en moddin ella meir sheyyesh bah bet din. nimtza mechuvvan ben shete ayarot, shetehen meviot shete agalot, divre rabbi eliezer. veen yerushalayim mevia egla arufa: 
Nimtza rosho bemakom echad vegufo bemakom acher, molichin harosh etzel hagguf, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi akiva omer, hagguf etzel harosh: 
Meayin hayu moddin. rabbi eliezer omer, mittibburo. rabbi akiva omer, mechatmo. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, mimmekom shennaase chalal, mitztzavvaro:
Mishnah Sotah 9:5-8:
Nifteru zikne yerushalayim vehalchu lahen. zikne otah hair meviin eglat bakar asher lo ubbad bah asher lo mashcha beol (sham), veen hammum posel bah, umoridin otah lenachal etan. veetan kemashmao, kashe. af al pi sheeno etan, kasher. veorfin otah bekofitz meachoreha. umekomah asur millizroa umillaavod, umuttar lisrok sham pishtan ulenakker sham avanim: 
Zikne otah hair rochatzin et yedehen bammayim bimkom arifa shel egla, veomrim, (sham) yadenu lo shafchu et haddam hazze veenenu lo rau. vechi al datenu alta, shezzikne vet din shofche damim hen, ella shello va leyadenu ufetarnuhu velo mazon, velo reinuhu vehinnachnuhu velo levaya. vehakkohanim omrim, (sham) kapper leammecha yisrael asher padita Adonai veal titten dam naki bekerev ammecha yisrael. lo hayu tzerichim lomar (sham) venikkapper lahem haddam, ella ruach hakkodesh mevassartan, ematay shettaasu kacha, haddam mitkapper lahem: 
Nimtza hahoreg ad shello neerfa haegla, tetze vetire vaeder. mishshenneerfa haegla, tikkaver bimkomah, sheal safek bata mittechillatah, kippera sefekah vehalcha lah. neerfa haegla veachar kach nimtza hahoreg, hare ze yehareg: 
Ed echad omer raiti et hahoreg, veed echad omer lo raita, ishsha omeret raiti veishsha omeret lo rait, hayu orfin. ed echad omer raiti, ushenayim omrim lo raita, hayu orfin. shenayim omrim rainu veechad omer lahen lo reitem, lo hayu orfin:
Mishnah Terumot 3:2-5:
Nafla achat mehen letoch hachullin, enah medammatan. nafla sheniyya lemakom acher, enah medammatan. naflu shetehen lemakom echad, medammeot kakketanna shebbishtehen: 
Hashshuttafin shettarmu ze achar ze, rabbi akiva omer, terumat shenehem teruma. vachachamim omrim, terumat harishon teruma. rabbi yose omer, im taram harishon kashshiur, en terumat hashsheni teruma. veim lo taram harishon kashshiur, terumat hashsheni teruma: 
Bamme devarim amurim, beshello dibber, aval hirsha et ben beto o et avdo o et shifchato litrom, terumato teruma. bittel, im ad shello taram bittel, en terumato teruma. veim mishshettaram bittel, terumato teruma. happoalim, en lahen reshut litrom, chutz min haddarochot, shehen metammeim et haggat miyyad: 
Haomer, terumat hakkeri ze betocho, umaasrotav betocho, terumat maaser ze betocho, rabbi shimon omer, kara shem. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyomar bitzfono o vidromo. rabbi elazar chisma omer, haomer, terumat hakkeri mimmennu alav, kara shem. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, haomer, issur maaser ze asuy terumat maaser alav, kara shem:
Mishnah Terumot 3:6-9:
Hammakdim teruma labbikkurim, maaser rishon latteruma, umaaser sheni larishon, af al pi shehu over belo taase, ma sheasa asuy. shenneemar (Shemot 22), meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher: 
Uminnayin sheyyikdemu habbikkurim latteruma, ze karuy teruma vereshit, veze karuy teruma vereshit, ella yikdemu vikkurim, shehen bikkurim lakkol. uteruma larishon, shehi reshit. umaaser rishon lashsheni, sheyyesh bo reshit: 
Hammitkavven lomar teruma veamar maaser, maaser veamar teruma, ola veamar shelamim, shelamim veamar ola, sheeni nichnas levayit ze veamar laze, sheeni nehene laze veamar laze, lo amar kelum, ad sheyyihyu fiv velibbo shavin: 
Hannachri vehakkuti, terumatan teruma, umaasrotehen maaser, vehekdeshan hekdesh. rabbi yehuda omer, en lannachri kerem revai. vachachamim omrim, yesh lo. terumat hannachri medammaat, vechayyavin aleha chomesh. verabbi shimon poter:
Mishnah Terumot 4:1-5: Hammafrish miktzat teruma umaasrot, motzi mimmennu teruma alav, aval lo lemakom acher. rabbi meir omer, af motzi hu mimmakom acher teruma umaasrot:
Mi shehayu ferotav bammegura, venatan sea leven levi usea leani, mafrish ad shemone sein veochlan, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, eno mafrish ella lefi cheshbon:

Shiur teruma, ayin yafa, echad mearbaim. bet shammay omrim, mishsheloshim. vehabbenonit, mechamishshim. veharaa, mishshishshim. taram veala veyado echad mishshishshim, teruma, veeno tzarich litrom. chazar vehosif, chayyav bemaasrot. ala veyado mishshishshim veechad, teruma, veyachazor veyitrom kemot shehu lamud, bemidda uvemishkal uveminyan. rabbi yehuda omer, af shello min hammukkaf:

Haomer lishlucho, tze uterom, torem kedato shel baal habbayit. im eno yodea dato shel baal habbayit, torem kevenonit, echad mechamishshim. pichet asara o hosif asara, terumato teruma. im nitkavven lehosif afillu achat, en terumato teruma:

Hammarbe bitruma, rabbi eliezer omer, echad measara, kitrumat maaser, yater mikkan, yaasenna terumat maaser lemakom acher. rabbi yishmael omer, mechetza chullin umechetza teruma. rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva omrim, ad sheyyeshayyer sham chullin:
Mishnah Terumot 4:10-13: Uvezo rabbi eliezer mekel, verabbi yehoshua machmir. bedores litra ketziot al pi hakkad veeno yodea ezohi, rabbi eliezer omer, roin otan keillu hen perudot, vehattachtonot maalot et haelyonot. rabbi yehoshua omer, lo taale ad sheyyihyu sham mea chaddim:

Sea teruma shennafla al pi megura vekippeah, rabbi eliezer omer, im yesh bakkippuy mea sea, taale beechad umea, verabbi yehoshua omer, lo taale. sea teruma shennafla al pi megura, yakpienna. veim ken, lamma amru teruma ola beechad umea, im eno yadua im belulot hen, o leayin nafla:
Shete kuppot ushete megurot shennafla sea teruma letoch achat mehen, veen yadua leezo mehen nafla, maalot zo et zo. rabbi shimon omer, afillu hem bishte ayarot, maalot zo et zo:

Amar rabbi yose, maase va lifne rabbi akiva bachamishshim aguddot shel yarak, shennafla achat mehen letochan, chetzyah teruma, veamarti lefanav, taale. lo shehatteruma taale bachamishshim veechad, ella shehayu sham mea ushene chatzayim:
Mishnah Terumot 4:6-9: Bishlosha ferakim meshaarim et hakkalkala, babbakkurot, uvasseyafot, uveemtza hakkayitz. hammone, meshubbach. vehammoded, meshubbach mimmennu. vehashshokel, meshubbach mishshelashtan:
Rabbi eliezer omer, teruma, ola beechad umea. rabbi yehoshua omer, bemea vaod. vaod ze, en lo shiur. rabbi yose ben meshullam omer, vaod, kav lemea sea, shetut lammedammea:

Rabbi yehoshua omer, teenim shechorot maalot et hallevanot, levanot, maalot et hashshechorot. iggule devela, haggedolim maalim et hakketannim, vehakketannim maalin et haggedolim. haiggulim maalin et hammalbenim, vehammalbenim maalin et haiggulim. rabbi eliezer oser. verabbi akiva omer, beyadua ma nafla, en maalot zo et zo, uchesheeno yadua ma nafla, maalot zo et zo:

Ketzad, chamishshim teenim shechorot vachamishshim levanot, nafla shechora, shechorot asurot vehallevanot muttarot. nafla levana, levanot asurot ushechorot muttarot. besheeno yadua ma nafla, maalot zo et zo. bezo rabbi eliezer machmir, verabbi yehoshua mekel:
Mishnah Terumot 5:1-5: Sea teruma temea shenafla lefachot mimmea chullin, o lemaaser rishon, o lemaaser sheni, o lehekdesh, ben temein ben tehorim, yerakevu. im tehora hayta otah hassea, yimmachru lakkohanim bidme teruma, chutz middeme otah sea. veim lemaaser rishon nafla, yikra shem litrumat maaser. veim lemaaser sheni o lehekdesh nafla, hare ellu yippadu. veim temeim hayu otan hachullin, yeachlu nikkudim o kelayot, o yilloshu veme ferot, o yitchalleku leissot, kede shello yehe vemakom echad kabbetza:

Sea teruma temea shennafla letoch mea chullin tehorin, rabbi eliezer omer, terom vetissaref, sheani omer, sea shennafla hi sea shealta. vachachamim omrim, taale veteachel nikkudim o kelayot, o tillosh beme ferot, o titchallek leissot, kede shello yehe vemakom echad kabbetza:
Sea teruma tehora shennafla lemea chullin temein, taale veteachel nikkudim o kelayot, o tillosh beme ferot, o titchallek leissot, kede shello yehe vemakom echad kabbetza:

Sea teruma temea shennafla lemea sea teruma tehora, bet shammay osrim, uvet hillel mattirin. amru vet hillel levet shammay, hoil utehora asura lezarim utemea asura lechohanim, ma tehora ola, af temea taale. amru lahem bet shammay, lo, im heelu hachullin hakkallin hammuttarin lezarim et hattehora, taale teruma hachamura haasura lezarim et hattemea. leachar shehodu, rabbi eliezer omer, terom vetissaref. vachachamim omrim, avda vemiutah:
Sea teruma shennafla lemea, higbihah venafla lemakom acher, rabbi eliezer omer, medammaat kitruma vadday. vachachamim omrim, ena medammaat ella lefi cheshbon:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 21::
Kol habba al erva min haarayot derech evarim o shechibbek venishshek derech taava venehena bekeruv basar hare ze loke min hattora. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 30)</small> "levilti asot mechukkot hattoevot" vegomer. veneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 6)</small> "lo tikrevu legallot erva". kelomar lo tikrevu lidvarim hammeviin lide gilluy erva: 
Haose davar mechukkot ellu hare hu chashud al haarayot. veasur laadam likrotz beyadav uveraglav o lirmoz beenav leachat min haarayot o lischok immah o lehakel rosh. vaafillu lehariach besamim shealeha o lehabbit beyafyah asur. umakkin lammitkavven ledavar ze makkat mardut. vehammistakkel afillu beetzba ketanna shel ishsha venitkavven lehanot kemi shennistakkel bimkom hattoref. vaafillu lishmoa kol haerva o lirot searah asur:

Lo yehallechu benot yisrael perue rosh bashshuk. achat penuya veachat eshet ish. velo telech ishsha bashshuk uvenah achareha gezera shemma yitpesu benah vetelech acharav lehachaziro veyitallelu bah harshaim shettefasuhu derech sechok: 
Asur lehotzi shichvat zera levattala. lefichach lo yihye adam dash mibbifnim vezore mibbachutz. velo yissa ketanna sheenah reuya leled. aval ellu shemmenaafin bayyad umotziin shichvat zera lo day lahem sheissur gadol hu ella shehaose ze benidduy hu yoshev vaalehem neemar <small>(yeshaya 1 15)</small> "yedechem damim maleu" ucheillu harag hannefesh:

Vechen asur leadam sheyyakshe atzmo ledaat o yavi atzmo lide hirhur. ella im yavo lo hirhur yassia libbo middivre havay (vehashechata) ledivre tora. shehi <small>(Mishlei 5 19)</small> "ayyelet ahavim veyaalat chen". lefichach asur leadam lishon al arpo ufanav lemala ad sheyyitte meat kede shello yavo lide kishshuy: 
Velo yistakkel bivhema uvechayya veof beshaa shemmizdakkin zachar linkeva. vmuttar lemarbie behema lehachenis kemichchol bishfoferet mippene shehen asukin bimlachtan lo yavou lide hirhur:

Vechen asur leadam lehistakkel benashim beshaa shehen omdot al hakkevisa. afillu lehistakkel bevigde tzemer shel ishsha shehu makkirah asur. shello yavo lide hirhur: 
Mi sheppaga beishsha bashshuk asur lo lehallech achareha ella ratz umesallekah latztzedadin o leacharav. vechol hamehallech bashshuk achare ishsha hare ze mikkalle amme haaretz. veasur laavor al petach ishsha zona ad sheyyarchik arba ammot shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 5 8)</small> "veal tikrav el petach betah": 
Veasur leadam sheeno nasuy lishloach yado bimvushav shello yavo lide hirhur. vaafillu mittachat tibburo lo yachnis yado shemma yavo lide hirhur. veim hishtin mayim lo yeechoz baamma veyashtin. veim haya nasuy muttar. uven nasuy uven sheeno nasuy lo yoshit yado laamma kelal ella beshaa shehu tzarich linkavav:

Asur lehishtamesh beishsha kelal ben gedola ben ketanna ben shifcha ben meshuchreret shemma yavo lide hirhur. bee ze shimmush amru rechitzat panav yadav veraglav vehatztzaat mitta lefanav umezigat hakkos. sheen osa leish devarim ellu ella ishto bilvad. veen shoalin bishlom ishsha kelal vaafillu al yede shaliach: 
Hamechabbek achat min haarayot sheen libbo shel adam nokfo alehen o shennishshek leachat mehen kegon achoto haggedola vaachot immo vechayyotze bahen af al pi sheen sham taava velo hanaa kelal hare ze megunne beyoter vedavar asur hu umaase tippeshim hu. sheen kerevin leerva kelal ben gedola ben ketanna chutz mehaem livnah vehaav levitto:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 5:16-17:
Kelim haddomim ze laze veenan nikkarin ella beiyyun harebe asur lehakerivan leor hanner ulehavchin benehen shemma yishkach veyatte. lefichach shammash sheeno kavua asur lo livdok kosot ukearot leor hanner mippene sheeno makkiran. ben bener shel shemen zayit ben bener shel neft sheoro rav. aval shammash kavua muttar lo livdok leor hanner kosot ukearot mippene sheeno tzarich iyyun harebe. veim haya ner shel shemen zayit en morin lo livdok veaf al pi shehu muttar, gezera shemma yistappek mimmennu: 
Ner sheachore haddelet asur liftoach haddelet velinol kedarko mippene shehu mechabbehu ella yizzaher beshaa sheppoteach uveshaa shennoel. veasur liftoach et haddelet keneged hammedura beshabbat kede shettehe haruach menashshevet bah veaf al pi sheen sham ella ruach metzuya. umannichin hanner shel shabbat al gabbe ilan hamechubbar lakkarka veeno choshesh:
Niddah 16b:17-17a:3: Amar rabbi shimon ben yochay: arbaa devarim hakkadosh baruch hu sonan, vaani eni ohavan — hannichnas leveto pitom, veen tzarich lomar levet chavero, vehaochez baamma umashtin mayim,

Umashtin mayim arum lifne mittato, vehameshammesh mittato bifne kol chay. amar leh rav yehuda lishmuel: vaafillu lifne achbarim? amar leh: shinnana, la! ella kegon shel bet peloni shemmeshammeshin mittotehen bifne avdehem veshifchotehem.
Veinhu may derush? "shevu lachem po im hachamor" — am haddome lachamor.
Rabba bar rav huna mekarkesh zage dechilleta, abbaye bale didve, rava bale paroche.

Taava nihya teerav lenafesh vetoavat kesilim sur mera
(Haloch) [holech] et-chachamim (vechacham) [yechkam] veroe chesilim yeroa
Tov yanchil bene-vanim vetzafun latztzaddik chel chote
Rov-ochel nir rashim veyesh nispe belo mishpat
Proverbs 13:24-14:2: Chosech shivto sone veno veohavo shicharo musar
Tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho uveten reshaim techsar

Holech beyoshro yere Adonai uneloz derachav bozehu

Evilim yalitz asham uven yesharim ratzon

Shabbat 113a:12-113b:2: Gemara amri deve rabbi yannay: lo shanu ella beadam echad, aval bishne bene adam — lo. uveadam echad name la amaran ella bachadashim, aval bishanim — la. vochodashim name la amaran ella bilvanim, aval bitzvuim — la. vela amaran ella sheen lo lehachalif, aval yesh lo lehachalif — la.

Tana: shel bet rabban gamliel lo hayu mekappelim kele lavan shellahen, mippene shehaya lahen lehachalif. amar rav huna: im yesh lo lehachalif — yachalif, veim en lo lehachalif — yeshalshel bivgadav. matkif la rav safra: veha mitchaze keramut rucha. kevan dechol yoma la kaaved, vehaiddana hu deka aved — la mitchaze keramut rucha.

"Vechibbadto measot derachecha". "vechibbadto" — shello yehe malbushecha shel shabbat kemalbushecha shel chol, vechi ha derabbi yochanan kare lemaneh "mechabbedotay". "measot derachecha" — shello yehe hilluchecha shel shabbat kehilluchecha shel chol. "mimmetzo cheftzecha" — chafatzecha asurin, cheftze shamayim muttarin. "vedabber davar" —

Shello yehe dibburecha shel shabbat kedibburecha shel chol. dibbur asur, hirhur — muttar. bishlama kullehu — lechayye, ella shello yehe hilluchecha shel shabbat kehilluchecha shel chol may hi? ki ha deamar rav huna amar rav, veamri leh amar rabbi abba amar rav huna: haya mehallech beshabbat ufaga beammat hammayim, im yachol lehanniach et raglo rishona kodem shetteaker sheniyya — muttar, veim lav — asur.

Matkif la rava: hechi lebed? laykkef — kamappesh behillucha. libar — zimnin demittavvevsan maneh mayya, veate lide sechita. ella beha kevan dela efshar — shappir dame. ella kediva minneh rabbi merabbi yishmael berabbi yose: mahu lifsoa pesia gassa beshabbat? amar leh: vechi bachol mi huttera? sheani omer: pesia gassa notelet echad mechamesh meot mimmeor enav shel adam. umahdar leh bekiddusha deve shimshe.
Yevamot 121a:18-20: Tanya, amar rabban gamliel: paam achat hayiti mehallech bisfina, veraiti sefina achat shennishbera. vehayiti mitztaer al talmid chacham shebbah, umannu — rabbi akiva. ucheshealiti bayyabbasha, ba veyashav vedan lefanay bahalacha. amarti lo: beni, mi heelcha? amar li: daf shel sefina nizdammen li, vechol gal vegal shebba alay — ninati lo roshi.
Mikkan amru chachamim: im yavou reshaim al adam — yenanea lo rosho. amarti beotah shaa: kamma gedolim divre chachamim, sheamru: mayim sheyyesh lahem sof — mutteret, mayim sheen lahem sof — asura.

Tanya, amar rabbi akiva: paam achat hayiti mehallech bisfina, veraiti sefina achat shemmittarefet bayyam, vehayiti mitztaer al talmid chacham shebbah, umannu — rabbi meir. keshealiti limdinat kappotkeya, ba veyashav vedan lefanay bahalacha. amarti lo: beni, mi heelcha? amar li: gal teradani lachavero, vachavero lachavero, ad shehekiani layyabbasha. amarti beotah shaa: kamma gedolim divre chachamim, sheamru: mayim sheyyesh lahem sof — ishto mutteret, mayim sheen lahem sof — ishto asura.
Zohar, Beshalach 1: Vayhi beshallach paro et haam velo nacham elohim derech eretz pelishtim vegomer. ribbi shimon patach, (chavakkuk 3:1) tefilla lachavakkuk hannavi al shigyonot. hay kera kashya, veit leistakkela beh, may shena tefilla lachavakkuk hannavi, yattir mikkol shear nevie alma, dela ketiv behu tefilla lishaya hannavi, o leyirmiyya, o lichezkel, o lehoshea, o lishar nevie alma.

Ella hachi tanenan, elisha zacha behay alma ma dela zacha nevia ochora, bar mimmoshe. (veim kol da lo baa leatrecha lemareh) ta chazi, may ketiv, (Melachim b 4:8) vayhi hayyom vayyaavor elisha el shunem vesham ishsha gedola. may ishsha gedola. ella gedola beovadaha, dechol bene (sefer acher dara) beta, mishtabbechin bah, vehi ikara deveta, uvegin devaalah la hava shechiach beveta, lemeheve ikara, la hava idkar hu, ella hi.

Vetu, vesham ishsha gedola: gedola al kol shear neshe alma, deha shear neshe alma, kad chaman ushepiza beveta, mitztaaran beh, vedachakan beh kol shekken leappaka aleh mamona, vehi chadat beh beushepiza, uleappaka aleh mamona, kol shekken kevan dechamat leh leelisha chadat beh lachadda. veal da, shevacha decholla deitteta hi, deha ushepiza deveta deitteta hi. uvegin kach vesham ishsha gedola, gedola al shear nashin.
Vattomer el ishah hinne na yadati ki ish elohim kadosh hu, bemma yada. ella ha ukemuha chavrayya, deshushifa chivvavra zerikat leh bearseh. vela chamat beh keri meolam, vela abar zevuva befatoreh.

Hane mile kashyayn, i tema dela chamat beh keri, ha saggiin innun bene nasha hachi bealma, ma shinnuya hacha. vei tema dela avar zevuva befatoreh. amay ketiv, hinne na yadati, vechi hi yadat, vela ochora, veha kol innun dechamu leh achil befatoreh havo yade.

Ella shappir kaamrat, aval hinni na yadati, hi yada, vela ochora, begin dehi metaknat arseh, beshaata deshachiv belelya, uveshaata dekaim betzafra. vehay dekamre deshushifa chivvavra zerikat leh bearseh, hachi hava, uvah yada, dearcha dealma, kevan dekaim bar nash mearseh, salik shushifa denaim bah, recha menuvala. vehay, beshaata desalkat hahu shushifa mearseh, hava salik rechin, (127) kerechin deginta deeden. amra i lav dekaddisha hu, ukedusha demareh aleh, la salik recha kaddisha hachi.

Begine kach, bae leitparsha min beta, dela izdehar bar nash kol kach beveta. aval amrat, (Melachim b 4:10) naase na aliyyayt kir ketanna venasim lo sham mitta veshulchan vechisse umenora, arba illen lamma. ella begin deinnun tikkuna dichneset yisrael, deitkeriat aliyyayt kir, vehachi itkary, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 38:2) vayyassev chizkiyya panav el hakkir.

Mitta veshulchan vechisse umenora, lav innun ketikun deshimmusha, deha kisse ka bae bekadmita, ulevatar shulchan, levatar menora, levatar mitta, amay akdimat mitta. begin dehi chaviva aleh yattir mikkolla, veakdim bar nash ma dechaviv aleh.

(Melachim b 4:10-11) vayhi hayyom vayyavo shamma. vayhi hayyom, man hu yoma da. ella kema deukemuha. veta chaze. hahu yoma, yoma tava derosh hashshana hava, deitpekadu beh akarot dealma, veitpakkedan beh bene alma. kara lashshunammit veamar, (Melachim b 4:13) hinne charadt elenu et kol hacharada hazzot. begine kach, itzterichna leayyeyna yoma da bedini dealma, dekudesha berich hu dain beyoma da lealma, uvegin deitparashna bilchod baatar da, itzterichna leistakkela birgizu dealma.

(Melachim b 4:13) uma laasot lach hayesh ledabber lach el hammelech o el sar hatztzava. vechi milla da lema itztericha legabbe itteta, dela nafkat vela azlat vela alat behechla demalka. ella, yoma da hava garim, dechol bene alma yatvin (nusach acher kayymin) bedina, uvehahu yoma ikre kudesha berich hu melech. hammelech hammishpat. amar lah, i at itzterich lach legabbe malka illaa, al ovadin di bidach.

Vattomer betoch ammi anochi yoshavet. may kaamrat. ella beshaata (nusach acher bezimna) dedina talya bealma, la yitperash bar nash bilchodoy, vela yitreshim leella, vela yishtemodun beh bilchodoy, deha bezimna (achara) dedina talya bealma, innun deishtemodun ureshimin bilchodayyhu, af al gav dezakkain innun, innun ittafsan bekadmita. veal da, la livae leh leinish, leitparsha mibben amma lealam, divchol zimna rachame dekudesha berich hu al amma kullehu kechad. (velo livae leh leinish laataperash min amma lealam) uvegine kach amra, betoch ammi anochi yoshavet, vela beena leitparsha minnayyhu, kema deavedna ad yoma den.

Vayyomer gechazi aval ben en lah vegomer. amar lah elisha. ha vadday shaata kayyeyma, deha yoma garim. vayyomer lammoed hazze kaet chayya at choveket ben. vattahar haishsha vatteled ben lammoed hazze kaet chayya asher dibber eleha elisha. lammoed vadday. levatar mit. may taama mit. ella begin deityeyhiv lah, vela levalah. umeatar denukeba itkashshar, uman deitkashshar benukeba, mota izdammenat kameh. mena lan delah ityehiv, dichtiv at choveket ben.

Ta chaze, beavraham ketiv (Bereshit 18:10) shov ashuv elecha, velo eleha, elecha vadday, bach itkashshar, vela benukeva. man deate missitra denukeba, mota akdim leragloy. vattaal vattashkivehu al mittat ish haelohim, begin detamman chamat kedusha illaa mikkolla.
Vayyomer lah hashalom lach hashalom leishech hashalom layyaled. mikkan, dehi ikara deveta, velo od ella deihi azlat avatreh, velo balah. vayyiggash gechazi lehadfah ha ukemuha.

Vayyomer ish haelohim harepe lah. may shena hacha deamar ish haelohim, vechad hava bemata elisha. ella hacha vadday ish haelohim, dehacha (sefer acher hu) chaza ducheteh, vela bemata, vela beshaata dahavo beni nevie kameh.

VaAdonai helim mimmenni vegomer, kema deat amer (Bereshit 19:24) vaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora, da be dina diltatta. velo higgid li, may taama lo yada elisha. ella amar kudesha berich hu, uma ana katil lehay, i ema leh, lo yamut, deha nevizbeza dileh hu. vadday it leh lememat, deha ittemar, dichtiv at choveket ben, umeatar denukeba garim mota, uvegine kach la amar leh.

Vayyomer legechazi chagor matnecha vekach mishanti veyadcha valech. veha ukemuha veistelak nisa minneh. chay Adonai veche nafshecha im eezvekka, amay kevan degechazi hava azil. ella hi yadat archoy dehahu rasha degechazi, delav ihu keday deyishtechach nisa al yedoy.

Vayyasem piv al piv veenav al enav vegomer. amay, ella deashgach elisha veyada deatra (deitteta hu) da hu degarim, deitkeshar beh hasheta. vayyasem piv al piv veenav al enav, lekashshera leh beatra ochora illaa, atar dechayyin ishtechachu beh.

Vela yachil leakera leh meatar deitkashshar beh bekadmita, ella ittear rucha chada milleella, veitkeshar behay atar, veativ leh nafsheh. dei lav hachi la hava kaim lealmin. vayzorer hannaar ad sheva peamim, vela salik yattir, kema deat amer (Tehillim 90:10) yeme shenotenu bahem shivim shana.

Veda hu chavakkuk nevia, kema deat amer at choveket ben. i hachi chavuk mibbae leh, amay chavakkuk tere. ella, chad deimmeh, vechad deelisha, deitchabbak immeh. davar acher tere chibbukin havo beh, ben lehay sitra ben lehay sitra. chibbuka chada, hahu atar dehava tale beh bekadmita. chibbuka acharina desalik leh ledargin illain yattir, uvegin kach chavakkuk tere.

(Chavakkuk 3:1) tefilla lachavakkuk hannavi, may tefilla. ella da hu atar, dehava kashir beh bekadmita, veda hu tefilla shel yad. al shigyonot. dehahu yoma deitkeshar beh, shigyonot dealma havo talyayn kame kudesha berich hu, ugevura hava shalit, veal da itkeshar beh hay tefilla. (nusach acher behay tefilla)

Davar acher tefilla lachavakkuk hannavi, tefilla lachavakkuk: begin chavakkuk, deihu avid begineh. Adonai shamati shimacha yareti vegomer, ta chaze, kad hava ittear aleh rucha dinvua al atar da dehu tefilla, hava ate vahava dachil umizdazi. matla amri, man denashich mikkalba, mikkaleh izdaza.

Adonai paalcha bekerev shanim chayyehu, man paalcha. ella, aleh kaamar, deihu poal dileh. bekerev shanim chayyehu. hav leh chayyin lehay paalcha, bekerev shenin illain. davar acher, chayyehu dela yamut kad bekadmita.

Al shigyonot, may al shigyonot, al shegiot mibbae leh. kema deat amer (Tehillim 19:13) shegiot mi yavin. ella (kolla hu aval) shigyonot, kema deat amer (Tehillim 7:1) shiggayon ledavid. zini tushebchan havo kamayyhu dinvie, lemishre alayyhu ruach nevua, kema deat amer (Shmuel 1 10:Adonai) ufagata chevel neviim yordim mehabbama velifnehem nevel vetof vegomer, uchetiv (Melachim b 3:15) veatta kechu li menaggen vegomer. vechol shekken chavakkuk, deitzterich leh yattir mikkullehon, lenayycha derucha, ulevassema lehahu atar, leamshacha aleh ruach nevua. vechen kullehu nevie kehay gavvna, bar mimmoshe desalik al kol shear nevie dealma, zakkaa chulakeh.

Ta chaze, kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, ruchehon hava tavir begavvavyyhu, vahavu shamin innun tushebchan, vela yachlin lemechode, uveshaata dechullehu ochlosin uretichin nafku bishchinta, kullehu arimu tushebchan veshirin kame kudesha berich hu, veittear kudesha berich hu ruchehon deyisrael, vahavu shamin innun tushebchan, vekaim ruchehon begavavyyhu dela parchan.

Bar nash kad ihu shavik pulechana, keden yada teviru degarmoy, teviru derucheh. kach yisrael, kad nafku mimmitzrayim, keden taimu taama demota, vekudesha berich hu asse lon, dichtiv, (Shemot 13:21) vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam vegomer. vechol orchin, havo sallekin rechin deasvata, vealin legufayyhu veittasyayn, vekal tushebchan dahavo shamin, havo chaddan venayychin beruchehon.

Ufaro vechol innun uchelosin dileh, havo azle batrayyhu, leozfa lon, ad denafku meara demitzrayim. vechen kol innun ravrevin dimmanan alehon, veal shear ammin, ozifu lah lishchinta uleyisrael kullehu, ad desharu beetam biktze hammidbar, hada hu dichtiv, vayhi beshallach paro et haam vegomer. ki karov hu, ki karov hu. hahu omaa deome avimelech laavahan, al hahu tivu deavdu pelishtim laavahan, dichtiv (Bereshit 21:23) kachesed asher asiti immecha taase immadi veim haaretz asher garta bah.
Zohar, Bo 10: Amar ribbi shimon, matztzat ketiv, kema deat amer, (yechezkel 1:1) marot elohim. velamma itkere matztzat. dina. (223 2) dina kaddisha. dina deitachada bishma kaddisha. dina dela hava takkifa kol hahu zimna begavavyyhu deyisrael, deha kayyeyma sihara bifgimuta. veal dekayyeyma sihara bifgimuta, (Devarim 16:3) lechem oni ketiv.

May tama kayyeyma bifgimuta. begin dela itperau, vela itgalya hay at kaddisha. gezirin havo vela itperau, ematay itperau, beshaata dichtiv, (Shemot 15:25) sham sam lo chok umishpat vesham nissahu, veaf al gav deokimna hay kera bemilla achara, kolla hava veyeot.

Vei tema devime yehoshua itperau. lav hachi, ella innun dichtiv, (yehoshua Adonai:Adonai) vechol haam hayyillodim bammidbar badderech vegomer. batar deitperau, amar kudesha berich hu, bekadmita achaltun matztzot, dekayyeyma sihara bifgimuta, veikre lechem oni, mikkan ulehala hay lechem meatar achara leheve. may hu. dichtiv, (Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim. la min sihara kehahu zimna, ella min hashshamayim mammash, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 27:28) veyitten lecha haelohim mittal hashshamayim.

Veyisrael kaddishin, natrin innun yomin dealu techot gadfoy dishchinta, venatrin hahu nahama deatya missitraha, veal da ketiv, (Shemot 23:15) et chag hammatzot tishmor vegomer, uchetiv ushemartem et hammatztzot. mahu ushemartem et hammatztzot. kema deat amer, (Shemot 19:5) ushemartem et beriti. vecholla bechad darga salleka veitachad.

Vei tema moshe hech la para lehu. ella, begin dela yitakkevun yisrael taman ad deyitsiu, veal da ketiv, (Devarim 16:3) shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot lechem oni. may tama lechem oni, mishshum ki bechippazon yatzata vegomer uchetiv velo yachlu lehitmahmeah.

Ta chaze, kad alu yisrael leara, alu gezirin veitperau. uma ketiv, (Devarim 8:9) eretz asher lo vemiskenut tochal bah lechem. may vemiskenut. lechem oni. amay ikre lechem oni. mishshum dekayyeyma sihara bifgimuta, vela mitbarcha mishshimsha, vela mitnahara min shimsha, kema deat amer, (divre hayamim 1 29:11) ki chol bashamayim uvaaretz, vela itnahara (mikkol) miyyovla. may taama. mishshum dela itperau. aval hacha, deitgezaru yisrael veitperau, lo techsar kol bah ketiv, veal da lo vemiskenut tochal bah lechem. may taama. mishshum dela techsar kol bah, kema dechasru leh bemitzrayim.

Uvechol shatta veshatta ducherana demitzrayim ka avde yisrael, veachle vela ishtetze middare darin. uvegin dela itperau hacha bemitzrayim, chasru leh lehay kol, vekayyeyma sihara bifgimuta, veikre lechem oni, oni: ketargumo miskenut. umay deachlu leh tamman beara, begin ducherana demitzrayim hava, vehay ledare darin, ulezimna deate ketiv, (Yeshayahu 60:20) lo yavo od shimshech virechech vegomer.

Tanna amar ribbi shimon ketiv beasor lachodesh hazze veyikchu lahem vegomer, uchetiv (Vayikra 23:27) ach beasor lachodesh hashshevii hazze yom hakkippurim hu, ishtema kema deittemar, dichtiv beasor lachodesh hazze. may ka mayyre. ella beasor, milla da beasor talya. lachodesh hazze bachodesh hazze mibbae leh. ella, kad ata nimusa lehay darga, ketiv lachodesh hazze dayka.

(Shemot 12:3) veyikchu lahem ish se levet avot se labbayit. tana telat kishrin innun, bechor behema, bechor hashshevi, bechor hashshifcha. (ditlat kishrin) dechol shear mitkashshere behu beillen telat gavvne dilella. uvehay deitkere tzon, itkashshar kolla, vecholla kalil batztzon, itkashshar tzon batztzon, vela yachil leitparsha mikkitroy, uvehay kullehu itkashsharu, veal da ketiv, vehaya lachem lemishmeret, ketiru leh biktiruta, viyhe itmesar bidechon birshutechon, ad detanchesu leh, vetabedun beh dina, ulezimna deate ketiv (yeshaya 63) mi ze ba meedom. uchetiv, (yeshaya la) ki zevach laAdonai bevatzra. uchetiv, (zecharya 14:9) vehaya Adonai lemelech al kol haaretz bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad.
Zohar, Bo 12: (Shemot 12:43) vayyomer Adonai el moshe veaharon zot chukkat happasach vegomer. 28 pikkuda da, lemishchat pesach ben haarbayim, beyd benisan, ducherana dehahu pesach demitzrayim. veda ihu chovata al kolla, kema deat amer, veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael ben haarbayim.

Pesach da, itzterich lemehve natir, measara yomin ulehala, dichtiv beasor lachodesh hazze veyikchu lahem vegomer. may taama. begin deha keden shariat sihara leanhara, measara yomin ulehala, ad deishtelim bachamesar. vearbesar delehevi nachis, beshaata dedina talya al alma.

Raza da, leabera zuhama, mikkame berit kaddisha, uleithanaa behahu recha denadif tevi nur. veal da la atya ella al sava. veal da, vechol arel lo yochal bo. man deit beh berit kaddisha, yechul beh. man dela it beh berit kaddisha, la yechul beh. dehay mibbene berit ihu letavra tukepa dechela achara, leabera arla mikkame berit. begin kach, hay bivne berit ihu lemebad, vela bivne arla.

Kad ata kudesha berich hu lemitzrayim, chama dama dehahu pesach, dehava rashim al pitcha, vedama divrit, hech havo kayymin al pitcha, dichtiv, ulekachtem aguddat ezov utevaltem baddam asher bassaf vehiggatem vegomer. ezova, ha okimna deihu mabar ruchin (22 amud bet) bishin, vechol setar ruach bisha, mabar beitaruta dileh, befurekana illaa deyisrael.
Lezimna deate, yete kudesha berich hu leyetzer hara veyikkos leh. vehasheta befurekana da, ketiv veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael vegomer. ducherana dezimna deate, behahu purekana illaa.

Al shete hammezuzot veal hammashkof behay reshimu deat yod, uvehay reshimu deat yod, leachazaa reshimu divrit kaddisha, veittebar arla mikkame dama divrit, rashim al kolla, veata dama al dama. kad avar hahu mashchit, hava chame dama, veizdekif mibbeta, kema deat amer velo yitten hammashchit vegomer.

I kudesha berich hu bilchodoy katil, amay ketiv velo yitten hammashchit, demashma demashchit hava azil vela kudesha berich hu. ella vadday kudesha berich hu hava katil, umashchit hava azil leashkecha ila leyisrael, kevan dehava chame hahu teviru dearla, bitren sitrin, hava arak veitperash minnayyhu.

Veal dekatal kudesha berich hu kol innun bucherin dehahu sitra, yahiv bucherin deyisrael lefurekana, dela yishkach alayyhu sitra achara ila kelal, uvecholla natir lon leyisrael kudesha berich hu, keabba al benin.

(Shemot 12:46) bevayit echad yeachel lo totzi min habbayit vegomer, (ayyen lekamman sof parashat pinchas) pikkuda 29 da, lemechal hay pesach. al matztzot umerorin, matztzot matztzat ketiv. may hay lokovel hay, ella leachazaa galuta dishchinta immehon deyisrael, behahu meriru dilhon, dichtiv vaymararu et chayyehem baavoda kasha vegomer. vechad achlin lehay pesach, leachazaa kol hay deavdu lon bemitzrayim, behahu galuta uvehahu shibuda.

Ma ketiv veetzem lo tishberu vo, leachazaa beh kelana, uvechol innun taavavn demitzrae. deha garmin havo raman beshuka, veatu kalbe vahavu garre lon meatar laatar, veda kashya lon mikkolla, deha garme innun tikkuna degufa, vedami legavvna achara, veyisrael raman lon beshuka orach kelana, veal da ketiv veetzem lo tishberu vo, attun la tishberun, aval kalbe havo atyayn umetabberin leh.

Tu, mitzrae havo atyayn levatar, vahavu chaman innun garme dahavo natle kalbe meatar laatar, umadkan lon, vahavu mitzrae tamni lon go afra, begin kalbe dela yishkechun lon, veda ihu bittula deavodat kochavim umazzalot, yattir, missitra dilhon. uveda kudesha berich hu istelak bikareh, veitkafyayn kol chelin acharanin, deha keden itkafyayn yattir, kad batilu ishtechach missitra dilhon, veal da yisrael la mevattele lon, dichtiv veetzem lo tishberu vo.
Zohar, Bo 17: (Shemot 13:16) vehaya leot al yadcha uletotafot ben enecha vegomer (behar 108 amud bet uvammishna) (8) pikkuda da, pikkuda deikre begavvna achara, dela ikre mitzva, ella kedusha, veillen innun tefilin. tefilla shel yad, utefilla shel rosh. tikkuna peera shappiru digvavnin illain. veal da ikrun totafot, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar.

Uchetiv (Hoshea 11:1) ki naar yisrael vaohavehu, yisrael zuta. shema yisrael, yisrael sava, shappiru digvavnin, ella vetatta. yosef salik veitattar bitren gavvnin (nusach acher dargin) bekadmita naar, uvesofa tzaddik. kamma yaan beh gavvnin lemechoze, veraza da (Bereshit 39:6) vayhi yosef yefe toar vife mare. shappira bitren sitrin, bitren dargin, bitren gavvnin, ella vetatta.

Ketiv (Devarim 6:18) veasita hayyashar vehattov. hayyashar: da tefilla shel yad, leamshacha (sefer acher laasamekaa) leh bitfilin shel rosh, leityachada kachada. utefilla shel yad, akdim leshel rosh. veitzterich dela have piruda benayyhu kelal.

Man demitatra bitfilin, kaim beraza degavvna illaa vekaim beinnun teren razin dekamran keyosef, deikre naar, veikre tzaddik, beraza deeved neeman, beraza deven yechiday. veillen innun tefilla shel yad, utefilla shel rosh, veinnun kelala chada bela piruda.

Arba parshiyayn ditfilin bed battim, beinnun tefilin shel rosh. uchema deinnun 4 parshiyayn beinnun tefilin shel rosh, uf hachi kullehu bitfilin shel yad bevayit 1. deha battefila shel yad, let lah miggarmah kelum, ella ma denakta milleella. veraza da, (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam. umiggo denakta lon milleella, ikre tefilla, veitkaddeshat bikdushathon (vecholla) ikre kedusha. veikre tefilla ucheden ikre malchut, malchut shamayim shelema.
4 Parshiyayn, ha okimna raza dilhon, bechamma duchete. aval parasha kadmaa, kaddesh li chol bechor, da ihu raza illaa, dechalil kol 4 battim, beraza dinhiru illaa, denafka meayin.

Vechol innun 4 itremizu hacha, kaddesh: da kedusha illaa. raza dechachmeta illaa, demittamman kolla itkaddash, beraza deganizu illaa, deitkere kaddesh. li: da bina, raza dealma illaa, hechla penimaa. (veraza da (Vayikra 25) ki li bene yisrael avadim (Bamidbar 3) ki li kol bechor (Shemot 19:5) vihyitem li segulla) chol: raza dechesed, bechol ducheta, ben leella ben letatta. bechor: da ben bechor, dichtiv, (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael, vehay ben bechor, kalil kol sitrin, vechol gavvnin. uvegin kach, kera kalil kullehu arba, beraza dechachmeta illaa. aval da beorach kelal, leminda decholla kalil behay, aval beorach perat, kol chad bilchodoy, da ihu parsheta kadmaa, dechalil kol shear parshiyayn.

Parasha tinyayna, vehaya ki yeviacha vegomer, da bina, deha befarsheta da, ihi yetziat mitzrayim, dehava missitra deyovla. veal da sheruta dilah vehaya, deha milla da ihi beyovla. uvegin kach shema dilah vehaya, delet vehaya (nusach acher havaya) ella baatar da, deihu zammin leitmashshecha letatta, uleanhara butzinin, uleishtakkecha bedarga tattaa, (nusach acher vehaya keman deamar al malka deihi have) (nusach acher deyeheve zammin leitmashshecha letatta uleanhara butzinin) vecholla beraza chada. uvegin deihu beorach tamir, la ikre beitgalleyay bishma da, ella itmesar lechakkimin leminda. veal da itreshim bishma kaddisha, bemilla da.

Parasha telitaa, shema, da ihu raza dimina, deikre chesed illaa. deihu ka meyayched yichuda decholla led sitrin, vekudesha berich hu mesadder beh, siddura dechol alma, veda ihu deka mitpashshat bechol sitrin, afillu go tehome tattae. beda kudesha berich hu bara alma, kad itattaf kudesha berich hu beittufa dezihara, veda deka meyayched yichuda, uvegin kach, shema samich livhaya.

Yichuda dechol yoma, ihu, yichuda leminda uleshavvaa reuta. yichuda da ha amaran bechamma duchete, yichuda dechol yoma, ihu yichuda dikra, (Devarim 6:4) shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai ha kullehu chad, veal da ikre echad. ha telat shemahan innun, hech innun chad, veaf al gav dekarenan echad, hech innun chad.

Ella, bechezyona deruach kudsha ityeyda, veinnun bechezu deena setima, leminda ditlata illen echad. veda ihu raza dekol deishtema, kol ihu chad, veihu telata gavvnin, eshsha verucha umayya, vechullehu chad, beraza dekol. (velav inun ella chad) uf hacha: Adonai elohenu Adonai innun chad. telata gavvnin, veinnun chad.

Veda ihu kol deavid bar nash beyichuda, uleshavvava reuteh beyichuda decholla, meen sof ad sofa decholla, behay kol deka avid behane telata deinnun chad. veda ihu yichuda dechol yoma, deitgele beraza deruach kudesha.

Vechamma gavvnin deyichuda itaru, vechullehu keshot. man deavid hay avid. uman deavid hay avid. aval hay yichuda deka anan mitare mittatta, beraza dekol deihu chad, da hu berira demilla, hay bichlala, levatar perat, kidkaamran.
Parasha reviaa, hu raza dedina kashya, (Devarim 11:16) hishshamru lachem. illen innun tefilin deresha. utefillin didroa, kegavvna da bechad beta, veha ittearna behu, vechullehu raza chada.
Kishra ditfilin derisha, ihu dalet, veal da ketiv, (Shemot 33:23) veraita et achoray. veal da ihu laachora, vetamman itkashshar kolla bekishra chada.

Veihi, kad manchat illen tefilin didroa leitkashshera, (sefer acher it kishra) achara, raza divrit kaddisha, raza da, kema deittear bechamma duchete, vecholla raza chada. zakkain innun yisrael deyadin raza da, veitzterich bar nash laanacha lon kol yoma, lemeheve bediyyukena illaa, vealeh ketiv, (Devarim 28:10) verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha veyyaru mimmekka. (ad kan raya mehemana) 50.
Zohar, Bo 2: Ribbi elazar patach, (iyyov 1:6) vayhi hayyom vayyavou bene haelohim lehityatztzev al Adonai vayyavo gam hassatan betocham. vayhi hayyom: da (44 1) rosh hashshana, dekudesha berich hu kaim lemedan alma. kegavvna da, (Melachim b 4:11) vayhi hayyom vayyavo shamma. hahu yoma yom tov derosh hashshana hava.

Vayyavou bene haelohim, illen ravrevin memanan shelichan bealma, leashgecha beovadin divni nasha. lehityatztzev al Adonai: kema deat amer, (Melachim 1 22:19) vechol tzeva hashshamayim omdim alav mimino umissemolo. aval lehityatztzev al Adonai behay kera ashkachna rechimuta dekudesha berich hu alayyhu deyisrael. begin, dehane shelichan, deinnun memanan leashgacha al ovadin divne nasha, azlin veshatin venatlin innun ovadin kullehu, uveyoma dekae dina lemekam, lemedan alma, itavidu kategorin lemekam alayyhu divne nasha. veta chaze, mikkol ammin dealma, la kayymin leashgacha beovadehon, bar beyisrael bilchodayyhu, begin deillen benin lekudesha berich hu.

Vechad la ishtechachu ovadin deyisrael kedka yeot, kivyachol innun memanan shelichan, kad baan lekayyeyma al innun ovadin deyisrael, al Adonai vadday kayymin, deha kad yisrael avdin ovadin dela kashran, kivyachol mattishin chela dekudesha berich hu. vechad avdin ovadin dechashran, yahavin tukepa vechela lekudesha berich hu. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 68:35) tenu oz lelohim. bema. beovadin dechashran. veal da, behahu yoma, kullehu ravrevan memanan itkanashu al Adonai. al Adonai vadday, deha kevan deal yisrael itkanashu, aleh itkanashu.

Vayyavo gam hassatan betocham, gam, leasgaa alayyhu, dechullehu atyayn lemeheve kategorin alayyhu deyisrael, veda ittosaf alayyhu, begin deihu dayltora ravreva mikkullehu, kategora mikkullehu, kevan dechama kudesha berich hu, dechullehu atyayn lekatrega. miyyad vayyomer Adonai el hassatan meayin tavo. vechi lo hava yada kudesha berich hu, mean hava ate. ella leayytaa ovada liruteh.

Vayyomer Adonai el hassatan vegomer vayyaan hassatan et Adonai vayyomar mishshut baaretz. mikkan olifna, deyishshuva deara itmesar lesitrin acharanin, bar ara deyisrael bilchodaha. kevan deamar mishshut baaretz, ashgach kudesha berich hu, devae lemeheve daltora alayyhu deyisrael. miyyad, (iyyov 1:8) vayyomer Adonai el hassatan hasamta libbecha al avdi iyyov ki en kamohu baaretz.

Chama shaata lemehav leh chulaka, bema (58 64 amud alef) deyitasak, veyitperash minnayyhu deyisrael, veha ukemuha, leraya devaa lemebar aneh bechad nahara vechulei, miyyad itassak beh hahu satan, velo kitreg alayyhu deyisrael.
Vayyaan hassatan et Adonai vayyomar hachinnam yare iyyov elohim. lav tavavha leavda demareh avid leh kol reuteh, dihe dachil leh, ade ashgachutach mineh, vetechome i dachil lach veim lav.

Ta chaze, beshaata deaku, kad ityeyhiv chulaka chada lehay setar leitasseka beh, itperish levatar mikkolla. kegavvna da sair berosh chodesh. sair beyoma dechippure. begin deitassak beh, veshavik lehu leyisrael bemalchehon, vehacha, mata zimna lemetal chulaka da, mikkol zara deavraham, besitra achara. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 22:20) hinne yalda milka gam hi vegomer et utz bechoro vegomer.

Veta chaze, beshaata deamar mishshut baaretz, baa minneh, lemebad dina beyisrael, deha dina hava leh al avraham, lemitba mekkudesha berich hu. begin, dela itavid dina beyitzchak, kad itkeriv al gabbe madbecha, deha la hava leh leachlefa karbena deazmin al madbecha, boochara, (vechen bechol sitra dilleh) kema deat amar, (Vayikra 27) lo yachalifennu. vehacha kaim yitzchak al gabbe madbecha, vela ishtelim minneh karbena, vela itavid beh dina, uvaa da meim kudesha berich hu, kema devaa dinih deyosef lechamma darin. vechol ma devaa, beorach dina baa.

Umehahu zimna deishteziv yitzchak, veitchallaf karbaneh, zammin leh kudesha berich hu, lehahu mekatrega, hay lechulakeh, kema deat amer hinne yalda milka gam hi vegomer et utz bechoro. vehacha, mata lemetal chulakeh aleh, mikkol zareh deavraham, vela yikrav besitra achara.

Vecholla bedina ata. (sefer acher legabbeh) kema deihu dan, hachi ittedan. begin deiyyov mikkerive eta defaro hava, vechad kam paro alayyhu deyisrael, baa lekatla lon. amar leh la, ella tol mamonehon ushelot al gufehon, befulechana kashya, vela tiktol lon. amar leh kudesha berich hu, chayyecha, behahu dina mammash, tehe dain, ma ketiv, (iyyov 2:Adonai) ulam shelach na yadcha vega el atzmo veel besaro vegomer. bema deihu dan, hachi ittedan. veaf al gav divchol shear hava dachil lekudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, ach et nafsho shemor. veityehiv leh reshu, lemishlat al bisra, begin raza dichtiv, (Bereshit 6:13) ketz kol basar ba lefanay veukemuha, ba lefanay vadday, veda ihu (338 109 amud alef) ketz kol basar, velo rucha. veittemar, deihu ketz deate missitra dechoshech, kema deat amer, (iyyov 28:3) ketz sam lachoshech ulechol tachlit hu choker. ulechol bisra, begin deit ketz achara, veikre (Daniel 12) ketz hayyamin, veda ihu ketz achara, missitra dismala, deihu choshech. veal da ityeyhiv leh reshu beatzmo uvesaro.

Vattesiteni vo levalleo. i hachi, lav bedina hava, ella bememar hahu mekatrega, deasit leh, veaste leh. ella, kolla bedina hava, vehachi amar lo elihu, (iyyov 34:11) ki foal adam yeshallem lo ucheorach ish yamtziennu. vehachi hava kema deittemar, kema deihu gazar, hachi itgezar aleh.

Vehay deamar vattesiteni vo levalleo chinnam, vattesiteni levalleo la ketiv, ella vattesiteni vo, beh kayyeyma bedateh, deihu chashiv deha tesiteni, kema deamar (iyyov 10:3) veal atzat reshaim hofata. (amar iyyov itpattit al memar dehahu mekatrega) kegavvna da, (tehillim 75) vayfattuhu befihem uvilshonam yechazzevu lo. vayfattuhu vaychazzevu lo. la ketiv, ella vayfattuhu befihem. befihem kayyeyma milla da deha itpatta.

Amar ribbi abba, kolla hu shappir, aval hachi olifna, ditnan, salik veastin. vechi ihu yachil leastana, in. deha ihu (resh vayyeshev tikun 141) melech zaken uchesil, dichtiv, (Kohelet 4:13) tov yeled misken vechacham mimmelech zaken uchesil. veal da, yachil leastana levar nash. may taama. begin deihu meheman al ovadoy divne nasha.

Ta chaze, hay bedina deyachid, aval bedina dealma, ketiv, (Bereshit 11) vayyered Adonai lirot. (Bereshit 18:21) erada na vaere. dela ityeyhiv mehemanuta ella bideh bilchodoy, deha la baa leovada alma, al memar dehahu mekatrega, detiuveteh ihu tadir leshetzaa. menalan dichtiv, (iyyov 28:3) ketz sam lachoshech ulechol tachlit hu choker. leshetzaa kolla, hu choker. veda ihu ketz kol basar ba lefanay, vadday begin leshetzaa.

Veta chaze, vayhi hayyom vayyavou bene haelohim lehityatztzev al Adonai. kema deittemar. vehahu yoma, kayymin teren sitrin, lekabbela beni alma. kol innun deatyayn kame kudesha berich hu bityuveta uveovadin tavin, innun zachyan lemeheve ketivin legabbeh dehahu sitra deihu chayyim, veappik totzot chayyim. uman deihu missitreh, achtiv lechayyim. vechol innun deatyayn beovadin bishin, innun ketivin lehahu sitra achara deihu mota, veikre (265 1) mavt, uveh sharya mota.

Uvehahu yoma, kayymin illen teren sitrin: chayyim, umavet. it man deachtiv lesitra dechayyim. veit man deachtiv lesitra demavet. ulezimnin dealma sharya beemtzaita, i kayyeyma chad zakkaa bealma, deachra alayyhu, kullehu kayymin veachtivu lechayyim. vei chad chayyayva achra alma, kullehu achtivu lemita.

Vehahu zimna, alma hava kayyaym beemtzaita, vehahu mekatrega baa leastaa. miyyad ma ketiv, hasamta libbecha al avdi iyyov ki en kamohu baaretz vegomer. kevan deishtemoda ihu bilchodoy, miyyad atkif beh mekatrega. veal da tanenan, dela itzterich leh levar nash leitparsha mikkelala desaggiin, begin dela yitreshim ihu bilchodoy, vela yekatregun aleh leella.

Dichtiv, bashshunammit, (Melachim b 4:13) vattomer betoch ammi anochi yoshavet. la beena leappaka garmay mikkelala desaggiin, betoch ammi yativna, ad yoma da, uvetoch ammi, bichlala chada ishtemoda leella. vehacha iyyov, kevan deishtemoda leella veitreshim, miyyad atkif beh mekatrega, veamar hachinnam yare iyyov elohim, kol ma dedachil lach veittakaf, lav lemaggana avid, halo atta sachta vaado uvead vegomer. aval tol kol hay tava deant aved leh, umiyyad im lo al panycha yevarchekka. yishbok lach, veyitdabbak besitra achara, deha hasheta befatorach ihu achil, salik patorach mineh, venecheze mimman ihu, uvean sitra yitdabbak.

Miyyad, vayyomer Adonai el hassatan hinne chol asher lo beyadecha. leachazaa, didchilu deiyyov legabbeh dekudesha berich hu, hu lenatra utereh. umehacha olifna, dechol innun dedachalin leh lekudesha berich hu, al uterayyhu, o al benayyhu, lav ihu dechilu kedka yeot. veal da kitreg hahu mekatrega veamar, hachinnam yare iyyov elohim halo atta sachta vaado vegomer maase yadav berachta. veal da ihu dachil lach veityeyhiv leh reshu lekatrega beh, uleachazaa, dela palach iyyov lekudesha berich hu birchimu.
Dechevan deitnasse, nafak meorcha, vela kaim bekiumeh, ma ketiv, bechol zot la chata iyyov bisfatav. lo chata bisfatav aval biruteh chata, ulevatar chata becholla.

Vei tema dela itnasse bar nash, ha ketiv (Tehillim 11:5) Adonai tzaddik yivchan vegomer. uvegin kach itnasse iyyov. veaf al gav dela kaim bekiumeh kedka yeot, la nafak mittechot reshuta demareh leitdabbeka besitra achara.

Vechamma hava hahu nissuta dileh. teresar yarche, shuletanuta dehahu sitra achara. kema detanenan, dina dechayyavaya baggehinnam 12 yarche, uvegin dela itdabbak besitra achara ketiv, (iyyov 42:12) vaAdonai berach et acharit (nidpas 181 amud bet) iyyov mereshito.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay deiyyov, lav nissuta ihu dekudesha berich hu, kenisuta dishar tzaddikayya, deha la ketiv vehaelohim nissa et iyyov, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:1) vehaelohim nissa et avraham. deavraham, ihu bideh akriv livreh yechiday dileh legabbe kudesha berich hu, veiyyov la yahiv kelum, vela masar leh lekudesha berich hu kelum.

Vela ittemar leh, deha galle kameh, dela yachil lekayyeyma beh, aval itmesar bida dimkatrega. uvedina dekudesha berich hu itavid, vekudesha berich hu ittear dina (bedina) da, lehahu mekatrega legabbeh, hada hu dichtiv, (iyyov 1:8) hasamta libbecha al avdi iyyov vegomer.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 4:3) vayhi mikketz yamim vayyave kayin mipperi haadama. mikketz yamim, velo mikketz yamin. ihu dacha leketz yamin, veitkeriv leketz yamim. veha okimna, (Daniel 12:13) veatta lech leketz. veamar daniel, lean ketz, leketz hayyamin, o leketz hayyamim. ad deamar leh leketz hayyamin. veal da david dachil veamar, (Tehillim 39:5) hodieni Adonai kitztzi umiddat yamay ma hi, o leketz hayyamim o leketz hayyamin. vehacha ma ketiv vayhi mikketz yamim, velo mikketz yamin, uvegin kach la itkabbal karbaneh, deha missitra achara hava. (kolla)

Ta chaze, ma ketiv vehevel hevi gam hu. may gam hu. leasgaa da beda, karbaneh lekudesha berich hu hava kolla, veikara dekarbena lekudesha berich hu, veyahav chulaka lesitra achara, kema deat amer umechelvehen. vekayin, ikara aved mikketz yamim, raza desitra achara, veyahiv chulaka lekudesha berich hu, veal da la itkabbal.
