Beiyyov ma ketiv, (iyyov 1:4) vehalchu vanav veasu mishte vegomer, veshalchu vekaru lishloshet achyotehem leechol velishtot immahem vayhi ki hikkifu yeme hammishte vegomer, uvemishteya bechol yoma mekatrega shechiach, vela yachil leh. mena lan. dichtiv, (iyyov 1:10) halo atta sachta vaado uvead beto uvead kol asher lo missaviv uleolam la yahiv chulaka kelal legabbeh, deha (nusach acher ma) ketiv (iyyov 1:Adonai) veheela olot mispar kullam. ola salleka leella leella, vela yahiv chulaka lesitra achara. deilmale yahav leh chulaka, la yachil leh levatar, vechol ma denatal middileh natal.

Vei tema amay avish leh kudesha berich hu. ella. deilmale yahav leh chulaka, yifni archa veyistelak meal makdesha, vesitra dikdushsha istelik leella leella. veihu la aved ken, veal da kudesha berich hu tava bedina.

Ta chaze, kema deihu itperash, vela achlil tov vara, ihu dan leh behahu gavvna, yahiv leh tov, ulevatar ra, ulevatar ahadreh letov. dehachi itchaze lebar nash, leminda tov, uleminda ra, uleahdara garmeh letov, veda ihu raza dimhemanuta. ta chaze, iyyov meavde paro hava, veda hu dichtiv beh, (Shemot 9:20) hayyare et devar Adonai meavde paro. ta chaze, dela baa kudesha berich hu leaakara iyyov meatreh deihu hava michse (nusach acher kola baa kudesha behach hu leakera meatrayyhu iyyov hava mechase) (nusach acher iyyov chakkim hava) al paro kevan deitchalash avad nukemin lefaro
Zohar, Yitro 27: (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. rabbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Bereshit 2:3) vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii, uchetiv bamman (Shemot 16:26) sheshet yamim tilketuhu uveyom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye bo. kevan dela mishtechach beh mezone, ma bircheta ishtechach beh.

Ella hachi tana, kol birkan dilella vetatta, beyoma sheviaa talyayn. vetana, amay la ishtechach manna beyoma sheviaa, mishshum dehahu yoma, mitbarchan minneh kol shita yomin illain, vechol chad vechad yahiv mezoneh letatta, kol chad beyomoy, mehahi beracha demitbarchan beyoma sheviaa.

Uvegine kach, man deihu bedarga dimhemanuta, bae lesaddera patora, uleatkena seudata belelya deshabbeta, begin deyitbarech patoreh, kol innun shita yomin, deha behahu zimna, izdaman beracha, leitbarcha kol shita yomin deshabbeta, uvirchata la ishtechach befatora rekanayya. veal kach, bae lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, benahame uvimzone.
Rabbi yitzchak amar, afilu beyoma deshabbeta name. rabbi yehuda amar, bae leitanga behay yoma, ulemechal telat seudate beshabbeta, begin deyishtechach sava veinnuga behay yoma bealma.

Rabbi abba amar, leizdammena bircheta beinnun yomin dilella, demitbarchan mehay yoma. vehay yoma, malya resheh dizer anpin, mittalla denachit meattika kaddisha setima decholla, veatil lechakla detappuchin kaddishin, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, deyitbarchun kullehu kachada.

Veal da bae bar nash, leitanga telat zimnin illen, deha beha talya mehemanuta dilella, beattika kaddisha, uvizer appin, uvechakla detappuchin. uvae bar nash leitanga behu, ulemechode behu. uman degara seudata minayyhu, achze pegimuta leela veonsheh dehahu bar nash saggi.

Begine kach, bae lesaddera patoreh, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, vela yishtekach patoreh rekanayya, vetishre bircheta aleh, kol shear yome deshabbeta. uvehay milla, achze, vetale mehemanuta leella.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay man deashlim telat seudate beshabbata, kala nafik umachreza aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, da seudata chada, lokovel (Vayikra 288 amud bet) attika kaddisha dechol kaddishin. vehirkavticha al bomote aretz, da seudata tinyayna, lokovel chakla detappuchin kaddishin. vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha, da hu shelimu deishtelim bizer appin.

Ulokavlayyhu bae leashlema seudateh, uvae leitanga bechullehu seudate, ulemechode bechol chad vechad minnayyhu, mishshum deihu mehemanuta shelemata. uvegin kach, shabbeta ityakkar, mikkol shear zimnin vechaggin, mishshum decholla beh ishtechach, vela ishtechach hachi bechullehu zimne vechagge. amar rabbi chiyyay, begin kach, mishshum deishtechach kolla beh, idkar telat zimnin. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii.

Rabbi abba, (nusach acher rav hamenuna sava) kad hava yativ bisudata deshabbeta, have chadde, bechol chad vechad, vahava amar, da hi seudata kaddisha, deattika kaddisha setima decholla. bisudata achara hava amar, da hi seudata dekudesha berich hu. vechen bechullehu seudate, vahava chadde bechol chad vechad. kad hava ashlim seudate, amar ashlimu seudate dimhemanuta.

Rabbi shimon, kad hava ate lisudata, hava amar hachi, atkinu seudata dimhemnuta illaa, atkinu seudata demalka, vahava yativ vechadde. kad ashlim seudata telitaa, havo machrize aleh, az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha.

Amar rabbi elazar leavuy, illen seudate hech mittaknin. amar leh, lelya deshabbeta, ketiv, vehirkavticha al bomote aretz. beh belelya, mitbarcha matronita, vechullehu chakal tappuchin, umitbarcha patoreh devar nash, venishmeta ittosfat, vehahu lelya, chedva dematronita have. uvae bar nash lemechode bechedvavta, ulemechal seudata dematronita.

Beyoma deshabbeta, bisudata tinyayna, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. al Adonai vadday. dehahi shaata itgalya attika kaddisha, vechullehu almin bechedvavta, ushelimu vechedvavta deattika avdenan, useudata dileh hu vadday.

Bisudata telitaa deshabbeta, ketiv vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. da hi seudata dizer appin, dehave bishlemuta. vechullehu shita yomin, mehahu shelimu mitbarchan. uvae bar nash lemechode bisudateh, uleashlema illen seudate, deinnun seudate mehemanuta shelemata, dezara kaddisha deyisrael, di mehemanuta illaa, deha dilhon hi, vela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uvegini kach amar, (Shemot lo) beni uven bene yisrael.

Ta chaze, bisudate illen, ishtemodun yisrael, deinnun beni malka. deinnun mehechala demalka, deinnun beni mehemanuta, uman defagim chad seudata minnayyhu, achze pegimuta leella, veachze garmeh delav mibbene malka illaa hu, delav mibbene hechala demalka hu delav mizzara kaddisha deyisrael hu. veyahavin aleh chumera ditlat millin, dina degehinnam vegomer.

Veta chazi, bechullehu shear zimnin vechaggin, bae bar nash lechde, ulemechde lemiskene. vei hu chadde bilchodoy, vela yahiv lemiskene, onsheh saggi, deha bilchodoy chadde, vela yahiv chidu leachara. aleh ketiv, (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem. vei ihu beshabbata chadde, af al gav dela yahiv leachara, la yahavin aleh onsha, kishar zimnin vechaggin, dichtiv peresh chaggechem. persh chaggechem kaamar, velo peresh shabbattechem. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:14) chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi. veillu shabbat la kaamar.

Uvegine kach ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael. umishshum dechol mehemanuta ishtechach beshabbata, yahavin leh levar nash nishmeta achara, nishmeta illaa, nishmeta dechol shelimu bah, kedugema dealma deate. uvegine kach ikre shabbat. mahu shabbat. shema dekudesha berich hu. shema deihu shelim mikkol sitroy.

Amar rabbi yosi, vadday kach hu. vavy leh levar nash, dela ashlim chedavavta demalka kaddisha. uman chedvavta deleh. illen telat seudate mehemanuta. seudate deavraham yitzchak veyaakov kelilan behu. vechullehu chidu al chidu mehemanuta shelemuta, mikkol sitroy.

Tana, bahaden yoma mitatteran avahan, vechol benin yankin, ma delav hachi bechol shear chaggin uzemanin. bahaden yoma, chayyayvayya degehinnam nayychin. bahaden yoma, kol dinin itkafyayn, vela mitarin bealma. bahaden yoma orayyta mitattera beitrin shelemin. bahaden yoma, chedvavta vetafnuka ishtema, bematan vechamshin almin.

Ta chazi, bechol shita yome deshabbeta, kad mata shaata ditzlota demincha, dina (156 amud alef) takkifa shalta, vechol dinin mitarin. aval beyoma deshabbeta, kad mata idan ditzlota demincha, raava deraavin ishtechach, veattika kaddisha galya ratzon dileh, vechol dinin mitkafyayn, umishtechach reuta vecheddu becholla.

Uvehay ratzon, istallak moshe, nevia mehemana kaddisha mealma. begin leminda, dela bedina istallak, vehahi shaata beratzon deattika kaddisha nafak nishmateh, veittammar beh. begin kach, (Devarim la) velo yada ish et kevurato ketiv. ma attika kaddisha, temira mikkol temirin, vela yadin illain vetattain. uf hacha, hay nishmeta deittammar behay ratzon, deitgalya beshaata ditzlota demincha deshabbeta, ketiv velo yada ish et kevurato vehu tamir mikkol temirin dealma, vedina la shalta beh. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe.

Tana, behay yoma, deorayyta mitattera beh, mitattera becholla, bechol innun pikkudin bechol innun gizrin veonashin, beshivin anafin dinhora, dezaharin mikkol sitra vesitra. man chame, anafin denafkin mikkol anafa vaanafa, chamishsha kayymin bego ilana, kullehu anpin behu achidan. man chame, innun tarin demitpattechan bechol setar usetar, kullehu mizdaharin venaharin, behahu nehora denafik vela pasik.

Kal karoza nafik, ittearu kaddishe elyonin, ittearu amma kaddisha, deitbachar leella vetatta. ittearu chedvavta lekadmut marechon. ittearu bechedvavta shelemata. izdemanu bitlat chedvavn, ditlat avahan. izdemanu lekadmut mehemanuta, dechedvav dechol chedvavta. zakkaa chulekechon, yisrael kaddishin, bealma den uvealma deate. da hu yaruta lechon, mikkol ammim ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday. veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchetiv (Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad.

Tana, behay yoma, kol nishmatehon detzaddikayyay, mitaddenin betafnuke attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin. verucha chada meinnuga dehahu attika kaddisha mitpashta (hahu mitpashshet) bechullehu almin, vesalleka venachta, umitpashsheta lechullehu bene kaddishin, lechullehu neture orayyta, venayychin benayycha shelim, mitneshe mikkullehu, kol rugezin, kol dinin, vechol pulechanin kashin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom hinniach Adonai lach meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha.

Begine kach, shakil shabbeta lokovel orayyta, vechol denatir shabbeta, keillu natir orayyta kulla. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 56:2) ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kol ra. ishtema, deman denatir shabbat, keman denatir orayyta kulla.

Rabbi yuday shail leh lera shimon, yoma chad deara immeh bearcha, amar leh, Rabbi, ha ketiv (sefer acher befarsheta deshabbat) befarsheta da shabbat, deamar yeshaya, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vegomer, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay vegomer. ma ka mayyre.

Amar leh, kapputekaa, chamarach kitre betifsa, unechit, demilla deorayyta bae tzachuta. o afche laachorach, vezil avatray, utechavvevn libbach. amar leh, begineh demor avidna archa, uvatreh demor estakkel bishchinta.

Amar leh, ta chaze, milla da ha ukemuha chavrayyay, vela perishu milla. cho amar Adonai lassarisim. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, umesarse garmayyhu kol shita yomin deshabbeta, velaan beorayyta, uvelelya deshabbeta mezarze garmayyhu beziuuga dilhon, mishshum deyade raza illaa, beshaata dematronita izdavvevgat bemalka.

Veinnun chavrayyay deyadin raza da, mechavvevnin libbayyhu limhemanuta demarehon umitbarchan beibba dimehon behahu lelya. veda hu dichtiv, asher yishmeru, kema deat amar, (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar.

Veikrun sarisim vadday, begin lechakkaa leshabbeta leashkecha raava demarehon, dichtiv vvcharo baasher chafatzti. may baasher chafatzti. da ziuuga dematronita. umachazikim bivriti, kolla chad, bivriti setam. zakkaa chulakeh deman deitkaddash bikdusha da, veyada raza da.

Ta chazi, ketiv sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol melachtecha veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai elohecha vegomer, kol melachtecha, beinnun shita yome avidtayyhu divne nasha uvegin hay milla. la mizdavvevge chavrayyay, bar bezimna dela yishtekach meavidtayyhu divni nasha, ella avidte dekudesha berich hu. umay avidte. ziuuga dematronita, leappaka nishmatin kaddishin lealma.

Uvegin kach, behay lelya chavrayyay mitkaddeshe bikdushsha demarehon, umechavvevne libbayyhu, venafke bene maale, benin kaddishin, dela satan limina velismala, benin demalka umatronita. veal illen ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, laAdonai elohechem vadday. begin deillen ikrun benin dileh, benin lemalka ulematronita.

Veha datayyhu dechavrayyay deyadin raza da, beda mitdabbekan. uvegin kach ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu. vehani innun dealma mitkayyeyma beginayyhu. vechad salik alma bedina, istakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun benoy, umerachem al alma. veal da ketiv (Yirmeyahu 2:21) kullo zera emet. zera emet vadday. mahu emet. izka kaddisha shelemata. kema deat amer (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. (emet da kudesha berich hu) vecholla chad. uvegine kach, zera emet vadday.

Amar leh Rabbi yuday, berich rachamana deshadarni hacha, berich rachamana, deha milla da shemana mippumach. bacha rabbi yuday. amar leh Rabbi shimon, amay ka bachit. amar leh, bachena, daamena devavy leinun bene alma, dearchehon kivire, vela yade vela mistakkele, detav lon dela itberiu. vavy lealma kad yippuk mor minneh, deman yachil legallaa razin, uman yinda lon, uman yistakkal bearche orayyta.

Amar leh, chayyecha, let alma ella leinun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta veyadin setime orayyta. vadday bikshot gazru chavrayyay al amma deara, dimchabbelin archayyhu, vela yadin ben yemina lismala, deha innun kivire, deyeot lemebad behu dina, afillu beyom hakkippurim. veal benayyhu ketiv, (Hoshea 2:6) ki vene zenunim hemma, vene zenunim mammash.

Amar leh, Rabbi, hay kera bae leityayshsheva bearchoy. ketiv (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo. etten lahem mibbae leh, mahu etten lo.

Amar leh, ta chaze, venatatti lahem beveti, mahu beti. kema deat amar (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. (341 dekudesha berich hu ikre bet) uvechomotay, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomotayich yerushala 40 hifkadti shomrim yad vashem, kelomar deyishlefun nishmatin kaddishin midducheta da. vehahu yad, chulak beashlamuta. tav, malya mibbenin umibbenatan. shem olam etten lo, lehahu chulak shelim. asher lo yikkaret ledare darin. davar acher etten lo lehahu deyada raza demilla, veyitkevavn bema devae lechavvevna.

Tu amar Rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. may taama. begin dela itchaze dina behay yoma. vei tema ha laggavoah salleka. bechol moshvotechem kaamar, vela laggavoah. vehahu desalleka laggavoah, leachfeya ledina achara salleka. detanenan, it eshsha achla eshsha. veesha demadbecha, achla eshsha achara.
Uvegine kach, itgalya attika kaddisha behay yoma, mikkol shear yomin. uvezimna deitgalya attika, la itchaze dina kelal. vechol illain vetattain mishtakkechin bechedvavta shelemata, vedina la shalta.

Tana, ketiv (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. sheshet yamim vadday, vela besheshet. vehane yomin kaddishin illain, ikrun yome dishma kaddisha itkelil behu, veinnun itteklilan beh. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

ohc: Vaychazzek Adonai vegomer velo ava vegomer. yaid hakkatuv ki bappaam hazzot hechlit bedato shelilat shelichut yisrael, velo nishar bedato lachshov machshavot im yachush lammakkot o im yisbol makkot haggedolot, ella chatam haddavar yaavor al divre Adonai hagam sheyyehareg.

O yirtze shennitchakkem laasot ofen shello yavou alav od makkot, uvaze en hechreach leshallecham. vehu ma sheamar samuch leamro "velo ava", vayyomer lo paro lech mealay vegomer. hakkavvana baze ki letzad shehiskil betesha makkot shebbau alav, shekkullan hayu al ze haofen: shetayim behateraa veechad belo hateraa, leman deamar shelosha shavuot haya matre al kol makka umakka, uleman deamar shavua echad, amar meatta bemakka zo habbaa titchayyev lihyot hahatraa, veim en hateraa en makka. laze nitchakkem veamar "hishshamer lecha al tosef reot panay", vechevan shekken en hateraa, vechevan sheen hateraa en makka. vehinne lo hiksha Adonai et libbo laasot ken ella ad kelot tesha makkot velo nishara ella makkat bechorot. velaze amar moshe ken dibbarta lo osif od vegomer. uferush divre moshe kevar perashti otam befarashat vaera befasuk (Shemot 7:3) "vaani akshe velo yishma alechem paro" vegomer.

Uvederech remez yirtze beamro ken dibbarta teshuva lema sheamar lo "beyom reotcha fanay tamut", heshivo ki eno yachol lehamit veen beyado ella koach haddibbur, vehu amro "ken dibbarta" velo "ken taase". o yirtze al ze hadderech, kevar dibbarta ken paam acheret, vehamechuvvan hu ree ma alta beyadcha, keamram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 1,lo) befasuk (Shemot 2:15) "vayvakkesh laharog et moshe" velo alta beyado, gam amru (yalkut shemauni 175) sheharag kol shoarav shehinnichu lemoshe likkanes veheshivu ki en lahem shelita alav, veim ken habbazuy ech machlit lomar "beyom vegomer tamut". ucheneged hainyan mitztzad atzmo sheen atta chafetz lirot panay gam ani en ani chafetz lehistakkel bidmutecha, "lo osif" vegomer:

rashi: Ugot matztzot. charara shel matztza; batzek shello hechemitz karuy matztza:

Vegam tzeda lo asu lahem. ladderech. maggid shivchan shel yisrael, shello amru heach netze lammidbar belo tzeda? ella heeminu vehalchu; hu shemmeforash bakkabbala, "zacharti lach chesed neurayich ahavat kelulotayich lechtech acharay bammidbar beeretz lo zerua" (Yirmeyahu 2), ma sachar meforash acharav? "kodesh yisrael laAdonai vegomer":
ohc: Matztzot ki lo chametz. perush, hattaam sheafuhu matztzot ki lo huttar lahem leechol chametz, laze miharu leefoto matztza. vahagam sheshshaha meet lisha ad et afiyya zeman ma, ulay ki hayu mitammelim bo, velaze amar hakkatuv "misharotam tzerurot besimlotam al shichmam", vechi lo haya lahem makom laset otam shehutzrechu letittam al shichmam? ella kede sheyyitammelu bahem, vechol zeman shemmitammelim baissa enah machmetzet, nosaf al shello natnu bo seor lechammetz. venatan hakkatuv taam ki lo chametz ki gorshu mimmitzrayim vegomer:

rashi: Chachmat arum. mi shehu chacham havin darko lefalles archotav:
Veivvelet kesilim. hi hammirma shebbelibbam, sofah shemmeviatam lide tippeshut:
targum: Chachmeta daarima beyuna dearcha uveshatyuta desachle ramayuta:

rashi: VaAdonai. kol makom shenneemar "vaAdonai" hu uvet dino, shehavvav leshon tosefet hu, kemo peloni ufeloni:
Hikka chol bechor. af shel umma acheret vehu vemitzrayim (mechilta):
Mibbechor paro. af paro bechor haya, venishtayyer min habbechorot, vealav hu omer "baavur hareotcha et kochi" (Shemot 9) – beyam suf (mechilta):

Ad bechor hashshevi. shehayu semechin leedam shel yisrael; veod, shello yomru yiratenu hevia happuranut; uvechor hashshifcha bichlal haya, shehare mana min hechashuv shebbechullan ad happachut, uvechor hashshifcha chashuv mibbechor hashshevi:

ohc: Vayyifen vayyetze. zilzelo beenav, sheachar shehitvadda veamar "Adonai hatztzaddik" vegomer vechazar lesirchono, laze pana veyatza kederech hannahug im shear bene adam. vetimtza ki gam paro harasha shillem lo ken, dichtiv "vayyushav vegomer vaygaresh otam meet pene faro" (Shemot 10:8,11). velaze timtza sheachar kach keshekkara lo lehitpallel al hasarat makkat haarbe, amar alehem "chatati laAdonai velachem" (Shemot 10:16), ma shello haya ragil lomar kodem, shennitkavven lehitvaddot al shennahag bam minhag pechitut vaygaresh otam.

rashi: Gam tzonchem gam bekarchem kechu. umahu kaasher dibbartem? "gam atta titten beyadenu zevachim veolot" (Shemot 10), kechu kaasher dibbartem:
Uverachtem gam oti. hitpallelu alay shello amut, sheani bechor:
ohc: Uverachtem gam oti. keillu amar "vegam tevarchu oti", veshiur hakkatuv "uverachtem gam ken oti" millevad sheyyasir hammakka, harechakat hannezek vehakeravat hattoelet.

rashi: Tamim. belo mum:
Ben shana. kol shenato karuy ben shana, kelomar shennolad beshana zo:
Min hakkevasim umin haizzim. o mizze o mizze, sheaf ez karuy se, shenneemar "vese izzim" (Devarim 14):
ohc: Umin haizzim tikkachu. taam shehutzrach lomar tikkachu, lomar afillu yesh kevasim yachol likkach min haizzim, laze samach lekicha laizzim.

rashi: Sheloshet yamim. shillush shel yamim, 370 belaaz, vechen shivat yamim bechol makom shateyynaa shel yamim:

Vayhi choshech afela: sheloshet yamim. choshech shel ofel, shello rau ish et achiv otan 3 yamim. veod sheloshet yamim acherim choshech muchpal al ze, shello kamu ish mittachtav – yoshev en yachol laamod, veomed en yachol leshev; velamma hevi alehem choshech? shehayu veyisrael beoto haddor reshaim velo hayu rotzim latzet, umetu vishloshet yeme afela, kede shello yiru mitzriyyim bemappaltam veyomru, af hem lokim kamonu. veod, shechippesu yisrael verau et kelehem, uchesheyyatzu vehayu shoalim mehen vehayu omrim en beyadenu chelum, omer lo, ani reitiv bevetcha, uvemakom peloni hu (Shemot Rabba):
ohc: Vayyet moshe et yado – tzarich ledakdek, lamma bemakkat haarbe hassemucha lah, hagam sheamar elav Adonai nete yadcha, amar hakkatuv "vayyet moshe et mattehu" vegomer (Shemot 10:13), vegam bechol hammakkot lo hayta makka shehizkir bah netiyyat yad ella matte, uvemakka zo amar et yado.

Veulay sheyyitkavven al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 14,2), ki choshech shel mitzrayim haya meoto choshech dichtiv (tehillim 18:12): "yashet choshech sitro", asher al ken lo nahag minhag miut derech kavod lintot mattehu kelappe mala.

Gam leyesh merabbotenu sheamru (Shemot Rabba 14,2) shechoshech ze haya miggehinnom, ulay ki shenehem nitkavvenu el haemet, ki shene mine choshech hayu: echad sheshshimmesh bishlosha yamim shello rau vegomer, veechad sheshshimmesh bishlosha yamim acherim shello kamu vegomer.

rashi: Teerav lenafesh. keshebbaa taavato lo laadam, hi areva lenafsho; ulechach toavat kesil lasur mera, lefi shearev lahem lemalle taavatam:
Nihya. hove. davar acher: taava nihya hakkadosh baruch hu mitavve sheyyaasu yisrael retzono, uvihyot taavato baa, areva lo. vetoavat reshaim – sheyyasuru meraatam, lemallovt taavatam:
targum: Rigta deyaaya tevasem nafsha umerachakta desachle perika min yediata:

rashi: Vayyikkod haam. al besorat haggeulla uviat haaretz uvesorat habbanim sheyyihyu lahem:
Merameses sukkota. mea veesrim mil hayu, uvau sham lefi shaa, shenneemar "vaessa etchem al kanfe nesharim" (Shemot 19):
Haggevarim. mibben esrim shana vamala (605 Rabba 3, 6):
Vayyomer Adonai el moshe veel aharon. bishvil sheaharon asa vetarach bammoftim kemoshe, chalak lo kavod ze bemitzva rishona, shekkelalo im moshe baddibbur:

Beeretz mitzrayim. chutz lakkerach, o eno ella betoch hakkerach? talo (leel 9 29) "ketzeti et hair vegomer", uma tefilla kalla lo hitpallel betoch hakkerach, dibbur chamur lo kol shekken. umippene ma lo nidbar immo betoch hakkerach? lefi shehayta melea gillulim:

Vehaya lachem lemishmeret. zehu leshon bikkur, shettaun bikkur mimmum arbaa yamim kodem shechita (fesachim 96). umippene ma hikdim lekichato lishchitato arbaa yamim, ma shello tzivva chen befesach dorot? haya Rabbi matya ben charash omer, hare hu omer "vaeevor alayich vaerech vehinne ittech et dodim" (Yechezkel 16) – higgia shevua shennishbati leavraham sheegal et banav, velo hayu veyadam mitzvot lehitassek bahem kede sheyyiggaalu, shenneemar "veat erom veerya" (sham), venatan lahem shete mitzvot, dam pesach vedam mila, shemmalu veoto hallayla, shenneemar "mitboseset bedamayich" (sham) – bishne damim, veomer "gam at bedam beritech shillachti asirayich mibbor en mayim bo" (Zecharya 9); ulefi shehayu shetufin beelilim amar lahem mishchu ukechu lachem, mishchu yedechem meelilim, ukechu lachem tzon shel mitzva (mechilta):
Veshachatu oto vegomer. vechi kullan shochatin? ella mikkan sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto (kiddushin 41):
Kehal adat yisrael. kahal veeda veyisrael; mikkan amru, pische tzibbur nishchatin beshalosh kittot zo achar zo, nichnesa chat rishona ninalu daltot haazara vechulei. kidita bifsachim (daf 64):

Ben haarbayim. mishshesh shaot ulemala karuy ben haarbayim, shehashshemesh note levet mevoo laarov; uleshon ben haarbayim nire veenay otan shaot shebben arivat hayyom laarivat hallayla, arivat hayyom bitchillat 7 shaot mikki yinnatu tzille erev, vaarivat hallayla bitchillat hallayla. erev leshon neshef vechoshech, kemo "arva kol simcha" (Yeshayahu 24):
ohc: Vehaya lachem lemishmeret. perush, tzarich shemira kedin kodashim kevan shekkara alav shem pesach. od yirmoz al derech amram zichrono livracha (Shir HaShirim Rabba 2,2) befasuk "goy mikkerev goy" (Devarim 4:34), shehayu yisrael bemitzrayim seruchim ketzat bechukke avoda zara mitztzad heyotam ben hammitzriyyim, veamru od (Shemot Rabba 16,2) sheramaz hakkatuv beamro "mishchu" sheyyimshechu meavoda zara. vehinne en kavvanatam zichrono livracha lomar chas veshalom shehayu ovde avoda zara, ella letzad shehayu benehem mibbeli yediatam yaasu chukkim shel ovde avoda zara bifrate hammalbushim vehammaachalim udevarim hargilim, vaasher al ken millevad shetztzivva sheyyaakru meotam peratim sheyyedammu lahem, nitchakkem od el elyon laakor bechinat hara mehem velaasot tikkun avon ze, veamar sheyyikchu hattale, shehi avoda zara shel mitzrayim shebbah haya leyisrael hammichsholot, veyaasu bah mitzva haamura bainyan, uvaze yihye lahem tikkun lishmirat avon avoda zara, vehu amro vehaya lachem lemishmeret, perush, bimkom mitzvat shemirat avoda zara kesheyyinhagu bo mishpat katuv, vehaven.

rashi: El eretz hakkenaani vegomer. veaappi shello mana ella chamishsha amamin, kol 7 goyim bemashma, shekkullan bichlal kenaani hem veachat mimmishpechot kenaan hayta shello nikra lah shem ella kenaani:

Nishba laavotecha. beavraham hu omer "bayyom hahu karat Adonai et avram vegomer" (Bereshit 15), uveyitzchak hu omer "gur baaretz hazzot" (sham 26), uveyaakov hu omer "haaretz asher atta shochev aleha" (sham 28):
Zavat chalav udevash. chalav zav min haizzim, vehaddevash zav min hattemarim umin hatteenim:

Et haavoda hazzot. shel pesach; vahalo kevar neemar lemala "vehaya ki tavou el haaretz vegomer", velamma chazar ushenaah? bishvil davar shennitchaddesh bah, befarasha rishona neemar "vehaya ki yomru alechem benechem ma haavoda hazzot lachem" — beven rasha hakkatuv medabber shehotzi et atzmo min hakkelal, vechan "vehiggadta levincha" — beven sheeno yodea lishol, vehakkatuv melammedcha, shettiftach lo atta bedivre aggada hammoshchin et hallev (mechilta):
ohc: Vehaya chi yeviacha vegomer. taam shettala mitzva zo beviat haaretz, lattaam atzmo shekkatavnu befasuk (Shemot 12:25) "vehaya ki tavou el haaretz", o kede shello yishshachach beorech hayyamim sham kesheyyirbu yemehem al haadama.

rashi: Veyamesh choshech. veyachashich alehem choshech yoter mecheshko shel layla, choshech shel layla yaamish veyachashich od:

Veyamesh. kemo veyaamesh; yesh lanu tevot harebe chaserot alef, lefi sheen havarat haalef nikkeret kol kach, en hakkatuv makpid al chesronah, kegon "velo yahel sham aravi" (Yeshayahu 13), kemo lo yaahel – lo yatte oholo, vechen "vattazreni chayil" (Shmuel 2 22), kemo vatteazzereni; veunkelos tirgem leshon hasara, kemo lo yamush; "batar deyede keval lelya" – kesheyyaggia samuch leor hayyom; aval en haddibbur meyushshav al havvav shel veyamesh, lefi shehu chatuv achar vihi choshech. umia potro leshon "memashshesh batztzohorayim" (Devarim 28), shehaya chaful umechuppal veav ad shehaya vo mammash:
Vayyakom paro. mimmittato:
Layla. velo kederech hammelachim beshalosh shaot bayyom (sham):
Hu. techilla, veachar kach avadav, melammed shehaya hu mechazzer al batte avadav umaamidan (sham):

Ki en bayit asher en sham met. yesh sham bechor, met, en sham bechor, gadol shebbabbayit karuy bechor, shenneemar "af ani bechor ettenehu" (Tehillim 89). davar acher, mitzriyyot mezannot tachat balehen veyoldot meravvakim penuyim, vehayu lahem bechorot harebe, peamim chamishsha leishsha achat, kol echad bechor leaviv:
ohc: Vayyakam paro layla. taam amro layla yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (zohar 10 38.) ki oto layla haya kayyom yair ketzachut hayyom. veramazti remez ze bappasuk (Shemot 13:8) "vehiggadta levincha bayyom hahu", ki yechavven lomar sheyyaggid lo gam nes hallayla shennaasa yom. veshemma tomar ki zarach or ballayla derech kelal laraim velattovim, laze amar vayyakam paro layla, keshekkam hu likro lemoshe uleaharon mana Adonai merasha ora vehaya layla, perush choshech, keamro (Bereshit 1:5) "velachoshech kara layla".

rashi: Zachor et hayyom hazze. limmed, shemmazkirin yetziat mitzrayim bechol yom:
El pelishtim. al pelishtim:

Beterem yakke faro et azza. keshehaya nevuchadnetztzar tzar al yerushalayim bashshana haasirit letzidkiyyahu, yatza chel paro mimmitzrayim vayyaalu hakkasdim meal yerushalayim (yirmeya 37:5); shama paro, veshataf et azza veshav leartzo. beseder olam (perek 26):
targum: Dahava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai im yirmeya neviya al pelishtae ad la yete faro veyimche yat yatve aza:

rashi: Vayyushav. hushevu al yede sheliach, sheshshalchu acharehem veheshivum el paro:
ohc: Lechu ivdu vegomer. amar setam haddevarim venitchakkem leharechik shello yaale al haddaat sheyyishalu sheyyelchu kullam, velaze dibber setam "lechu ivdu", veamar mi vami, lo lomar im kullam im mehem ze, vadday shello yelchu ella bene haavoda, kemo sheggilla levassof "lechu haggevarim ki otah attem mevakshim", ella gam baggevarim haya chafetz shello yelchu kullam.

rashi: (Vehaya ki yeviacha. yesh merabbotenu shellamdu mikkan shello kadshu bechorot hannoladim bammidbar, vehaomer kadshu, mefaresh bia zo im tekayyemuhu vammidbar tizku likkanes laaretz utekayyemuhu sham):
Nishba lecha. vehechan nishba lecha? "veheveti etchem el haaretz asher nasati vegomer" (Shemot 6):
Unetanah lecha. tehe veenecha keillu nittena lecha bo bayyom, veal tehi veenecha kirushshat avot:
ohc: Vehaya ki yeviacha vegomer. amar vehaya ki yeviacha vegomer, lomar shello yishkach mitzvot Adonai ki yarchiv Adonai gevulo veyishman veyivat, velo chash lomar ki davka baaretz, letzad shehi mitzva hatteluya bagguf veamrinan bekiddushin (36:) shekkol mitzva shehi teluya bagguf en chilluk ben baaretz ben bechutz laaretz.

rashi: Ad yom haechad veesrim. lamma neemar? vahalo kevar neemar "shivat yamim"? lefi shenneemar yamim, lelot minnayin? talo ad yom haechad veesrim vegomer (mechilta):
Yesh derech yashar lifne ish. over avera veomer en bah avera. davar acher: yesh derech yashar lifne ish. derech atzel yeshara hayta beene esav shehaya ish sade (Bereshit 25:27), veacharitah vegomer:
targum: It orcha desavrin bene nasha ditritza hi vesofah orcha demota:

rashi: Al tochlu mimmennu na. sheeno tzaluy kol tzarko koro na velashon aravi:
Uvashel mevushshal. kol ze beazharat al tochlu:
Bammayim. minnayin lishar mashkin? talo uvashel mevushshal, mikkol makom (fesachim 41):
Ki im tzeli esh. lemala gazar alav bemitzvat ase, vechan hosif alav lo taase, al tochlu mimmennu … ki im tzeli esh:

Rosho al keraav. tzolehu kullo cheechad im rosho veim keraav veim kirbo, uvene meav noten letocho achar hadachatan (sham 74); uleshon al kirbo kilshon "al tzivotam" (Shemot 6), kemo betzivotam – kemot shehen, af ze kemot shehu – kol besaro mishshalem:
Kala. gemera; kalil, kullechem yeshallach:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai vegomer od nega vegomer. parasha zo maggedet ma shekkevar amar Adonai kodem. vetimtza ki hatechalat hammakkot nevua rishona shehayta bemidyan amar lo (Shemot 3:19) "lo yitten etchem melech mitzrayim lahaloch velo beyad chazaka veshalachti et yadi vegomer venatatti et chen haam vegomer veshaala" vegomer. unevua sheniyya gam ken bemidyan hodio makkat bechorot, dichtiv (Shemot 4:22) "beni vechori vegomer vattemaen leshallecho hinne anochi horeg et bincha bechorecha", hare beyado makkat bechorot baacharona. unevua shelishit beeretz mitzrayim amar elav (Shemot 7:4) ki siman sof hammakkot hu keshello yishma lahem paro, perush, shello yirtze lishmoa divrehem od. asher al ken kesheamar lo "al tosef" vegomer mizze yada ki higgia zeman makka haacharona shebbah yetzu, veyada otah ki hi zo makkat bechorot sheshshekula keneged kol vechulei hanneemeret elav bismichut mitzvat "veshaala ishsha mishshechentah". vehu ma sheamar hakkatuv vayyomer Adonai od nega vegomer, perush, kevar amar Adonai "od" vegomer, perush, shehu ma shekkatav bannevuot harishonot kemo sherashamti. velaze amar moshe techef el paro "ko amar Adonai kachatzot hallayla" vegomer. vahagam shello matzinu sheamar lo Adonai sham perat ze shel kachatzot, yillamed satum mehameforash ki chen hayu sham haddevarim ella shekkitzer, umimmekomo atta lamed ki chen amar elav Adonai. umeatta lo neemra nevua zo bemitzrayim. gam lo kashe lamma yetzav Adonai paamayim al sheelat kelim mimmitzrayim.

rashi: Befi evil choter gaava. makkel shel gaava, kegon paro, sheamar "mi Adonai asher eshma bekolo" (Shemot 5:2):
Tishmurem. kemo "tishmerem" (Mishlei 22:18) – tishmor et hachachamim:
targum: Befumeh deshatya zakta detzaara vesifvathon dechakkime ninteran inun:

rashi: Mishchu. mi sheyyesh lo tzon yimshoch mishshello:
Ukechu. mi sheen lo yikkach min hashshuk (sham):
Lemishpechotechem. se levet avot:
ohc: Vayyikra moshe lechol zikne yisrael. vahagam ki Adonai amar elav "dabberu el kol adat yisrael", yihye perusho kemaamar (vayyikra 4:13) "veim kol adat yisrael yishgu" sheyyeamer al hazzekenim kemo shemmeforash bimkomo (torat kohanim), "vayyomer alehem" yechavven lishar haam, kemishpat kol mitzvot Adonai leyisrael shehayu mippi moshe (eruvin ned,1).

O efshar shello amar ella lazzekenim vehem yedabberu lechol adat yisrael, vachaluka mitzva zo mishshear mitzvot hattora ki adayin lo nichnesu yisrael babberit velo huchenchu lehikkanes lishmor velaasot, velaze haya medabber lazzekenim vehazzekenim kol echad yedabber benachat uvederech hammitkabbel livne mishpachto kede sheyyihyu nochim laasot.

rashi: Hirba koshel. hakkadosh baruch hu shehadafo, vehirba lo michshol:
Gam nafal. nitkabbetzu ish el reehu lemor nakuma venashuva el ammenu, mimmakom sheyyatzanu mishsham lehillachem:
Cherev hayyona. "charba desana dehi kechamra meravya" (targum yonatan); hayyona leshon yayin. lashon acher: leshon onaa:
targum: Asgiu matkelehon af ishtemau gevar lechavreh veyemrun kumu unetuv leamna uleara yaldutana min kodam charba desana dehi chechamar meravya:

rashi: Veasa fesach. yachol kol hammitgayyer yaase pesach miyyad, talmud lomar vehaya keezrach haaretz, ma ezrach bearbaa asar af ger bearbaa asar (sham):
Vechol arel lo yochal bo. lehavi et shemmetu echav mechamat mila, sheeno mumar laarelut veeno lamed mibben nechar lo yochal bo" (sham):
ohc: Vechi yagur ittecha ger. kan hiskim al kabbalat gerim mehaerev rav kedaat moshe, vehu amro ittecha. od ramaz daat elyon ki lo hiskima al haddavar ella lirtzon moshe Adonai chafetz, keamram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 42). vehu amro ittecha ger, perush, immecha hu ger, sheen atta baki bannistarot velo machshevotay machshevotechem, vetze ulemad ma alta beyadam mehem.

Himmol lo chol zachar. perush, keshem shemmilat eved meakkevet beyisrael shello yochal, gam hagger milat avadav vechulei meakkevet oto ad sheyyimmol lo kol zachar. veamro veaz yikrav vegomer, perush lo yitztarech sheyyishchatu acherim alav ella hu beatzmo yikrav laasoto, vehaya keezrach vegomer:

rashi: Kaasher ashallach etchem veet tappechem. af ki ashallach gam et hatztzon veet habbakar kaasher amartem:

Reu ki raa neged penechem. ketargumo. umia shamati, kochav echad yesh sheshshemo raa, amar lahem paro, roe ani baitztagninut shelli oto chochav ole likratchem bammidbar, vehu siman dam vahariga; ucheshechatu yisrael baegel uvikkesh hakkabba lehargam, amar moshe bitfillato, lamma yomru mitzrayim lemor "beraa" hotziam (Shemot 32), zo hi sheamar lahem, reu ki raa neged penechem; miyyad vayyinnachem Adonai al haraa vehafach et haddam ledam mila, shemmal yehoshua otam, vezehu shenne "hayyom galloti et cherpat mitzrayim mealechem" (Yehoshua Adonai), shehayu omrim lachem, dam anu roin alechem bammidbar:
Yachtiru daat. yaasuhu keter lerosham, vesof:
targum: Yertun shavre shatyuta uchelilhon daarimae yediata:

rashi: Kele gola. adam yotze ladderech, metakken lo chemet umekadda shel cheres lishtot bah:
Venitztzeta. leshon "tziyya" (yeshaya 41:18):
targum: Mane galuta atkini lich malchut kenishta demitzrayim are mappas letzadu tehe vetitzde mibbeli yatev:

rashi: Ushemartem et hammatztzot. shello yavou lide chimmutz; mikkan amru tafach tiltosh betzonen, rabbi yoshiyya omer al tehi kore et hammatztzot, ella et hammitzvot – kederech sheen machamitzin et hammatztza, kach en machamitzin et hammitzva, ella im baa leyadcha, ase otah miyyad (sham):
Ushemartem et hayyom hazze. mimmelacha:

Ledorotechem chukkat olam. lefi shello neemar dorot vchukkat olam al hammelacha ella al hachagiga, lechach chazar ushenao kan, shello tomar azharat kol melacha lo yaase lo ledorot neemra ella leoto haddor:
ohc: Ushemartem et hammatztzot vegomer. perush, keshem sheani shamarti hayyom velo echarti yom echad, uveetzem hayyom hazze hotzeti etchem, letaam ze attem gam ken lo teacharu hammatztza ad shettachmitz.

Veamar od ushemartem et hayyom hazze, yetzav ken hael gam ken sheyyihye haadam meshammer gam hayyom leval yite bacheshbon, velo yakdim velo yeacher measot et hayyom hazze velo yom acher bimkomo. vechol perush ze omer ki beetzem yair yamin usemol, yair latet taam lema shellefanav lishmirat hammatztzot, veyair lema shelleacharav lishmirat hayyom al ze hadderech, ki beetzem vegomer perush letaam shebbeetzem hayyom vegomer ushemartem attem gam ken et hayyom hazze.

rashi: Vayyikra lemoshe uleaharon layla. maggid shehaya mechazzer al pitche hair vetzoek, hechan moshe sharuy? hechan aharon sharuy? (mechilta):
Gam attem. haggevarim:
Gam bene yisrael. hattaf:
Ulechu ivdu et Adonai kedabberchem. hakkol kemo sheamartem velo kesheamarti ani; batel "lo ashalleach", batel "mi vami haholchim", batel "rak tzonchem uvekarchem yutztzag":
ohc: Vayyikra lemoshe vegomer layla. taam amro paam sheniyya layla; ulay leheyot ki chash paro bikriato lemoshe shello yetze likrato mechashash gezerato sheamar lo (Shemot 10:28) "al tosef reot panay ki beyom reotcha fanay tamut", veim ken yachush leval yaalil alav, laze amar bikriato "layla", perush, en ze mittenae haggezera ki hu lo amar ella bayyom velo ballayla uzeman ze layla hu. o letzad shello yire panav hu omer ki hu layla veen kan taanat "al tosef reot panay" ki hu bemachshach, lo yiru ish et vegomer.

O yechavven hakkatuv lomar teshuvat moshe el paro keshekkara lo, ki anahu veamar lo "layla", veen ani yachol latzet ledabber immecha, ki tzivva Adonai (Shemot 12:22) "lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker".

Veamar paro "kumu tzeu" vegomer, perush, asaam bene chorin leatzman. veulay sheramaz betevat kumu leshon hitkommut unesiut rosh, al derech ma sheddarshu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 58,8) befasuk (Bereshit 23,17) "vayyakam sede efron". vechashav ki baze tekal hammakka mealav kesheyyigmor haddavar mitztziddo leshallecham, hagam sheyyavo haikkuv mehem en alav ashmat davar.

Od yirmoz beamro kumu tzeu, ki letzad shello hayu rotzim latzet elav keraam lakum, ki chashav sheenam rotzim lakum mimmittatam lavo etzlo, veamar ki keriato lahem hu lahanaatam sheomer lahem "tzeu" vegomer. ulederech ze taam amro "layla", hikdim hakkatuv lomar taam shello yatzu likrato techef umiyyad, vaAdonai tzivva al kevod hammalchut, laze hikdim sibba asher sibbeva akkavatam mitztzet veamar "layla", vezo sibba shello kamu veyatzu etzlo ki Adonai tzivva "lo tetzu ish mippetach beto" vegomer (Shemot 12:22).

Gam attem vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma amar "gam" bitchillat davar? veod, vechi moshe veaharon hayu asurim shehutzrach lomar "tzeu mittoch ammi"? veulay ki mittoch devarav gilla machshavto ki haya chafetz sheyyutztzegu moshe veaharon, laze amar gam attem millevad yisrael. uletzad sheen haddavar muvan betevat "gam" shehi al yisrael, ki lefi haemet moshe lo haya bemaasar, uchesheamar "gam" en bemashmaut hakkodem bene yisrael, velo yutzdak lomar "gam attem" ella lefi machshevet paro kannizkar, laze chazar levaer gam bene yisrael.

Od yirtze, ki nitkavven legaresh otam hagam sheyyachpetzu mertzonam lashevet immahem, ulefi ze yutzdak lomar gam attem – hagam sheattem birshut atzmechem, af al pi chen en ani chafetz shetteshvu beartzi, veze chiddush, vehu ma sheamar Adonai (Shemot 11:1) "keshallecho kala garesh yegaresh etchem". veamro gam bene yisrael lerabbot hattaf vehannashim, veamro gam tzonchem vegomer lerabbot shear mikne, o lerabbot ma sheshshaalu leezer mimmennu.

rashi: Shaatat. en lo dimyon; veyonatan tirgemo: "mippesoit":
Meraash lerichbo. meraash asher lerichbo:
Galgillav. ofanne markevotav:
Lo hifnu avot el banim. lehatztzilam:
targum: Mikal mafsuit parat gibbarohi mizia lirtichohi itregushat galgalohi la mitpenan avhan lerachama al benin meitrashlot yedin:

rashi: Zot chukkat happasach. beyd benisan neemra lahem parasha zo:
Kol ben nechar. shennitnakkeru maasav leaviv shebbashshamayim, veechad haggoy veechad yisrael meshummad bemashma (mechilta):
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai vegomer zot chukkat happasach. kashe, lamma lo amar "dabber el bene yisrael" kasseder haamur bechol mitzva umitzva. ulefi ma shekkatavnu (Shemot 12:3) ki parasha zo neemra beyd benisan, lo hutzrach lomar "dabber" ki hi semucha im "dabberu el kol adat yisrael" sheamar sham. veyesh latet taam lamma lo nichteva bimkomah, ki letzad shemmitzva zo bishlemut yeshnah kefesach dorot neemra achar yetziat mitzrayim, lomar ki chol ze bishlemut meakkev ledorot.

Veraiti midrash rabbotenu (Shemot Rabba 19,5) shehotzi Adonai ruach miggan eden, uvissem pischo shel moshe, venitkabbetzu kol yisrael veamru lo: moshe rabbenu, bevakkasha haachilenu mippesach shellecha. amar lahem: im en attem nimolim en attem ochlim, dichtiv "zot chukkat happasach" vegomer. miyyad natnu atzman umalu vechulei, ad kan. hinne lefi midrash ze lo kashe lamma lo amar "dabber" vegomer o "lemor", ki parasha zo lemoshe uleaharon neemra, vetzivva otam "kol ben nechar" vegomer, veachar shebbau yisrael letzad achilat pischo shel moshe hamevussam malu atzmam.

Vekashe ledivre hammidrash, ech yachol litten lahem mippischo, vahalo en happesach neechol ella limnuyav? veulay sheamar lahem ken kede sheyyimmolu, uchesheyyimmolu yihye kemo chen pischehem kefischo shel moshe mevussam. veraiti reaya ledivre hammidrash shello ratzu limmol mimma sheamar bichezkel (20:8) "vayyamru vi velo avu lishmoa elay vegomer vaomar lishpoch chamati alehem betoch eretz mitzrayim", hare shello kibbelu asot mitzvotav yitbarach:

rashi: Uletotafot. tefillin; veal shem shehem arvaa vattim keruyin tatepat – "tat" bechatpi shetayim, "pat" beafriki shetayim (sanhedrin 4). umenachem chibbero im "vehattef el darom" (Yechezkel 21), "al tattifu" (Micha 2), leshon dibbur, kemo ulezikkaron, sheharoe otam kashur ben haenayim, yizkor hannes vidabber bo:
ohc: Vehaya leot al yadcha vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha (menachot 37,1) amru: "yadcha" – yad keha shehu yad semol, vetzarich ladaat maddua lo bachar Adonai beyad yamin laasot bo hammitzva ki hu hameshubbach. verabbotenu amru (sham) leheyoto mechuvvan keneged hallev shebbetzad semol, vedivrehem emet, ella shennire li latet tuv taam ki hakkatuv atzmo natan taam haddavar bema shekkatav ki bechozek yad, ki yesh lecha ladaat ki haadon baruch hu yesh bemiddotav shete bechinot, haachat tikkare yad haggedola, vehaachat tikkare yad hachazaka, hayyad haggedola hi tzad hachesed vehattov, vehayyad hachazaka hi haggevura hameshallemet leose raa keraato. vehinne behotzaat yisrael mimmitzrayim nata Adonai yad hachazaka vehikka sonav eser makkot, asher laze gamar omer haadon shettihye hanachat tefillin bichtivat zikkaron beyad keha shellanu shehi dugemat yad hachazaka hammotzia otanu mimmitzrayim, veze sheamar hakkatuv kan ki bechozek yad venachon. vahagam shemmatzinu sheamar beharebe peamim "yad haggedola", zo hasekamat middat harachamim lemiddat haddin, aval ikkar hammishpat yad hachazaka yitkanne.
Chassalat parashat ba

rashi: Ken dibbarta. yafe dibbarta uvizmanno dibbarta. emet shello osif od reot panecha (mechilta ushemot Rabba):
Ki yishalcha vincha machar. yesh machar shehu achshav veyesh machar shehu leachar zeman, kegon ze, uchegon "velo yomru venechem machar levanenu" (Yehoshua 22), divne gad vedivne reuven:

Ma zot. ze tinok tippesh sheeno yodea lehaamik sheelato vesotem veshoel "ma zot?", uvemakom acher hu omer "ma haedot vehachukkim vehammishpatim vegomer" (Devarim 6), hare zot sheelat ben chacham; dibbera tora keneged arbaa vanim — rasha, vesheeno yodea lishol, vehashshoel derech setuma, vehashshoel derech chachma (mechilta):
ohc: Vehaya ki yishalcha vegomer. perush, beshaa sheyyire bincha inyan pidyon bechor, im yishalcha atta chayyav lomar lo, aval belo sheela en chiyyuv ella belel pesach. velaze dikdek lomar machar, perush, afillu lemachar dehaynu kol zeman sheyyihye, veamar lemor, perush, shettihye kavvanato bashsheela shettomar elav, az hu shetteshivehu badderech haamur, aval im yomar "ma zot" bederech zilzul lo lechavvanat hatteshuva – lo teshivehu kaze.

Od yirtze sheen tzarich shettihye hashsheela belashon ze "ma zot", ella hagam shettihye beeze ofen shettihye, kol shehammechuvvan shel hashsheela hu "lemor ma zot". nimtzenu omrim ki pasuk ze shello belel pesach neemar, ella bemitzvat kedushshat peter rechem, veen tzorech behaggada zulat al yede sheela. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (mechilta) amru keneged arbaa banim vechulei, ze derech derush.

rashi: Lel shimmurim. shehaya hakkabba shomer umetzappe lo, lekayyem havetachato lehotziam meeretz mitzrayim:
Hu hallayla hazze laAdonai. hu hallayla sheamar leavraham, ballayla hazze ani goel et banecha (mechilta):
Shimmurim lechol bene yisrael ledorotam. meshummar uva min hammazzikin, kainyan shenneemar "velo yitten hammashchit vegomer" (fesachim 109):
ohc: Lel shimmurim vegomer. yechavven hakkatuv lirmoz chamishsha nissim muflaim shezzemannam layla zo: 1, bime avraham keshehikka et arbaa melachim (Bereshit 14:15) "vayyechalek alehem layla". 2, bitziat mitzrayim dichtiv (Shemot 12:29) "vayhi bachatzi hallayla". 3, bime chizkiyya keshehikka gavriel machane sancheriv dichtiv (Melachim 2 19:35) "vayhi ballayla hahu". 4, bime mardechay veester (Ester 6:1) "ballayla hahu nadda shenat hammelech". Adonai, geulla haatida.

Keneged nes avraham amar lel shimmurim hu laAdonai, ki beemtzaut hannes nitgallet amittato yitbarach, keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 42,1) sheyyesh mehaummot shello hayu maaminim benes hatztzalato meur kasdim veheeminu benes hakkaat arbaa melachim. ucheneged mitzrayim amar lehotziam meeretz mitzrayim. ucheneged nes chizkiyyahu amar hu hallayla hayyadua lachem karashum bedivre navi (Melachim 2 19,la) "vayhi ballayla hahu vayyetze malach" vegomer. ucheneged nes mardechay amar hazze laAdonai, ucheneged geulla haatida amar shimmurim lechol bene yisrael ledorotam, perusho lesof haddorot baagala uvizman kariv.

rashi: Kidvar moshe. sheamar lahem bemitzrayim, "veyishalu ish meet reehu":
Usemalot. af hen hayu chashuvot lahem min hakkesef umin hazzahav, vehameuchar bappasuk chashuv:
ohc: Asu kidvar moshe. perush, lo lahanaat hammamon ella lemitzvat navi. od yirtze al pi ma sheheela rambam beferek 9 mehilchot yesode hattora, ki im yavo navi veyomar leyisrael al pi Adonai laavor al mitzva achat horaat shaa keeliyyahu behar hakkarmel vechaddome – shomin lo chutz meavoda zara, vehu amro uvene yisrael asu. uletzad ki maase ze hu maase bilti hagun lignov daat goy, gam ligzol mamonam, veech yatzdiku yisrael laomer lahem avor avera? laze amar al pi moshe, perush, asher huvechan lenavi uvifrat ze yeamnu devarav kannizkar:

rashi: Lev yodea marat nafsho. tarcho vigio sheamal battora, lefichach besimchato lo yitarav zar kesheyyekabbel secharo leatid. davar acher: lev yodea marat nafsho yisrael shehem mare nefesh baggalut vehayu neheragim al kedushshat hashshem uvesimchato lo yitarav zar leatid. bet reshaim. bet aram yishshamed.
targum: Libba yadea meriruta denafsheh uvechedvateh la mitarav nucheraa:

rashi: Sechireha. sareha, kemo "betaar hassechira" (yeshaya 7:20):
Marbek. kofla belaaz:
Hifnu. panu oref levakkesh lanus:
targum: Af ravrevaha vegavah keigle rivka are af inun itpeniu araku kachada la yachilu lemekam are yom tevarhon ata alehon idan seudan bishtehon:

rashi: Kol yerek. ale yarok, vayradevarea belaaz:
Vehaya ki tavou el haaretz. tala hakkatuv avoda zo beviatam laaretz, velo nitchayyevu vammidbar ella pesach echad sheasu vashshana hashshenit al pi haddibbur:
Kaasher dibber. vehechan dibber? "veheveti etchem el haaretz vegomer" (Shemot 6):
ohc: Vehaya ki tavou vegomer. hinne peshat hakkatuv yaggid ki mitzva zo enah ella achar kenisatam laaretz, im ken lamma chazar Adonai middaat zo vetzivva et bene yisrael (Bamidbar 9:1) bashshana hashshenit laasot happesach bemoado kechol chukkotav?

Venire ki gilla Adonai daat elyon baze, ki haya bedato im yizku yisrael lo yaasu pesach sheni ella beeretz kenaan, ella letzad hameratam meet yatzu mimmitzrayim vehem mamrim pi Adonai, vaafillu beyam suf hitchilu lamrot, dichtiv (tehillim 106:7) "vayyamru al yam beyam suf", ze haya sibba shearchu hayyamim velo haya lahem zechut laalot techef umiyyad. velaze kesheraa Adonai sheggarmu maasehem velo nichnesu laaretz vehem adayin bammidbar, hutzrach letzauot laasot happesach bammidbar, ki ad atta lo nitztauu ella "ki tavou el haaretz". vahagam ki haadon kore haddorot merosh (Yeshayahu 41:4), af al pi chen machshevotav hattovim higgid leammo kannizkar:

rashi: Moshe veaharon asu vegomer. kevar katav lanu zot bechol hammoftim, velo shenaah kan ella bishvil lesamchah lapparasha shelleachareha:
ohc: Umoshe veaharon vegomer vaychazzek vegomer. kavvanat hakkatuv lomar shehagam sheasu et kol hammoftim haelle, af al pi chen lo nitratztza leshallecham afillu shello behechlet, ella latzet meartzo levad, keamro (Shemot 5:3) "nelcha na derech sheloshet yamim".

rashi: Holech et chachamim. yechkam, veroe chesilim hamechabber lo kesilim lihyot lo reim:
Yeroa. yerutztzatz:
targum: Dimhalech im chakkime nitchakkam vedimchabbar lesachle nivash leh:

rashi: Kartu yarah. koach yesh bahen lichrot kol yarah:
Ki lo yechaker. mispar tzevaam:
targum: Shetzu ravrevaha amar Adonai are let lehon sof are sagiin mizachala velet lehon minyan:

rashi: Veyardu chol avadecha. chalak kavod lammalchut, shehare bassof yarad paro beatzmo elav ballayla "vayyomer kumu tzeu mittoch ammi" (Shemot 12), velo amar lo moshe mittechilla veyaradta elay vehishtachavita li:
Asher beraglecha. haholchim achar atzatcha vehilluchecha:
Veachare chen etze. im kol haam meartzecha:
Vayyetze meim paro. kesheggamar devarav, yatza millefanav:
Bochori af. al sheamar lo "al tosef reot panay" (Shemot 10):
ohc: Veyardu chol avadecha vegomer. kan hivtiach ki avadav ellu yichyu velo yamut mehem echad bemakkat bechorot. veulay shehayu kullam peshutim veen bechor benehem veyada bidiat navi. o hagam shehayu benehem bechorot, af al pi chen hotziam mikkelal hammakka, vehattaam lo letzad tzidkutam ella letzad shebbizzahu paro harasha bifnehem vedibber elav kedabber hannaval "al tosef reot vegomer ki beyom" vegomer, laze tzarich gam hu lehitbazzot bifnehem kedin hamevayyesh chavero bifne rabbim shetztzarich lefayyeso bifnehem. vetimtza shehikpid moshe al haddavar, dichtiv: "vayyetze meim paro bochori af". vehinne hagam shello amar moshe ella "veyardu chol avadecha", nitkavven lomar gam alav ki hu beatzmo yakum layla, ella sheddibber derech kavod.

Vehishtachavu li lemor. taam shello amar beferush "veyomru li", nitkavven lomar ki emtzaut hahishtachavaya atzmah yaggid ki kavvanatam lemor "tze atta", kevan shehu adon alehem, im ken haadon yaase cheftzo veen alav shilton.

Od yirtze, ki leheyot ki minhag hammelachim kesheyyavo adam ledabber alehem davar yishtachavu lefanav, umizze yeda hammelech ki hem chafetzim ledabber immo, ki en mehammusar ledabber lifne melech gadol belo sheelat rishyon, gam en derech kavod lishol reshut, laze yishtachave uvaze yeda hammelech ki chafetz davar veyomar elav davar. vehu sheamar vehishtachavu li lemor, perush, shehahishtachavaya hi lehaggid sherotzim lemor, vehaamira "tze atta" vegomer. vahagam shello hizkir hakkatuv perat ze beotah hallayla, kitztzer veamar gedola mehaamur kan, shepparo atzmo kam layla vegomer:

rashi: Lezikkaron. ledorot:

Vechaggotem oto. yom shehu lecha lezikkaron atta choggo. vaadayin lo shamanu ezehu yom hazzikkaron, talo "zachor et hayyom hazze asher yetzatem" (Shemot 13), limmedanu, sheyyom hayetzia hu yom shel zikkaron. vee ze yom yatzu? talo "mimmochorat happesach yatzu" (Bamidbar 33), heve omer yom chamishsha asar benisan hu shel yom tov, shehare lel chamishsha ashar achlu et happesach velabboker yatzu (mechilta):
Ledorotechem vegomer. shomea ani miut dorot shenayim, talo "chukkat olam techagguhu" (sham):
ohc: Chukkat olam techagguhu. taam shello hispik lomar "ledorotechem", vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (mechilta) ki "dorotechem" levad hayiti omer miut rabbim shenayim, talmud lomar "chukkat olam" legallot al perush "dorotechem" shehu tamid, adayin kashe, lo haya lo lomar "ledorotechem" ella "chukkat olam". achen yitbaer al derech haomer (berachot 12:) "lemaan tizkor et yom tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim kol yeme chayyecha" lehavi limot hammashiach, uleman deamar "kol yeme chayyecha" hallelot. efshar ki amar "chukkat olam" shello tomar tenach bime hacherut, bime haggalut sheanu meshubadim ma makom lezikkaron letova sheppaska, talmud lomar "chukkat olam" afillu bizman hashshibud bishar galuyyot chukka chakak Adonai. umeemtzaut perusham ze taskil gam ken hasarat taanat "ledorotechem" sheen kavvanato shene dorot. veim lo haya omer "ledorotechem" lo hayinu shomim ma shepperashnu bechukkat olam", vehayinu omrim shello ba ella lehatemadat dorot velo lishne dorot levad hannishma mittevat "ledorotechem", umehayyittur shamanu ma shepperashnu.

rashi: Vehaya haddam lachem leot. lachem leot velo laacherim leot (sham). mikkan shello natnu haddam ella mibbifnim:
Veraiti et haddam. hakkol galuy lefanav, ella amar hakkabba, noten ani et enay lirot sheattem asukim bemitzvotay, ufoseach ani alechem (sham):

Ufasachti. vechamalti, vedome lo "pasoach vehimlit" (Yeshayahu 31). vaani omer, kol pesicha leshon dillug ukefitza. ufasachti, medalleg haya mibbatte yisrael levatte mitzriyyim, shehayu sheruyim ze betoch ze, vechen "poschim al shete hasseippim" (Melachim 1 18), vechen kol happissechim – holchim kekoftzim, vechen "pasoach vehimlit" – medallego umemalleto mibben hammumatim:

Velo yihye vachem negef. aval hve hu bammitzrim. hare shehaya mitzri beveto shel yisrael, yachol yimmalet? talo "velo yihye vachem negef", aval hove bammitzrim shebbevattechem. hare shehaya yisrael beveto shel mitzri, shomea ani yilke chemoto, talo "velo yihye vachem negef" (mechilta):
ohc: Velo yihye vegomer lemashchit. perush, lesibbat mashchit sheyyotze lehashechit bezulat, en bo ella bechinat teva hahashchata lechol zulat, birot chotam shemo yitbarach shehi hammitzva yifchad veyira miggeshet elav, laze hu shetztzivva Adonai lihyot haddam leot. veim tomar im ken mitzri shehaya nechba el bet yisrael yihye nitztzol, talmud lomar "bachem" velo bammitzrim, ki lo tair or hammitzva lehatztzala ella al yisrael, dichtiv (yeshaya 60:2) "vealayich yizrach Adonai uchevodo alayich yerae".

rashi: Vayhi mikketz sheloshim shana vegomer vayhi beetzem hayyom hazze. maggid, shekkevan shehiggia hakketz lo ikkevan hammakom keheref ayin – betv venisan bau malache hashsharet etzel avraham levassero, uvetv benisan nolad yitzchak, uvetv benisan nigzera gezerat ben habbetarim:
ohc: Vayhi mikketz vegomer. velo amar hakkatuv ma haya, veim nitkavven al hayyetzia hare chazar veamar paam sheniyya "vayhi beetzem". od tzarich ladaat ma tzaar yirmoz betevat vayhi.

Veulay ki yaggid hakkatuv hatztzaar shel ikkuvam ad hakketz, velo haya bahem zechut latzet kodem hakketz. o lirmoz ki hatztzaar shehaya leyisrael bammispar hammuzkar lemala, dichtiv: "umoshav bene yisrael" vegomer (Shemot 12:40), lo kol hazzeman hahu ella mikketz.

Vayhi beetzem. ramaz hatztzaar shel yetziat hayyotzim immahem, shemmehem savvu raot. o lirmoz ki lo chadlu hammakkot vehatztzarot mimmitzrayim gam beetzem hayyom hazze, vechen hu omer (Bamidbar 33:4) "umitzrayim mekabberim" vegomer, "uvene yisrael yotzim beyad rama" (Shemot 14:8).

rashi: Gam bischok. shehakkadosh baruch hu mesachek immahem baolam hazze, yichav libbam leatid lavo. vechen hu omer "veattem titzaku mikkeev lev" (Yeshayahu 65:14):
targum: Af beguchacha nichav libba vesofa dechedvata chamutza:

rashi: Ufasach. vechamal, veyesh lomar vedilleg:
Velo yitten hammashchit. velo yitten lo yecholet lavo, kemo "velo netano elohim lehara immadi" (Bereshit 31):
Chacham yare. min happureanut:
Vesar mera. min haraa:
Uchesil mitabber. mitchazzek laavod bechazka:

Uvoteach. umachalik venofel baaretz, kemo "beeretz shalom atta voteach" (yirmeya 12:5), vetirgem yonatan: "at mitbattach venafol" – machalik. veyesh mefarshim: bittachon mammash, behechalo; boteach lomar: lo tevoeni raa:
targum: Chakkima dachel umaste min bishta vesachla mitchalet besachluta umasbir bah:

rashi: Parsa. parsat regel, palenatea belaaz:
Lo neda ma naavod. kamma tichbad haavoda, shemma yishal yoter mimma sheyyesh beyadenu:
ohc: Vegam miknenu vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lehazekir achar shekkevar amar elav "gam atta titten"? ze yaggid shemmillevad sheyyikchu miknehem gam atta vegomer, im ken hare hizkir miknehem. vehaya nire lomar shechash sheyyavin paro ki amro "gam atta" lo yirmoz hakkodem al miknehem ella al hattaf, ki millevad sheyyelech hattaf gam tzarich hu litten vegomer, laze beer haddevarim sheal hammikne, ze dochak. od tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro ki mimmennu nikkach vegomer, ma chiddush baze? im lehodio sheovdim Adonai bizvichat tzon, halo kevar amar elav "gam atta titten beyadenu zevachim" vegomer, im ken en chiddush behodaa zo. od tzarich ladaat amro "lo neda ma naavod", ki peshat haddevarim yaggid baze hu al hashshiur sheenam yodim kamma tichbad haavoda, velaze tzerichin lemiknehem vegam hu yitten im yachpotz, im ken haya lo lomar "kamma naavod".

Achen nire ki nitkavven lishlol taana achat leval yiton otah paro, vehu ki yikchu min harauy lizboach laAdonai umin sheeno rauy yutztzag. laze amar "vegam miknenu yelech immanu" – perush afillu otam sheenam reuyim lizvicha, velaze gamar omer lo tishshaer parsa – perush, kol regel behema, uvichlal ze nichlal sus ufered gamal chamor vechulei, ki chullam yikkare lahem mikne. veamro "ki mimmennu nikkach" yitbaer al derech amram bemassechet avoda zara (24:) veze leshonam: ta shema vechulei "asher chamal haam al metav hatztzon vegomer lemaan zevoach laAdonai" vegomer, may metav? deme metav, umay shena deikputz alehem zevina, ad kan. hinne shehagam sheamar hakkatuv "lemaan zevoach laAdonai" mefaresh lah hattalmud lemaan kenot middemehen zevachim, uchemo chen yitbaer amro kan ki mimmennu nikkach – perush, hagam sheenam reuyim lizvicha af al pi chen yitztarech lanu letaam ki mimmennu – perush, middamav nikkach laavod Adonai, perush tzarche avoda, velaze lo amar "mimmennu nizbach laAdonai elohenu".

Veamro vaanachnu lo neda ma naavod. perush: veim tomar neshaer shiur hammaspik laavoda vehashshear yutztzag, laze amar "lo neda ma naavod". tevat "ma" tisbol shene inyanim velishnehem nitkavven: haechad hu kamma, vehashsheni ma hu ofen haavoda sheyyetzav hael otanu, ki efshar sheyyomar shennivne binyan lizboach bo uchele zahav en shiur vaavanim tovot umargaliyyot vaavodot acherim, vahagam sheamru "venizbecha" vegomer, hare amar od "shallach ammi veyaavduni" (Shemot 4:23) vehichnis peratim acherim bichlal ze millevad hazzevicha, beofen sheen davar ze shel hazzevicha mesuyyam sheen zulatah, asher al ken anu tzerichin lechol ma sheyyesh lanu vegam atta titten.

Veamro ad boenu shamma, nitchakkem lehashiv ki yomar elav: halo navi atta, usheal lecha davar ze meAdonai veyitbarer hainyan, veyutztzag davar sheen bo tzorech. laze amar "ad boenu shamma", perush, sheen ze mehammusar lishol et elohenu al haddavar ladaat ma yachpotz ad boenu shamma bimkom haavoda, az neda haddavar. veulay ki letzad shepparo lo hitzdik teshuva zo vechashad ki moshe arom yarim alav vedivre atzmo meshiv veen chas veshalom befihu nechona, ki min hassetam yodim gam yecholim leda, ella moshe mippi atzmo amar teshuva zo lenegdo, laze nitkaes alav veamar elav: "al tosef reot panay" vegomer.

rashi: Evilim yalitz asham. shehem chotim, shetztzerichin latet mamon lemi shechatu lo, veyalitz baadam ashamam, shehem meviim memonam lo; kemo happelishtim shenneemar "kechu lachem chamishsha techore zahav vachamishsha achbere zahav vegomer unetattem lelohe yisrael kavod ulay yakel et yado mealechem" (Shmuel 1 6:4-5):
Asham. amenda belaaz:
Uven yesharim ratzon. appeyymint belaaz, hakkadosh baruch hu merutztze lahem:
targum: Kesile matlin becheta uvenat teritze reuta:

rashi: Peti yaamin. ledivrehem venissat acharehem. davar acher: bischok yichav lev, "sechok lichsil asot zimma" (Mishlei 10:23), vesofo yichav lev. sug lev – rasha, kemo "kesef sigim" (Mishlei 26:23). sug hu shem happesolet, sug hu hakkesef hameurbav bappesolet:
Umealav ish tov. umimmaal lo larasha, yihye hatztzaddik:
Peti yaamin. leanshe rachil:
Vearum yavin laashuro. lifsiotav, kelomar: yetzappe millariv, veyamtin ad yivvada lo el nachon (Shmuel 1 26:4):
targum: Shavra meheman lechol mile vaarima mitbayen letavteh:

rashi: Umalta oto az yochal bo. rabbo, maggid shemmilat avadav meakkavto milleechol bappesach, divre rabbi yehoshua. rabbi eliezer omer, en milat avadav meakkavto milleechol bappesach, im ken ma talo az yochal bo? haeved:
Leanot. ketargumo, "leitkenaa", vehu miggizrat ani – meanta lihyot ani veshafal mippanay:

Hitallalti. sachakti, kemo "ki hitallalt bi" (Bamidbar 22), "halo kaasher hitolel bahem" (Shmuel 1 6), haamur bemitzrayim, veeno leshon poel umaalalim, sheim ken haya lo lichtov olalti, kemo "veolel lamo kaasher olalta li" (Eicha 1), "asher olal li" (sham):
ohc: Ulemaan tesapper vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan hutzrach letaam ze, velo hispik battaam harishon she chafetz lehasim otot elle kemo shepperashti besamuch. od, ma hu "et asher hitallalti bemitzrayim", uma hu "veet ototay" shennire shehem shene devarim. od tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro vidatem vegomer:

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu ki ba Adonai lehodia ki en tachlit hakkavvana bahavaat haotot bekirbo laasot nekama befaro, ella lechazzek haotot shebbahem ikkar haemuna belev yisrael, kede sheyyihye rashum bal yishshachach lanetzach, ki kesheyyihye bekirbo shel paro yihye bezichron bene yisrael leolam vaed. vehakkavvana al derech amram zichronam livracha bemassechet chullin (chullin 75:) bedin ben pekua, kol sheyyihyu bo shene devarim hammuflaim yihye muzekar tamid, uchesheyyiru sheochlo belo shechita lo yachsheduhu ki muzekar hu benehem, ki tere temihe midkar dechire inshe. vehinne beemtzaut happele sheyyafli Adonai lehodiam ki hu sholet baruach uvammayim uveafar uvevaale chayyim uvaesh uvaavir vechaddome, en ze maspik sheyyizzacher haddavar bitmidut leolam lachkok haemuna, ella beemtzaut heyot hafelaa sheniyya, ki yafli Adonai lehara et paro vaavadav lehashekotam kosot laana ma shello haya chen lechol goy. veze lecha neimut imre noam "ulemaan tesapper beazne vincha" inyan ze, vehassippur min hannimna sheyyihye haddavar tamid bezichroncha zulat beemtzaut shete temihot: haachat et asher hitallalti bemitzrayim hare temiha achat, hagam shehaya Adonai ose lahem tzarot sheen bahem shiddud hammaarachot vehattiviyyot, af al pi chen letzad rov hatztzarot vehammakkot eser makkot, vechol makka hayta shel arba vechamesh makkot, lo asa chen lechol goy, hinne haddavar tamuah, utemiha zo levad lo dechire inshe velo yesapperu maase Adonai. veamar veet ototay, perush, haotot sheasa Adonai temiha sheniyya, sheggam belo inyan mitzrayim haot meatzmo hu devar pele, uveemtzaut shete pelaot "tesapper beazne vincha uven bincha" vegomer. vetachlit hamechuvvan bassippur hu "vidatem ki ani Adonai" veen od, vetachzivu haemunot zulat ze. vechen timtza kesheddibber ittanu Adonai baruch hu behar sinay petach devarav yitbarach amar "anochi Adonai elohecha", veze lecha haot, "asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim", vehu shehikdim devarav kan veamar "vidatem ki ani Adonai", ki yakkiru baze bechush harut tzedek haemuna ma shello hissig adam mehaolam ad haolam, baruch asher ken asa lanu.

rashi: Mikra kodesh. mikra shem davar; kera oto kodesh laachila ushetiyya uchesut (mechilta):
Lo yease vahem. afillu al yede acherim (sham):
Hu levaddo. "hu" velo machshirav sheefshar laasotan meerev yom tov (betza 28):
Lechol nefesh. afillu livhema; yachol af laggoyim, talmud lomar lachem (mechilta):

ohc: Vayhi beetzem vegomer. hodia haddavar besamuch laasiyyat pesach, lomar ki ze gorem gemar hayyetzia, ki zulat ze lo haya beyadam mitzvot latzet, keamram zichronam livracha (Yechezkel 16:6) befasuk "vaeevor alayich" vegomer:

rashi: Veatta al tira. tzaddikim shebbetoch mitzrayim, sheggalu sham al karcham:
targum: Veat la tidchal avdi yaakov vela tittevar yisrael are ha ana perik lich merachik veyat benach meara galutehon vituvun devet yaakov veyishketun veyishrun lerochatzan velet demanid:

rashi: Ad bechor hashshevi. lamma laku hashshevuyim? kede shello yomru, yiratam tava elbonam vehevia puranut al mitzrayim:

Mibbechor paro ad bechor hashshifcha. kol happechutim mibbechor paro vachashuvim mibbechor hashshifcha hayu bichlal; velamma laku bene hashshefachot? sheaf hem hayu meshabedim bahem usemechim betzaratam:
Vechol bechor behema. lefi shehayu ovdin lah. keshehakkabba nifra min haumma, nifra meeloheha:
ohc: Umet kol bechor. velo amar "veharagti kol" vegomer, leheyot ki Adonai baruch hu poel hattov beyado, aval peullat hara yetzav limshartav ose devaro vehem yaasu, laze lo amar "veharagti" ella "umet", perush, al yede shaliach. umaase Adonai, hemma hazekarat hodaat habbechorot ze hu, veze gorem ki hammashchit yashchitennu umet, umizze yitgalle perush amro "vehikketi" shehu al yede shaliach.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat lod,1) yahav beh eneh vekatleh, gam amru venaasa gal shel atzamot. vehinne devarim ellu behashekafa rishona yerachakem hassechel, ki ech tihye reiyyat tzaddik leraa, vahalo ketiv (Mishlei 22:9) "tov ayin hu yevorach", gam tziyyen rabbi shimon ben yochay zichrono livracha (zohar 11 211,1) lera ayin hammazzik beeno ki hu chelek ra. achen achar hahashkafa bedikduk amram "yahiv eneh", haya lo lomar "raa bo beenav", ella leheyot ki chol chelek ra shebbaolam behechreach ki yihye lo davar hammaamid kol shehu mehachiyyuni shehu bechinat hattov, ki chelek hara shem mita yesh lo veech yichye veyihye bammetziut, veen tzarich lomar sheyyitnoea veyelech kevaale chayyim. laze behechreach sheyyihye bo chelek kol shehu mibbechina hannikret chayyim veze chelek tov. uvaze taskil lehavin maamaram zichronam livracha (socha nov,1) ki leatid lavo yavi hakkadosh baruch hu lesml veyishchatehu bemaamad hatztzaddikim vechulei ad kan. udevarim ellu en lahem mashmaut ki lo yutzdak shechita lemalach, ulema shehikdamnu tihye hakkavvana ki yasir mimmennu chelek hamechayyehu, uvahasarat mimmennu chelek hattov zo hi shechitato.

Od yesh lecha ladaat ki kol makor yishaf lemino veyishavennu, veze hu sod bechinat berure nitzotze hakkedushsha beemtzaut nishmot yisrael veesek toratam, vehatztzaddikim haatzumim kadmonenu yakkiru behabbitam beadam rasha levarer mimmennu koach hachiyyuni shehu bechinat hattov beemtzaut hariyya haddakka asher yabbitu been hachachma lehotzi chelek hattov hahu, ki kesheyyitkavven lemul anaf hakkedushsha taase bo nefesh hatztzaddik kemaase even hashshoevet labbarzel hannikret 260 belaaz shettotziennu mimmakom shennikba sham biriyya, vaAdonai asa dimyonot baolam lehaamin adam betorat chacham. umeatta nimtza daat elohim beamro "umet kol bechor", perush ki beemtzaut sheani over betoch mitzrayim baze yamut meatzmo kol bechor, kintinat ayin shel chachamim barshaim veosim otam gal shel atzamot, ki beemtzaut ken yetze mehem hachiyyuniyyut, kemo chen haddavar hazze sheyyafrid mehem beemtzaut haavarato sham kol nishmot habbechorot, vehaven haddevarim.

Veamro kol bechor, perush, lo shettetze hannefesh mehagguf levad, ella sheggam bechinat nefesh tamut – guf venefesh shel kelippat bechor mitzrayim. veulay ki baze lo nitatztzem shum galut od kivchinat galut veshibud mitzrayim, ki avad koach hakkelippa heatzum shehu bechinat bechor:

Veraiti latet taam lamma lo yatzu yisrael ella beemtzaut makkat bechorot. od lamma Adonai hikka afilu bechor sheeno mitzri, dichtiv (Shemot 12:29) "bechor hashshevi". veulay ki hattaam hu letzad shemmatzinu shekkara Adonai leyisrael (Shemot 4:22) "beni vechori", uchevar hodiunu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (zohar chelek 2 263) ki chol ma shebbara Adonai bemiddat hattov gam ze leummat ze asa haelohim bivchinat hara, vechol bechina uvechina sheyyesh bakkedushsha yesh kenegdah bakkelippa, vehakkelippa mitammetzet umitchazzeket leechoz bah. velaze keneged bechinat habbechora shebbakkedushsha hayta bechinat bechora shebbakkelippa ochezet vetokefet bah leval shallach, ad asher harag Adonai kol shem habbechora shebbiklippat mitzrayim, ben shel mitzrayim ben shel haummot shehayu sham, dichtiv "ad bechor hashshevi" uvechor hashshifcha" "vechl bechor behema". vegam bechor yisrael kiddesh otam Adonai keamro (Bamidbar 8:17) "kol bechor vegomer hikdashti otam li", kede shello tishshaer bechora zulat shel kodesh asher hikdish Adonai. velaze met afilu bechor behema, vechevan shenneekar shem ze nafal anaf hara shehaya machzik bivchor hakkedushsha, velaze techef yatzu bene yisrael. vahagam shemmatzinu sheyyatzu veradfu acharehem, chashvu sheadayin yesh bahem koach leechoz bam, vetze ulemad ma alta beyadam – lo notar bahem ad echad.

rashi: Lo chen. kaasher amartem leholich hattaf immachem, ella lechu haggevarim veivdu et Adonai:
Ki otah attem mevakshim. ki otah bikkashtem ad henna – nizbecha lelohenu, veen derech hattaf lizboach:
Vaygaresh otam. hare ze lashon katzar velo peresh mi hamegaresh:
Velakchu min haddam. zo kabbalat haddam, yachol bayyad? talo asher bassaf (mechilta):
Hammezuzot. hem hazzekufot achat mikkan lappetach veachat mikkan:
Hammashkof. haelyon shehaddelet shokef alav keshessogrin oto, 139 belaaz; uleshon shekifa chavata, kemo "kol ale niddaf" (Vayikra 26) – deshakif, chabbura – mashkofe:
Al habbattim asher yochlu oto bahem. velo al mashkof umezuzot shebbevet hatteven uvet habbakar, sheen darin betocho (70 mechilta):
Lech minneged leish kesil. mehitchabber tamid etzlo:
Uval yadata. sofcha shello yadata chachma:
targum: Ezel bearcha acharita min kodam sichla delet besifvateh yediata:

rashi: Dabberu el kol adat. vechi aharon medabber? vahalo kevar neemar atta tedabber? ella cholkin kavod ze laze, veomrim ze laze lammedeni, vehaddibbur yotze mibben shenehem keillu shenehem medabberim (mechilta):
Dabberu el kol adat yisrael lemor beasor lachodesh. dabberu hayyom, berosh chodesh sheyyikkachuhu beasor lachodesh:
Hazze. pesach mitzrayim mikcho veasor, velo pesach dorot (fesachim 96):
Se labbayit avot. lemishpacha achat; hare shehayu merubbin, yachol se echad lechullan? talo "se labbayit" (mechilta):
ohc: Dabberu vegomer lemor. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar "dabberu" velo samach al ma sheamar befasuk rishon "vayyomer Adonai vegomer lemor", veim lo hispik lo tevat "lemor" haya lo lomar "dabberu" kodem amro "hachodesh hazze", ki mitzva zo leyisrael ledorotam nittena, velamma lo amar kodem lah "dabberu". od kashe amro tevat lemor ki lemi yomru yisrael?

Veulay ki letzad shebbemitzva zo shel lekichat hasse yesh bah shete bechinot: achat letova, ki vah nasu rosh verau otam oyvehem osim belohehem shefatim, keamram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 16,3), vehashsheniyya letzad hammitzva ki mitzvat hammelech hi laasot ken, vehaover alav anosh yeanesh. laze hutzrach lomar dabberu vegomer lemor, "dabberu" leshon koshi, keneged tzorech haddavar ugezerat melech ulehaanish al kol over, velemor" amira rakka, keneged maala vechavod asher tassigem baddavar. uletzad shebbammitzva shetztzivva bitchillat hannevua, shehi lachshov minnisan, en onesh laover al ze keonesh hachodel measot happesach, velaze lo amar kenegdah ella "lemor", asher al ken hutzrach lachzor velomar "dabberu" keneged mitzvat pesach, veamar od "lemor" ki gam bah yesh maala leyisrael kannizkar. uvederech derash tzivvam lehanehig et yisrael behanehagat hattora vehammitzvot, lehodiam chukke Adonai vetorotav ulehanhigam bederech yeshara, velaze amar "dabberu" veamar "lemor", perush kede sheyyihyu meullim, al derech amro (Yeshayahu 3:10): "imru tzaddik" vegomer.

Od yirtze, ki mittechilla yedabber el hazzekenim kemo shemmatzinu lo shekken asa moshe, dichtiv (Shemot 12:21) "vayyikra moshe lechol zikne yisrael", vehu amro dabberu el kol adat yisrael lemor sheyyomar lehaam, vehu gam ken ma sheamar sham hakkatuv "vayyomer alehem".

Veyikchu lahem vegomer. kashe lamma amar 6 bitchillat inyan? veulay ki ramaz laddevarim hanneemarim bedivre moshe leyisrael, dichtiv "mishchu ukechu" vegomer, veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 16,2) "mishchu yedechem meavoda zara" vegomer, vedavar ze lo neemar bedivre Adonai, vehinne middivre moshe nishma ki chen neemar lo binvua, vehu amro "veyikchu" betosefet 6 remez shekkadam dibbur, uma hu "mishchu" sheamar moshe.

Od yirtze, leheyot sheamar "beasor" – yachol lakach beasor yishchat, lo lakach beasor lo yikkach bey beyv beyg, talmud lomar "veyikchu" lerabbot achar kach. uvammechilta (Shemot 12:3) lamdu din ze shel lekicha bey beyv beyg middin kal vachomer, vedavar habba bekal vachomer im nimtza lo remez bakkatuv naskim lomar ki laze nitkavven.

Od yirmoz bedakdek od tevat "lahem". od amro tevat ish shello haya tzarich lomar ella "veyikchu se levet" vegomer. achen yirtze al derech amram zichrono livracha (tanchuma) befasuk "veyikchu li teruma" veze leshono: amar hakkadosh baruch hu kechu oti immachem, vehu amro kan letzad ki zo mitzva rishona hodiam hassagat hammitzva ki baasotah yashre alav Adonai shechinato besod (Devarim 28:10) "verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha". gam amru ki tevat "mitzva" yesh bah shem havaya chatzi beat bash vachatzi befashut (Tikkunei Zohar tikun 29), vehu amro veyikchu lahem ish perush al derech amram zichrono livracha (sota 42:) "ish" – en ish ella hakkadosh baruch hu, ki bemitzva zo yikchu lahem lekicha gedola vaatzuma vehu ish shehu elohenu malkenu.

Veraiti latet lev lamma lo tzivva Adonai befesach mitzrayim al hattemeim vehaarelim uvene hannechar shello yochlu mippesach. hen emet ki azharat hattemeim, lefi ma shekkatavnu befarashat "zot chukkat hattora" (Bamidbar 19:2), yesh taam nachon baddavar, aval haarelim uvene hannechar lamma lo tzivva otam Adonai. vehinne lefi divrehem zichronam livracha huzeharu yisrael al shenehem, al hammila kaamur bedivre kabbala (Yechezkel 16:6) "vaerech mitboseset bedamayich", veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 19:6) dam pesach vedam mila, veal ben nechar darshu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 16) befasuk "mishchu" vegomer – mishchu yedechem meavoda zara, hare shehizhir al haddavar ki kodem mitzvat happesach yetzu mikkelal ovde avoda zara veyikkansu bichlal yisrael. vechol ze eno maspik lekusheyatenu ki lamma lo bau haddevarim bedivre Adonai beikkar hammitzva.

Vehinne besof happarasha, achar shessidder yetziat yisrael mimmitzrayim, neemra parashat "zot chukkat happasach" vegomer, "kol ben nechar" vegomer, "vechol eved" vegomer. veraiti lerabbi avraham ben ezra zichrono livracha shekkatav ki parasha zo neemra lefesach dorot vehosif mitzvot acherot vechulei, veim nitkavven lomar ki ben nechar vearel hem mitzvot musafot befesach dorot, devarav kan betelim hem kefi divre rabbotenu zichronam livracha, vegam mimma sheggamar omer hakkatuv sham befarashat arel uven nechar veamar (Shemot 12:50) "vayyaasu vene yisrael kaasher" vegomer, veim lefesach dorot neemra parasha zo lo haya lo lomar "vayyaasu vene yisrael kaasher tzivva" vegomer shemmashma sheasu yisrael kol haamur bapparasha. gam ma sheamar sheyyechavven al pesach sheasu bemidbar sinay hem devarim bealma, umi yishma elav veen tzarich lomar lekabbel devarav baze, hagam sheharav zichrono livracha chash lekimcheh veeno cholek al divre rabbotenu ella bedavar sheen bo horaa leatid, af al pi chen gam bema shellefanenu cholek belo omek hammachriach vechayyotze bo.

Veraiti lerabbotenu zichronam livracha bammechilta sheamru, veze leshonam: "zot chukkat happasach" (Shemot 12:43) – befesach mitzrayim uvefesach dorot hakkatuv medabber, divre rabbi yoshiyya. rabbi yonatan omer: befesach mitzrayim hakkatuv medabber. en li ella pesach mitzrayim, pesach dorot minnayin? talmud lomar "kechol chukkotav vegomer yaasu oto" (Bamidbar 9:3) al karcham. hare dilchol daat hattannaim befesach mitzrayim hakkatuv medabber, veneekru divre rabbi avraham ben ezra vehayu kelo hayu.

Ulefi ze efshar sheyyirmoz hakkatuv beamro veyikchu, perush, millevad mitzvat mila umitzvat meshichatam meavoda zara shehu bechinat ben nechar shetztzivva Adonai, hosif od lomar "veyikchu" vegomer. veamro lahem kan ramaz shelilat ben nechar vearel shello yuchelu leechol befesach, kemo shebba haddavar mevoar binvuat "zot chukkat happasach" (Shemot 12:43).

rashi: Veavarti. kemelech haover mimmakom lemakom (mechilta), uvehaavara achat uverega echad kullan lokim:
Chol bechor beeretz mitzrayim. af bechorot acherim vehem bemitzrayim. uminnayin af bechore mitzrayim shebbimkomot acherim? talo "lemakke mitzrayim bivchorehem" (tehillim 136):
Meadam vead behema. mi shehitchil baavera mimmennu matchelet happuranut (mechilta):
Uvechol elohe mitzrayim. shel etz nirkevet veshel mattechet nimset venittechet laaretz (sham):
Eese shefatim ani Adonai. ani veatzmi, velo al yede shaliach:
Egla yefe-fiyya. "malchuta yayay" (targum yonatan):
Keretz. "ammemin ketulin" (targum yonatan); keretz leshon chittuch, vechen "mechomer koratzti" (Iyov 33:6):
Mitztzafon. mibbavel:
targum: Malchut yaaya havat mitzrayim ammin ketolin mitzippuna yetun alah lemivzah:

rashi: Karu sham. bammilchama hichrizu mashal shel cherpa:
Paro melech mitzrayim shaon. shehaya magbiah kol shaono teshuot, lehithallel bechelotav:
Heevir hammoed. sheyyied hayyom milchama kavua latzet ulehillachem velo yatza, veavar yom zeman hammoed (moed katan 16.):
targum: Zaminu letaman paro malka demitzrayim desagiin itregusheteh made zimnaya:

rashi: Kolah kannachash yelech. hare hannachash ba lelammed al mitzrayim venimtza lamed: lamadnu mikkan, shekkesheamar hakkadosh baruch hu lannachash "al gechoncha telech" (Bereshit 3:14), vekittea et raglav vehalach kolo besof haolam; kach shenuya bishloshim ushetayim middot derabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili (miyyadah 12):
Ki vechayil yelechu. eleha:
targum: Kal nikush zeyanehon kechevan zachalin are vemashiryan yehachun alechon uchema dealin bechashilin lemekatz ae churesha:

rashi: Vehannotar mimmennu ad boker. ma talo ad boker paam sheniyya? litten boker al boker, shehabboker mashmao mishsheat hanetz hachamma, uva hakkatuv lehakedim sheasur baachila mealot hashshachar, zehu lefi mashmao. veod midrash acher, limmed sheeno nisraf beyom tov ella mimmochorat, vechach tidreshennu: vehannotar mimmennu bevoker rishon, ad boker sheni taamod vetisrefennu (mechilta):
Asher yashvu bemitzrayim. achar shear hayeshivot sheyyashvu gerim beeretz lo lahem:
