Sheloshim shana vearba meot shana. ben hakkol, mishshennolad yitzchak ad achshav, hayu arba meot, mishshehaya lo zera leavraham nitkayyem ki ger yihye zaracha, usheloshim shana hayu mishennigzera gezerat ben habbetarim ad shennolad yitzchak; vei efshar lomar beeretz mitzrayim levaddah, shehare kehat min habbaim im yaakov haya, tze vachashov kol shenotav vechol shenot amram beno ushemonim shel moshe, lo timtzaem kol kach, veal karchacha harebe shanim hayu likhat ad shello yarad lemitzrayim, veharebe mishshenot amram nivlaim bishnot kehat, veharebe mishshemonim shel moshe nivlaim bishnot amram, hare shello timtza arba meot leviat mitzrayim, vehuzkakta lomar al karchacha, sheaf shear hayeshivot nikreu gerut vaafillu vechevron shenneemar "asher gar sham avraham veyitzchak" (Bereshit 35), veomer "et eretz megurehem asher garu vah" (Shemot 6), lefichach atta tzarich lomar "ki ger yihye zaracha" mishshehaya lo zera, ucheshettimne 400 shana mishshennolad yitzchak, timtza mibbiatan lemitzrayim ad yetziatan 210, veze echad min haddevarim sheshshinnu letalmay hammelech (Megila 9):
Lavo nevuchadretztzar. zo makka sheniyya, shehecheriv nevuchadnetztzar et mitzrayim bishnat esrim vesheva lemalcho (Yechezkel 29:17), kemo sheshshaninu beseder olam (seder olam Rabba 26):
targum: Pitgam nevua demalel Adonai im yirmeya neviya lemete nevuchadretzar malka devavel lemimche yat ara demitzrayim:

rashi: Vehaavarta. en vehaavarta ella leshon haferasha, vechen hu omer "vehaavarta et nachalato levitto" (Bamidbar 27) (mechilta):

Sheger behema. nefel sheshshiggerattu immo veshillechattu belo itto; velimmedcha hakkatuv shehu kadosh bivchora liftor et habba acharav veaf sheen nefel karuy sheger, kemo "shegar alafecha" (Devarim 7), aval ze lo va ella lelammed al hannefel shehare chevar katav kol peter rechem. veitto af bechor behema temea bemashma, ba uferesh bemakom acher "bivkarcha uvetzoncha" (Devarim 15). lashon acher yesh lefaresh, "vehaavarta chol peter rechem" — bivchor adam hakkatuv medabber:
Hammisgav. shem makom:
targum: Lemoav kidnan amar Adonai tzevaot elaha deyisrael vay al nevo are itbezizat behitat itkevishat kiryatayim behitu mibbet rochatzanhon veittevaru:

rashi: Baavur ze. baavur sheakayyem mitzvotav, kegon pesach matztza umaror hallalu:
Asa Adonai li. ramaz teshuva leven rasha, lomar asa Adonai li, velo lecha, sheillu hayita sham lo hayita cheday liggael (mechilta):
ohc: Vehiggadta levincha vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma lo amar "veamarta", ki tevat haggada matzinu lerabbotenu zichronam livracha sheamru (shabbat paz,1) sheyyitkavven bah devarim kashim kegidim. od kashe amro bayyom hahu, uvesamuch gamar omer "baavur ze", vedarshu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (mechilta ba parasha 17 vabehagedah) beshaa shemmatztza umaror vegomer, vehu ballayla velo bayyom, veim ken lo haya lo lomar ella "vehiggadta levincha lemor baavur ze", vaani yodea zeman hahaggada shehu ballayla. od tzarich ladaat amro lemor, vehu kevar amar "vehiggadta".

Venire ki yechavven al derech amram zichrono livracha (fesachim 116:) matchil bignut umesayyem bishvach. yomar genut avotehem shel haavot ki lo haya davar meshubbach, vehu amro vehiggadta devarim kashim shellev haadam nekash mehem, veachar kach mesayyem bishvach, vehu amro lemor amirot meshubbachot mesammechim et hallev umesaadim oto. veamar bayyom hahu hodia bemetek leshon tzaddik ki hallayla hahu yom yikkare lo layla, vehu amro (tehillim 139:12) "velayla kayyom yair", velo chash shettite lomar yom mammash mimma sheggamar omer "baavur ze" shehu bishat matztza vechulei keamram zichrono livracha. veulay ki samach "bayyom hahu" im "vehiggadta" ki gam nes ze bichlal mitzvat hahaggada.

Od yirtze beamro lemor, leheyot sheamar "vehiggadta levincha", tenach im yesh lo ben, im en lo ben yihye patur? talmud lomar "lemor", sheal kol panim tzarich lehaggid afillu beno leven atzmo. veim tomar, kevan sheal kol panim hu tzarich lehaggid afillu beno leven atzmo, im ken lamma amar "levincha"? veulay shebbeemtzaut hayyittur ani mevin ken velo belo yittur. veefshar od sheyyirmoz beamro vehiggadta levincha, sheim yaggid haggada haamura bainyan yezakkehu Adonai sheyyaggid livno, uchede shello tite lomar davka, laze amar "lemor".

Baavur ze. ulay sheramaz betevat "ze" shetem esre mitzvot harshumim bechag happesach: shelosha devarim – pesach, matztza umaror, vehaggada, veshivat yeme hechag, vekiddush yom rishon vesheni, hare shetem esre kemispar "ze", vehu amro baavur ze asa vegomer, vahagam sheshshivat yeme hechag leinyan 613 mitzvot enam nimnim lesheva mitzvot.

rashi: Lo yecheratz kelev leshono. omer ani shehu leshon shinnun – lo yeshannen, vechen "lo charatz livne yisrael leish et leshono" (Yehoshua 10) – lo shinnen, "az techeratz" (Shmuel 2 Adonai:24) – tishtannen, "lemorag charutz" (Yeshayahu 41) – shanun, "machshevot charutz" (Mishlei 21) – adam charif veshanun, "veyad charutzim taashir" (sham 10) – charifim, socharim shenunim:
Asher yafle. yavdil:
ohc: Ulechol bene yisrael vegomer. tzarich ladaat hakkavvana baze, veim lomar shello yamut adam mehem, haya lo lomar beferush "velo yamut mibbene yisrael" vegomer.

Veulay shennitkavven beseder haddibbur al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava kamma 60:): kelavim tzoakim malach hammavet bair, laze amar ulechol bene yisrael vegomer, kede shetteda shello yamut mehem adam, shello yecheratz kelev leshono sham. ha lamadta shello nira benehem mechabbel, vehu amro lemaan tedun asher yafle:

Od nitkavven lirmoz lo ki davka bemakom sheyyihyu kol bene yisrael, perush, kullam yachad yihyu yisrael, "lo yecheratz kelev" vegomer, ze lecha haot ki en zar ittam, aval im lo yihyu kullam bene yisrael veyihye benehem ish mitzri, yecheratz kelev leshono. ha lamadta ki yerae sham mashchit. vehakkavvana baze lomar lo ki lo toil arma labbechorot lehimmalet, shehagam sheyyitchabbeu habbechorot hammitzrim ben yisrael lo yimmaltu beemtzaut ze, vechen amru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 18,2).

rashi: Ki chetavor beharim. ki kaasher devar emet hu shettavor kavua beharim vehar hakkarmel al hayyam, ken beemet yavo haddavar hazze al mitzrayim (mechilta yitro bachodesh 5):
targum: Keyam ana amar malka Adonai tzevaot shemeh are kema deyatziv pitgama detavor beturaya uchecharmela beyama ken yete tevireh:

rashi: Shivat yamim. 380 shel yamim:

Shivat yamim matztzot tochelu. uvemakom acher hu omer "sheshet yamim tochal matztzot" (Devarim 16) limmed al shevii shel pesach sheeno chova leechol matztza, uvilvad shello yochal chametz; minnayin af shishsha reshut? talo "sheshet yamim". zo midda vattora, davar shehaya bichlal veyatza min hakkelal lelammed, lo lelammed al atzmo bilvad yatza, ella lelammed al hakkelal kullo yatza, ma shevii reshut af shishsha reshut; yachol af hallayla harishon reshut, talo "baerev tochlu matztzot" – hakkatuv kevao chova (fesachim 120):

Ach bayyom harishon tashbitu seor. meerev yom tov, vekaruy rishon lefi shehu lifne hashshiva; umatzinu mukdam karuy rishon, "hariyshon adam tivvaled" (Iyov 15) – halifne adam noladta; o eno ella rishon shel shiva? talo "lo tishchat al chametz vegomer" (Shemot 34) – lo tishchat happesach vaadayin chametz kayyam (fesachim Adonai):
Hannefesh hahiv. keshehi venafshah uvedatah – perat leanus (mechilta):
Miyyisrael. shomea ani tikkaret miyyisrael vetelech lah leam acher, talo bemakom acher "millefanay" (Vayikra 22) – bechol makom shehu reshuti:
ohc: Shivat yamim. hinne hattaam hu letzad shello hispik betzekam lehachemitz ugealam haggoel. veim tomar, vahalo hayyotzim adayin lo yatzu laasot zikkaron laddavar? halo gam happesach shetztzivva Adonai lakachat se levet avot vegomer adayin lo pasach, ella shebbizchut mitzva zo yifsach Adonai, gam hammatztza bizchut mitzva zo yemaher legoolam, vechen haya:

Vetimtza sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (fesachim 120.) midderashot hattora beachat mishlosh esre middot, ki chol shiva en chiyyuv bematztza ella layla harishona kevao hakkatuv chova, vehattaam ki gam bechinat hammitzva lo haya ella belel chamishsha asar, veze nikba lechova bazzeman atzmo, umeaz vahala en kiuun bannes lammitzva, vehaven. vetaam amro "shivat yamim matztzot" eno ella reshut. veulay sheddibber beseder ze lomar ki maale alav hakkatuv keillu achal kol shiva.
Vetimtza ki tzivva Adonai shene mikrae kodesh – bayyom harishon uvayyom hashshevii, yom rishon letzad nes yom chamishsha asar, veyom shevii letzad nes gemar haggeula shel keriat yam suf vechulei.

Od taam amro shivat, letzad shello tzivva Adonai bechol shiva lav delo tochal chametz, vehayiti omer im lo achal chametz en beyado lo zechut velo onesh. talmud lomar "shivat yamim tochal matztzot", lomar lecha ki keshello achal chametz keillu achal matztzot, vahare beyado sheva mitzvot ase.
Vetaam shiva velo pachot velo yoter, nitkavven Adonai sheyyihyu asukim bemitzvot ad gemar haggeulla shehu beyom shevii shel pesach asher hifli Adonai asot nissim lahem uverodfehem mishpatim.
Gam yesh taam baruchaniyyut, ki yesode hakkedushsha shehem shoresh nishmot yisrael shiva enayim (Zecharya 3:9), vetikkare keneset yisrael bat sheva lesibba zo (zohar chelek 3 6:).

rashi: Veruach hakkadim. ruach mizrachit nasa et haarbe, lefi shebba kenegdo, shemmitzrayim bidromit maaravit hayta, kemo shemmeforash bemakom acher:
Chattaim teraddef raa. adam rasha, rishato rodafto ad hishshamdo:
targum: Lechatae tirdaf bishta vetzadike yishtalmun tavta:

rashi: Holech beyashro yere. mi shehu yere Adonai, umi shehu neloz derachim, kelomar: okem derachav:
Bozehu. lehakkadosh baruch hu:
targum: Dimhalech bitritzuta dachel min kodam elaha vedaashik beorchateh shaat leh:

rashi: Miyyamim yamima. mishshana leshana (sham):
Cheshbon. umadmen – shem makom. ulefi shemotam hu mazkir puranutam:
Tiddommi. techeravi:
targum: Let od tushebcha lemoav becheshbon chashivu alah bisha ato uneshetzina milmeheve ama af madman tittabbarin batrach yehachun ketole charba:

rashi: Nischaf. nishtefu vehecheliku gibborecha, kemo "matar sochef" (Mishlei 28:3), nistachafa sadehu bilshon mishna (chetubbot 7,8). umenachem chibbero leshon killayon, vechen chibber "matar sochef". vedonash patar "matar sochef" kemo matar soef, kemo "mesaef pura bemaaratza" (Yeshayahu 10:33):
targum: Ma den ittevaru gibbarach vela yechilu lemekam are Adonai tavrinun:

rashi: Machmetzet lo tochelu. azhara al achilat seor:
Kol machmetzet. lehavi et taaravto:
Bechol moshvotechem tochelu matztzot. ze va lelammed shettehe reuya leheachel bechol moshvotechem, perat lemaaser sheni vechallot toda (mechilta):
Et en haaretz. et mare haaretz:
Velo yuchal. haroe lirot et haaretz, velashon ketzara dibber:

Veim yimat habbayit mihyot misse. veim yihyu muatim mihyot misse echad, sheen yecholin leachlo veyavo lide notar: velakach hu ushecheno vegomer. zehu mashmao lefi feshuto. veod yesh bo midrash: lelammed, sheachar shennimnu alav, yecholin lehitmaet velimshoch yedehem hemennu ulehimmanot al se acher; ach im bau limshoch yedehem ulehitmaet, mihyot misse, yitmaatu beod hasse kayyam, bihyoto vachayyim velo mishshennishchat (fesachim 89):
Bemichsat. cheshbon, vechen "michsat haerkecha" (Vayikra 27):
Lefi ochlo. harauy laachila, perat lechole ulezaken sheeno yachol leechol kazzayit (mechilta):
Tachossu. "titmenun":
ohc: Veim yimat vegomer. hakkatuv yityashshev ben ledaat rabbi yehuda uven ledaat rabbi yose, shennechleku betorat kohanim (mechilta; fesachim 99,1). lerabbi yehuda sheamar tzarich sheyyishshaer echad mibbene chavura rishona, yeduyyak amro yimat habbayit, perush sheyyitmaet mehachavura velo kol hachavura. ulerabbi yose sheamar shello yannichu happesach kemot shehu, yeduyyak amro mihyot misse, shemmeat se yitmaet mimmenuyim vealav hu hahakpada shello yishshaer belo menuyim, vehakkatuv shakul hu.
Od nire sheyyechavven lomar, sheen derech sheyyihye hasse muat leochlav, ki kazzayit basar yimmatze bo lerabbim sheyyihyu bachavura.
O yirtze, ki birkat hakkodesh merubba hi, veyimmatze bo shiur hatztzarich limnuyav, velo yimmatze hammiut ella babbayit shehem bene chavura shello yaspiku leochlo.

Lefi achlo tachossu. yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (fesachim pach.) shochet adam al yede beno uvitto hakketannim vegam al yede ishto, gam amru (fesachim paz:) im hi lemuda lavo etzel aviha ochelet mishshel aviha letzad heyotah regila leechol sham, vehu amro ish lefi achlo, perush al otam shehem regilim lavo etzlo leechol vesomchim al shulchano lefi ma shehem yimmane immo vesham kanu mekomam.

Od yitbaer al derech amram (fesachim 90,1) sheonen shochatin alav, hagam shebbishat shechita eno rauy, kevan sheyyachol leechol ballayla shochatin alav, vehu amro lefi achlo, perush holchin venimnin bishat shechita al sheat achila.

Od yirtze lefi achlo, al pi ma sheshshaninu bifsachim (fesachim tze,1) zav vechulei shochatin alav, vegam amrinan hatam shochatin vezorkin al tevul yom umechussar kippurim, veulla amar af al teme sheretz ad kan. vehattaam hu kol sheyyachol leechol et pischo beet achilato, vehu amro lefi achlo, perush en holchim bo ella lefi achilato shel pesach, vechol shebbishat achilato hu rauy leachlo, hagam shebbishat shechita lo haya rauy, shochatin alav. ulefi ze hu haddin teme met im haya yom shevii shello chal beyom arbaa asar, shochatin alav veochel laerev.

Uma sheamru sham betorat kohanim vehuva bifsachim daf 90,1 sevarat tanna shessover ki "velo yachlu laasot happesach bayyom hahu" (Bamidbar 9:6) yom shevii shellahem haya, veaf al pi chen nidchu lefesach sheni, davka tumat met dachamira, velaze amar (sham) "lenefesh adam", hagam shelaerev hayu tehorim. ulerabbi yose haggelili (sham) nuchal lomar sheafillu teme met shechal shevii shello beyom arbaa asar shochatim alav. uma gam im tavlu uchedaat hattosafot bifsachim daf 90 uledaat haravad shehissig al rambam beferek 6 mehilchot karban pesach, yeuyyan sham devarav, vehu hayyoter karov lifshata desugeya.

rashi: Bevayit echad yeachel. bachavura achat, shello yeasu hannimnin alav shete chavurot vichallekuhu. atta omer bachavura achat o eno ella bevayit echad kemashmao, ulelammed sheim hitchilu vehayu ochlim bechatzer veyardu geshamim shello yikkansu labbayit? talmud lomar, "al habbattim asher yochlu oto bahem", mikkan shehaochel ochel bishne mekomot:
Lo totzi min habbayit. min hachavura:
Veetzem lo tishberu vo. harauy laachila, kegon sheyyesh alav kazzayit basar, yesh bo mishshum shevirat etzem, en alav kazzayit basar en bo mishshum shevirat etzem:
Vayyomer Adonai el moshe bo el paro. vehatere vo:
Shiti. sumi – sheashit ani:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai el moshe. amar leshon amira rakka, gam hizkir shem harachamim, lo letzad hammishtalleach elav ella letzad hashshaliach shehuzkar besamuch "el moshe", ki hem devarim sheyyismach bahem tzaddik ki chaza nakam (tehillim 58:11), laze amar leshon amira vehazekarat shem harachamim, ki hem devarim hassoadim et libbo.

Od – letzad shello haya Adonai sholeach hammakka techef umiyyad, ad shehaya sholeach lehaterot bo kodem, lemar shavua echad (Shemot Rabba 9,12) ulemar shelosha shavuot, veze hu mimmiddat hachesed veharachamim, laze amar leshon amira vezichron shem harachamim.
Od yirtze al derech shepperashti lemala befarashat vaera (Shemot 6:2) ki afillu middat harachamim hiskima besimcha laasot din ulehinnakem meoyev ze.

Ki ani hichbadti – perush, meatta taskil ladaat ki ani hu shehichbadti et libbo, ki mitteva adam lu yihye libbo kashe kaeven yirad veyifchad biroto makkat habbarad, veze haish odennu berisho, en ze mimmiddat adam ella elohim gazar alav lehakeshoto. ulefi ma shepperashti befasuk (Shemot 9:32) "vehachitta vehakkussemet vegomer ki afilot" vegomer ki Adonai asa pile pelaim, veze haya sibba lehachebid libbo, yeduyyak gam ken al nachon "ki ani hichbadti" baasot pele ze.

O yirtze lederech ze, ki letzad sheraa moshe hammakka haggedola shel habbarad verasha ze adrabba hosif lachato, yishlol hattikva mimmennu veyitchammetz levavo bishlichutav el paro. laze amar: lo tachush laze, ki ani hichbadti libbo, vezulat ze keshearpe mimmennu koved lev hinne hu meshallecham.

Veet lev avadav – taam koved lev avadav hu leval yiatzuhu leshalleach, gam shebbaze tihye havaat hammakkot lechol mitzrayim velo lefaro levad, ki baze lo yihye pirsum hammakkot asher yavi Adonai al paro levad. vahagam shello hizkir Adonai perat ze bishlichut rishona velo amar ella "achazzek et lev paro", amar haikkar uvichlalo hem avadav. veulay shennitkavven Adonai bidvarav kan lefaresh lo devarav harishonim, shello lev paro levad ella gam lev avadav. vetaam shello beer mikkodem uveer atta, letzad sheamar moshe bapparasha hakkodemet "veatta vaavadecha" (Shemot 9:30), gilla dato ki hu sover sheen hazekarat avadav nichlelet behazekarat paro, umeatta yavin bedivre Adonai sheamar lo "vaani achazzek et lev paro" ki en avadav bichlal, veyachshov ki chizzuk lev avadav lo meAdonai yatza haddavar, laze amar ani hichbadti et libbo veet lev avadav:

Lemaan shiti ototay elle bekirbo. tzarich ladaat lamma dikdek lomar ototay elle, sheyyerae sheikkar hattaam shehichbid libbo hu letzad otot elle lesumam, shennire sheyyesh tzorech besimat otot elle velo zulatam. od amro bekirbo. veyitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 12,5) ki maase mitzrayim meid al haelohut ki hu hashshallit vehu haadon, vehaadon letzad shechafetz beyisrael lekarvam leavdo uledavka bo haya chafetz lehasekilam lirot ulehabbit beayin hachechashat kol emuna chutz mimmennu, vaadayin lo heram ki hu bore ruach veose malachav ruchot, gam lo heram ki hu bore or vachoshech. velaze amar lemaan shiti vegomer, perush letzad sheamar elav "ki ani hichbadti et libbo" yesh makom lemoshe lomar, lamma yaarich od hattorach veyitztarech gam ken leshadded hammaarachot, ki yesh bechol makka shinnuy seder maarechet habberia, im lehareoto et kocho yitbarach asher amar alav "mi Adonai", halo hikka makkat habbarad veherahu Adonai yado hanniflaa, uma tzorech lehappech seder habberia od. laze amar elav taam "lemaan shiti ototay elle", perush otot sheani rotze laasot beolami kede sheyyakkiru yisrael haelohut, adayin nisharu mehem elle lehashelamat haemuna, ki bechol sheva makkot sheavru en bahem hachechasha lammishtachave lashshemesh o layyareach, gam laasher yite ki bore haruach eno bore heafar, vahagam sheshshalat Adonai al haaretz, bamme yivvada ki hu bore ruach hu hayyotzer adam vetzar tzura. vehutzrach Adonai lehareotam bemaase haarbe ki asa malachav ruchot lahaviam gam lehacheziram, gam laset et hammetim leval yehanu mehem hammitzriyyim (Shemot Rabba 13,7), uvemakkat choshech ki hu yotzer hammeorot veshalat bahem, gam yetzirat hachoshech, vegazar alav leshammesh avot lemitzrayim (Shemot Rabba 14,1), uvemakkat bechorot noda ki hu hayyotzer tzura betoch tzura umakkir tippat habbechor (bava metzia 61,2), gam beemtzaut makka zo tzivva Adonai mitzvat (Shemot 13,2) "kaddesh li chol bechor", veyihye ze lezikkaron ki hu yotzro mibbeten leeved lo. velaze keshemmatza rasha ze hiksha Adonai libbo "lemaan shiti ototay elle" sheani tzarich laasot leot ulemofet lattaam hannizkar, yihyu bekirbo shettimtzena oto kosot hattarela gam ken letzad risho, vezulat taam ze lo haya Adonai meshadded hammaarachot bishvilo levad.

rashi: Veyafiach kezavim. vetamid medabber kazav ed shaker:
targum: Sahada mehemna la mechazev vedimmalel kadvuta sahada rigla hu:

rashi: Lehacherit letzor uletzidon. pelishtim hayu ozrim otam meoyvehem:
I chaftor. izlash belaaz:
targum: Al yoma deate lemibbaz yat kol ara pelishtae leshetzaa letzor uletzidon kol shear said are abbez Adonai yat ara pelishtae shear nagvat kapputekae:

rashi: Tora achat vegomer. lehashevot ger laezrach af lishar mitzvot shebbattora (sham):
Et habbasar. velo gidim vaatzamot (sham):
Umatztzot al merorim. kol esev mar nikra maror; vetzivvam leechol mar zecher levaymarru et chayyehem" (Shemot 1):
ohc: Veachlu et habbasar. rabbotenu zichronam livracha (fesachim fag.) amru "et habbasar" – velo gidim vaatzamot, karnayim utelafayim. velidivrehem, lamma amar "et"? ma ba lerabbot? venire ki va lerabbot ma sheamru bammishna (fesachim 84.): kol hanneechol beshor haggadol neechol bigdi harach, umefaresh lah rava: kol hanneechol beshor haggadol beshilka vechulei.

Od yirtze al pi machloket rabbi yochanan veresh lakish (fesachim 84,1) begidin shessofam lehitkashshot, lerabbi yochanan nimnin uleresh lakish en nimnin. lerabbi yochanan yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech: "et habbasar" – kol sheddome labbasar sheimmahem kaamar vahare hem domin, uleresh lakish kol sheddomin labbasar bivchinat habbasar mitztzad atzmo, ucheshem shehabbasar en sofo lehitkashshot vechulei.

Umatztzot al merorim. lefi peshat hakkatuv, lefi ma sherainu sheamar Adonai shetztzarich tzeli esh vesheyyihye shalem vechulei, ze yaggid sheddaat elyon hu lehareot bechina haggedola vehacherut veen reshut acherim alehem. ulefi ze gam hammerorim shetztzivva Adonai hu letzad ki chen derech ochle tzeli leechol immo davar chad, ki baze yeerav lechech haochel veyochal bechol avvat nafsho. gam baze yukkar godel haarevut kesheyyakdim lefiv merorim. gam ma shehizkir hammatztzot hu perat asher yechonen chech ochel yitam lo hatztzeli.

Vehinne sheloshet hassarigim yatimu yachad, vehu romez lishlosha devarim: haechad hu haggalut shemmerru et chayyehem, hashsheni hi hayyetzia techef umiyyad shello hispik betzekam lehachemitz bemitzrayim, shelishi, asher pasach Adonai al battehem vehu bechinat haggeulla, ki avar Adonai beeretz mitzrayim venittek chevel moserot heavot shehayu tokfim bahem shehu bechinat habbechora, uchemo shepperashti hainyan bimkomo (Shemot 11:5). usheloshet hainyanim yachad hayu tzerichin lihyot, vezulat echad en nes bashshenayim haacherim, sheim lo haya haggalut lo hayu massigim asher hissigu mehatztzeruf uma shebberru, uma gam lefi ma shekkatavnu bimkomot acherim (Bereshit 46:3) ki goy gadol atzmo shehotzi Adonai mimmitzrayim hem bechinot nitzotze hakkedushsha sheshsham hayta vesham nimtzet, usegullat hotzaatah hu hammaror asher merru et chayyehem, vehu sod amro (Kohelet 8:9) "et asher shalat haadam baadam lera lo". veillu lo haya hammehirut shehotziam Adonai hayu chozrim umishtakkeim borrim umitbarrim, vehu maamar hattanna (haggada shel pesach): veillu lo hotzi vechulei adayin vechulei, vehayinu avadim lefaro vechulei, dichtiv (Shemot 12:39): "velo yachlu lehitmahmeah", veikkar haggeulla hi happesicha. nimtzeta omer ki shelashtam yachad hem haikkar, velaze haya hillel medakdek lecharcham yachad (fesachim 115,1).

rashi: Yutztzag. yehe mutztzag bimkomo:
ohc: Vayyikra faro vegomer. perush, achar sheshshalmu yeme hachoshech, ki kodem "lo kamu ish" vegomer, velaze dibber harasha kashot lemoshe veamar lo "al tosef vegomer reot panay tamut", ki im choshech yeshufehu haya medabber tachanunim.

Gam tappechem. taam shello hismich haholchim yachad veachar kach hammutztzagim, al ze hadderech: "lechu ivdu vegomer gam tappechem gam tzonchem", rak "tzonchem" vegomer – ulay shennitchakkem harasha lehakedim hattenay kodem lammaase, veze shiur devarav: lechu ivdu kedivre harishonim shehaggevarim hem haovdim velo hattaf, rak im taasu tenay ze shetztzonchem vegomer yutztzag, bitnay ze gam tappechem yelech vegomer, vezulat hattenay lo yelchu ella haovdim, shehem haggevarim, velo hattaf. veim haya makdim hammaase lomar "gam tappechem" vegomer veachar kach yomar "rak tzonchem", hammaase kayyam vehattenay batel. veulay sheggam ben haggoyim yakpidu al diyyuk ze, leheyot divre sevara vehem devarim hargilim bemekach umimkar.

rashi: Kullanu metim. amru lo chigzerat moshe hu, shehare amar "umet kol bechor", vechan af happeshutim metim, chamishsha o asara bevayit echad:

Bechodesh haaviv. vechi lo hayinu yodin beeze chodesh? ella kach amar lahem, reu chesed sheggemalchem, shehotzi etchem bechodesh shehu chasher latzet, lo chamma velo tzinna velo geshamim, vechen hu omer, "motzi asirim bakkosharot" (tehillim 68) – chodesh shehu chasher latzet (mechilta):
Vayyelchu vayyaasu bene yisrael. vechi kevar asu, vahalo merosh chodesh neemar lahem? ella mikkevan shekkibbelu alehem maale alehem hakkatuv keillu asu (mechilta):
Vayyelchu vayyaasu. af hahalicha mana hakkatuv, litten sachar lahalicha vesachar laasiyya (sham):
Kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe veaharon. lehaggid shivchan shel yisrael shello hippilu davar mikkol mitzvot moshe veaharon, umahu ken asu? af moshe veaharon ken asu (sham):
ohc: Vayyelchu vegomer ken asu. hutzrach lomar ken asu velo hispik bema shekkadam lomar "vayyaasu" vegomer, lomar hitzdiku bemaasehem bemitzvot Adonai velo hevinu davar shello chen hu bemashmaut, veze lo haya nishma meamro "vayyaasu vegomer kaasher" vegomer, ki efshar shehakkatuv omer ma shechashvu hem, vehaven:

rashi: Hityatztzev vehachen lach. keneged hammilchama, vehachen veatkin:
targum: Chavu vemitzrayim uvesaru bemigdol uvesaru bemappas uvetachpanches amaru izderez veatken lach are ketilat charba sacharanach:

rashi: Kol adat yisrael yaasu oto. lamma neemar, lefi shehu omer befesach mitzrayim "se levet avot", shennimnu alav lammishpachot, yachol af pesach dorot ken? talo kol adat yisrael yaasu oto:
Vehaya lecha leot. yetziat mitzrayim tihye lecha leot:
Al yadcha ulezikkaron bet enecha. shettichtov happarashiyyot hallalu vetiksherem barosh uvazzeroa:
Al yadcha. al yad semol, lefichach yadcha male befarasha sheniyya, lidrosh bah yad shehi cheha (menachot 36):
Baarbe. bishvil makkat haarbe:
ohc: Baarbe. ulay sheyyikshor arbe echad bemattehu, o efshar sheyyazkir shem haarbe bintoto et yado lesiman, ki netiyyat yado hu bishvil arbe.

rashi: Peter chol rechem. sheppatach harechem techilla, kemo: "poter mayim reshit madon" (Mishlei 17), vechen "yaftiru vesafa" (tehillim 22) – yiftechu sefatayim:
Li hu. leatzmi kaniti, ay shehikketi vechore mitzrayim:

Lo yimmatze bevattechem. minnayin laggevulin? talmud lovomar "bechol gevulecha" (Shemot 13); ma talo bevattechem? ma betcha birshutecha, af gevulecha shebbirshutecha, yatza chametzo shel nachri shehu etzel yisrael velo kibbel alav acharayut (mechilta):

Ki kol ochel machmetzet. laanosh karet al hasseor, vahalo chevar anash al hechametz? ella shello tomar chametz sherauy laachila anash alav, seor sheeno rauy laachila lo yeanesh alav; veim anash al hasseor velo anash al hechametz, hayiti omer, seor shehu mechammetz acherim anash alav, chametz sheeno mechammetz acherim lo yeanosh alav, lechach neemru shenehem (mechilta):
Bagger uveezrach haaretz. lefi shehannes naasa leyisrael, hutzrach lerabbot et haggerim (sham):

Chachmot nashim banta vetah. chachmot nakud pattach, sheeno shem davar, ella hachachamot shebbannashim bonot et battehem – shemmitkayyemot al yedehen; kemo ishto shel on ben pelet, kemo shemmeforash beferek 'chelek (sanhedrin kat:-110.):
Veivvelet. veishsha shota:
Beyadeha tehersennu. taharos betah; zo ishto shel korach (Bamidbar 16:1):
targum: Chakkimta dinshaya banya vetah veshatyeta bidaha akra lah:

rashi: Vayyashilum. af ma shello hayu shoalim mehem hayu notnim lahem, atta omer echad? tol shenayim valech.
Vaynatztzelu. verokinu:
ohc: Vayyashilum vaynatztzelu vegomer. perush, letzad shennatan Adonai chen haam beene hammitzrim, uvaze hayu hammitzrim mashilim otam beal karcham, umechamat ze hitzdiku haddevarim, ki en kavvanatam lalechet behechlet, sheim ken hayu mevakkeshim hem lakachat mehem lehareviach yoter, uvaze "vaynatztzelu et mitzrayim". vehinne hammaskil al davar yire ki poal adam yeshallem lo (berachot 9,1), ki letzad sheyyisrael chibbevu devar hayyetzia velo chashshu lahanaat mamon, hu haddavar vehu hassibba shehifliu lehareviach, uzechutam omedet lahem.

rashi: Midderachav yisba sug lev. esav:
Umealav ish tov. yaakov:
targum: Min orchateh nisba man dimdiach libbeh vegavra tava nisba min dechalteh:

rashi: Lemaan revot moftay. makkat bechorot ukeriat yam suf ulenaer et mitzrayim:
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai vegomer lo yishma. hakkavvana baze ulay shechashav moshe ki paro biroto kol hammoftim vehappelaim asher asa moshe baze, hagam sheyyire ki halchu yisrael velo chazru, shemma tippol alav emata vafachad velo yirdof achare bene yisrael, laze hodio ki "lo yishma", perush, lo yekabbel alechem, perush, lema sheattem choshvim shehechlit dato miyyisrael. veamar leshon atid lomar afillu achar makkat bechorot lo achnia libbo lakkatze haacharon lekabbel leshalleach behechlet, vehattaam "lemaan revot moftay beeretz mitzrayim" kesheyyirdefu acharehem. veamro "eretz" kevar amru zichronam livracha (mechilta 14) befasuk "ki Adonai nilcham lahem bemitzrayim" vegomer, yeuyyan sham devarav.

Od yirtze, leheyot sheamar moshe vehishtachavu li lemor tze atta vechol haam asher beraglecha, uferush "beraglecha" hu birshutecha, hare shehotziam laam mershut paro unetanam birshut moshe roenu malkenu, uvaze gilla lo ki yetziatan mimmitzrayim hayta baakirat reshut paro mealehem. laze amar Adonai elav lo yishma alechem paro, perush, lo yavin divrechem paro, vehattaam, "lemaan revot moftay", veim yavin haddavar meet sheyyomar lachem ballayla (Shemot 12:31) "kumu tzeu" yachlit haddavar veen lo makom lirdof acharehem achar kach, veen makom lammoftim sheani rotze leharebot matayim vachamishshim makkot yesovvuhu.

rashi: Dabber na. en na ella leshon bakkasha, bevakkasha mimmecha hazehirem al kach, shello yomar oto tzaddik avraham "vaavadum veinnu otam" (Bereshit 15), kiyyem bahem, "veachare chen yetzu birchush gadol" (sham), lo kiyyem bahem:

Hachodesh hazze. herahu levana bechiddushah veamar lo keshehayyareach mitchaddesh yihye lecha rosh chodesh (mechilta). veen mikra yotze mide feshuto, al chodesh nisan amar lo, ze yihye rosh leseder minyan hechodashim, sheyyehe iyyar karuy sheni, sivan shelishi:

Hazze. nitkashsha moshe al molad hallevana, beezo shiur terae vetihye reuya lekaddesh, vehera lo beetzba et hallevana barakia veamar lo kaze ree vekaddesh (sham). vechetzad herahu? vahalo lo haya nidbar immo ella bayyom? shenne "vayhi beyom dibber Adonai" (Shemot 6), "beyom tzavvoto" (Vayikra 7), "min hayyom asher tzivva Adonai vahala" (Bamidbar 15)? ella samuch lishkiat hachamma neemra lo farasha zo veherahu im chashecha:
ohc: Hachodesh hazze lachem vegomer. taam kefel "rosh chodashim rishon hu" vegomer, nitkavven lomar ki chodesh ze hu rosh, perush muvchar shebbechodashim, al derech amro (Shemot 30:23) "besamim rosh".

Vedikdek lomar lachem, ki eno meshubbach umeulle shebbechodashim ella leyisrael. vetimtza sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (rosh hashshana 11.) benisan nigalu benisan atidin liggael, ki hachodesh mesuyyam letovat yisrael, veal ze "rishon hu", rauy lihyot lachem sheyyihyu monim minnisan letzad maalato.

Od yirmoz beamro hachodesh hazze velo amar chodesh ze, lirmoz al hayyadua, shehu hakkadosh baruch hu, dichtiv (Shemot 15:2) "ze eli", ki yihye ze "lachem" sheyyiggale lahem, keamram zichronam livracha (mechilta beshallach yad): raata shifcha al hayyam vechulei.

Od yirmoz ki hachodesh hazze lachem rosh, perush, sheyyihye leyisrael kinnuy bechinat harosh, shello yihyu od nivzim ushefalim. od ramaz betevat "ze" ki yihye rosh lechol hechodashim shehem shenem asar kemispar "ze".

rashi: Ruach yam. ruach maaravi:

Yamma sof. omer ani sheyyam suf haya miktzato bammaarav, keneged kol ruach deromit, vegam bemizracha shel eretz yisrael, lefichach ruach yam tekao laarbe beyamma suf kenegdo. vechen matzinu leinyan techumin shehu pone letzad mizrach, shenneemar "miyyam suf vead yam pelishtim" (lekamman 23 lo) mimmizrach lemaarav, sheyyam pelishtim bammaarav haya, shenneemar bappelishtim "yoshve chevel hayyam goy keretim" (Tzefanya 2):
Lo nishar arbe echad. af hammeluchim shemmalchu mehem:

ohc: Ushemartem et haddavar hazze. hinne peshat hakkatuv yaggid ki gam ledorot yetzav devarim haamurim bainyan, velo rainu sheasu ken kadmonenu, gam rabbotenu lo tziuu laasot ken. venire ki mimma sheamar hakkatuv lechak lecha bifne atzmo vechazar lomar ulevanecha, gilla hamechuvvan shehu al ze hadderech, sheen haddevarim shavim bo uvevanav, shehaya lo lomar "ushemartem et haddavar hazze lechak olam", umeamro "lechak lecha ulevanecha" hare ze mefaresh hamechuvvan sheenam shavim baddavar. "lechak lecha" hu kol haamur bainyan, "ulevanecha ad olam" peratim mehainyan, vesamach hakkatuv al sheyyavo bimkomot acherim happeratim shehem nohagim ledorot veshalal bahem peratim sheenam ledorot shello hizkiram bahem, vegam kan beer haddevarim beamro "velo yitten hammashchit lavo el battechem lingof" sheyyingof et mitzrayim, vedavar ze eno matzuy ledorot.

rashi: Resh vekalon. dallut vekalon baim al porea musar:
targum: Miskena uman leh tzaara maresh marduta udemizdeher bemachsenuta mityakar:

rashi: Rav ochel nir rashim. raiti bammasoret haggedola: rav ochel. sheloshim ushelosha 'rav – kematzin, vezehu chataf kamatz, umechubbar im ochel bemakkef; veochel raiti sham: nakud pattach (230 sageval shehu patach katan) vetaamo leela, kemo "et kol ochel hashshanim hattovot" (Bereshit 41:35). ulefi nekuddato, ze pitrono: harebe tevua baa laolam al yede nir anashim dallim, kelomar: harebe tora yotza al yede talmidim, sherabbotehem lemedin mehem mittoch pilpulam shemmefalpelim bahalacha:

Veyesh nispe. veyesh harebe mehem shehem kalim min haolam bishvil lo mishpat sheenan nohagin kashshura, uleinyan hattevua yesh tevua loka bishvil bealeha sheeno motzi maasroteha umattenot aniyyim kammishpat, verabbotenu pershu bemassechet chagiga (chagiga 4:-5.), veyesh nispe al shelucho shel malach hammavet shemmechallef shem beshem umemit et shello higgia zemanno aval im ken hu en inyan sof happasuk lerosho:
targum: Rabba achil ara lemiskena veit gavra mitneged bela dina:

rashi: Erev rav. taarovet ummot shel gerim:

ohc: Ulechol bene yisrael haya or vegomer. dikdek lomar ulechol, lomar shekkol echad veechad miyyisrael shehaya holech levet hammitzri haya lo or bemoshvotam shel hammitzriyyim.

O yechavven lomar: or ze minnayin motzao? veamar shehu or bemoshvotam, vechaser tevat "asher", veharebe mikraot yekatztzeru chen. vehakkavvana al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 14,2) ki harshaim mitkassim bachoshech, vehu asher kissa hammitzrim harshaim, ucheneged hatztzaddikim alehem yizrach hashshem baruch hu, veohavav ketzet hashshemesh bigvurato, umeor moshvotam livva lahem hashshem baruch hu chelek echad, vehu amro or bemoshvotam:

rashi: Terem yechmatz. hammitzrim lo hinnichum lishhot kede chimmutz:
Misharotam. sheyare matztza umaror.
Al shichmam. aappi shebbehemot harebe holichu immahem, mechabbevim hayu et hammitzva:
Veachare chen. mikketz arbaim shana, kemo sheamar yechezkel (Yechezkel 29:13):
targum: Veemserinun beyad devaan lemiktalhon uveyad nevuchadretzar malka devavel uveyad avdohi uvatar ken tishre keyome kedem amar Adonai:

rashi: Gam atta titten. lo dayyecha shemmiknenu yelech immanu ella gam mishshellecha titten:
ohc: Gam atta titten beyadenu. kashe, ech shaol yishal eved Adonai zivche elohim meish bazuy vetame asher herim piv bikdosh yisrael, nosaf al heyoto nachri? hachefetz laAdonai bezevach reshaim? vahagam sheamra tora "ish ish" lerabbot (chullin 13,2), ach verak lo lishol mimmennu.

Achen divre fi chacham, dikdek bilshono veamar veasinu, shehaya lo lomar "laasot laAdonai elohenu", ella nitkavvenu lomar shehu yitten beyadam mikne harauy lizvachim, vaanachnu naase laAdonai elohenu letzorech atzmenu, ella shehu yamtzi lahem mattana sheyyistappeku mimmenna lezivchehem laAdonai. gam baze lo kashe amro "zevachim veolot" lattanna sheamar (menachot ag:) sheen mekabbelin meummot haolam ella ola velo shelamim, vahare mikra male dibber hakkatuv kan "zevachim veolot", velidvarenu lo kashe.

rashi: Vayyomer moshe ko amar Adonai. beamdo lifne faro neemra lo nevua zo, shehare mishsheyyatza millefanav lo hosif reot panav:

Kachatzot hallayla. kehechalek hallayla: kachatzot. kemo "baalot" (Melachim 1 18), "bacharot appam banu" (Tehillim 124), zehu peshuto leyashshevo al afnav, sheen chatzot shem davar shel chatzi. verabbotenu derashuhu kemo kachatzi hallayla, veamru sheamar moshe "kachatzot", shemmashma samuch lo, o lefanav o leacharav, velo amar "bachatzot", shemma yitu itztagnine faro veyomru moshe badday hu (berachot 4):
ohc: Kachatzot hallayla. kevar dibberu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (berachot 4.) betaam amro kachatzot bechf. veulay sheyyechavven od al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 43,3) befasuk (Bereshit 14:15) "vayyechalek alehem layla" ki lel 15 benisan haya. od amru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 42) ki harigat arbaa melachim sheharag avraham ibbeda kamma emunot, gam hayta milchama gedola vaatzuma ureshuma bemalche olam, ki hayu melachim takkifim veshaltu al chamishsha melachim gedolim vetakkifim, veadam echad hu veavde veto nitztzechum. laze tziyyen lo hazzeman veamar lo kachatzot hallayla hayyadua baolam, sheyyatzati leyesha avraham avihem, kemo chen "ani yotze" vegomer:

Ani yotze vegomer. perush, hagam sheyyesh li kamma meshartim, af al pi chen ani beatzmi etze betoch mitzrayim. vehattaam lishte sibbot: 1, lechibbat habbanim, shettihye yetziatam al yado bichvodo uveatzmo. 2, ki en malach mavchin hahavchana haggedola mi hu shennotzar mittippa rishona shel adam sheyyikkare gam ken bechor, hagam shehu sheni ushelishi labbeten, zulat hu hayyotzer hu habbore baruch hu makkir hattippot shetztzar mi vami habbechor.

rashi: Been alafim evus bar. been shevavrim haevus rekam, sheafillu teven en matzuy babbayit:
Bar. naki verekam, kelomar: bemakom sheen talmide chachamim en horaa nimtzet kahalacha:
targum: Atar delet tora dachyan urevata vesugea daalalta bechayleh detora:

rashi: Toshav. ze ger toshav:
Vesachir. ze goy, uma talo, vahalo arelim hem, veneemar vechol arel lo yochal bo? ella kegon aravi mahul vegivoni mahul vehu toshav o sachir (sham):
Nidmeta. nechreva:
Titgodadi. tesarti beevel uvevechi:
targum: Metat pureanuta leyatve aza ittevar ashkelanae shear tukefhon ad ematay tithamamun:

rashi: Peter chamor. velo peter shear behema temea; ugezerat hakkatuv hi lefi shennimshelu bechore mitzrayim lachamorim; veod, shessiyyeu et yisrael bitziatan, sheen lecha echad miyyisrael shello natal harebe chamorim mimmitzrayim teunim mikkaspam umizzehavam shel mitzrim:
Tifde vese. noten se lakkohen ufeter chamor muttar bahanaa vehasse chullin beyad kohen (bechorot 9):
Vaarafto. orfo bekofitz meachorav vehorgo; hu hifsid mamono shel kohen, lefichach yafsid mamono (sham 10):
Vechol bechor adam bevanecha tifde. chamesh selaim pidyono katzuv bemakom acher (Bamidbar 18):
Lammishpat. "bedin chasuch" (targum yonatan), meat meat:
Venakke. leshon tiut vehashemed; vechen tirgemo yonatan leshon kelaya:
targum: At la tidchal avdi yaakov amar Adonai are besaadach memri are aved gemira bechol ammaya di agletach letaman veimach la abed gemira veayte alach yesurin lealfutach beram bedin chasoch veshetzaa la eshetzinach:

rashi: Haterem teda. haod lo yadata ki avda mitzrayim:
ohc: Ad matay yihye vegomer. lo shehiskimu leshallach yisrael behechlet, ki hannevua sheamar Adonai lemoshe "hichbadti" vegomer tachchish ze, ella sheratzu sheyyelchu beofen sheyyachzeru vadday. velaze timtza kesheamar moshe "binarenu uvizkenenu" vegomer vegersham paro, lo yasfu dabber od baddavar hazze. gam pihem ana vam ki lo heeminu beseder hammaase ki elohe haivrim haggadol haggibbor vehannora nata yado bahem leshallach yisrael, ella shehayu yokshim bahem, veen lecha kefira baamittut hainyan kaze.
Haterem teda. perush, haim kodem shetteshallechem tirtze ladaat sheavda mitzrayim? laze shallach otam kodem sheyyaggia geder ze shel avedat mitzrayim.

Veraiti latet lev bamme hiskima datam al avedat mitzrayim achar kach, veshatku vehalchu lahem. ulehavin hainyan naskil bachakor bainyan ma hayta dato shel paro vaavadav mittechillat hainyan, haim yesh shote gamur baolam sheyyisbol kol haraot vehatztzarot hahemma veyachnis atzmo besakkanot nefashot, veod lo shellaka eloho vesafu miknav veavdu tzimche adama, vechimat safu tammu, keamro "haterem teda ki avda mitzrayim"? umin hassetam lo yeamen ki kol kach tippesh haya, vahagam ki hiksha Adonai et rucho, im kol ze tzarich shettihye lo eze sevara shebbah yitgalle tippeshuto. vetigdal hakkushya birot ki lo shaal Adonai mimmennu ella derech sheloshet yamim, vahagam shekkatavnu sham (Shemot 3:18) ki Adonai lo amar perat ze ella yisrael, im kol ze hare bechol shelichutav lo amar ella (Shemot 5:1) "veyachoggu li bammidbar", "veyaavduni" (Shemot 5:3), ze yaggid ki lo lachalutin yetzav Adonai.

Vaavin davar, ki hu ze asher hitahu lefaro ulechol ammo ofen hashshelichut asher shalach Adonai lishloach yisrael lachog bammidbar, shehakkavvana hu lashuv achar kach. hare hu galuy lefaro uleammo ki lo behechlet hu shoel, umizze nafal hattaut ki yesh baddavar shene tzedadin: haechad ki devar Adonai emet hu ki eno chafetz ella derech sheloshet yamim, vehashsheni ki haddevarim bau derech arma veen dato ella lehotziam lachalutin. ulefi ze haddevarim meidim ki kivyachol en koach bo lehotziam behechlet, bar minan, ha lamadta sheyyesh lo menia chas veshalom laratzon asher yachpotz. velaze paro vaavadav, letzad shelilat ikkar haemuna bahem, chashvu tzad hashsheni, velaze hikshu arpam umeanu lekabbel maamar Adonai, ki amru en bechocho chas vechalila lehacheriach hechreach gadol, veze lecha haot hammufla shearom yarim. velaze hikshu libbam, veachar kach kesherau avadav sheavru alehem sheva makkot vehitra bemakka sheminit shel haarbe, natnu lev letzadded tzad harishon, ki haemet hu shettamo shel haeloah baruch hu sheeno chafetz lehotziam lachalutin. vehu amram ad matay yihye vegomer shallach et haanashim veyaavdu, perush, sheen kavvanat Adonai ella al perat ze, vehattaam shebbo hichrachnu haddavar ki hikkarnu ki kol yachol, veim hayta kavvanato sheyyelchu lachalutin haya omer ken beferush viabbed kol mesarev umemaen bidvarav. veamru haterem teda ki avda mitzrayim bammakkot asher hikka, ha lamadta ki yachol hu laasot kol asher yachpotz. ulefi ze hichrichu shene devarim: haechad sheyyisrael lo yelchu behechlet, vehitzdiku mippile hammakkot, ki im haya Adonai chafetz lehotziam behechlet – en miyyado matztzil.

Vetimtza ki nitchakkem paro harasha veheshivam bemirma, "vayyushav et moshe vegomer, vayyomer lahem mi vami haholchim", veheshivuhu "binarenu uvizkenenu nelech", veamar lahem "raa neged vegomer, lechu na haggevarim vegomer ki otah attem mevakshim, vaygaresh otam" vegomer. umeemtzaut hammaase nistera daat avde faro, ki lo kemo shechashvu sheen halichatam ella leshaa, shehare mehainyan muchach ki arma baddavar, vahalichatam halichat olam. ulefi ze chazru gam ken lammechush harishon, ki ze lecha haot ki lo kol yachol kannizkar lemala, uvaze lo hosifu ledabber od kedivrehem harishonim.

rashi: Bikkesh letz chachma. keshehu tzarich el hachachma eno motzah belibbo:
targum: Bae memikna chachmeta velet vidiata leman demitbayen zelila:

rashi: Veacharav lo yihye chen. veoto shehaya vime yoel shenne "kamohu lo nihya min haolam" (Yoel 2), lamadnu shehaya kaved mishshel moshe. (oto shel yoel haya) ay minin harebe, shehayu yachad arbe, yelek, chasil, gazam, aval shel moshe lo haya ella min echad, vechamohu lo haya velo yihye:
Motnechem chagurim. mezummanim ladderech:
Bechippazon. leshon behala umehirut, kemo "vayhi david nechpaz lalechet" (Shmuel 1 23), "asher hishlichu aram bechafzam" (Melachim 2 7):

Pesach hu laAdonai. hakkarban karuy pesach al shem haddillug vehappesicha, shehakkabba haya medalleg batte yisrael mibben batte mitzrayim vekofetz mimmitzri lemitzri veyisrael emtzai nimlat; veattem asu chol avodotav leshem shamayim, derech dillug ukefitza, zecher lishmo shekkaruy pesach; vegam 481 leshon pesia:
Ketzar appayim. hammemaher linkom kaaso:
Veish mezimmot. machashavot etza raa:
targum: Man decharya rucheh mitchashev shatya vesanya legavra daaricha tariteh:

rashi: Tov yanchil. et zechuto veet mamono livne vanav, aval chote eno manchil levanav, ki tzafun chelo umamono latztzaddik, kemo shekkatuv "vattasem ester et mardochay al bet haman" (Ester 8:2):
targum: Gavra tava morit livne venohi umitnatar letzadika utereh dechataah:

rashi: El amon. al amon, al hassar amon. yesh shehu leshon gedulla, kemo "hatetvi minno amon" (Nachum 3:8):
Minno. alekkesanderiyya rabbeta (Pesikta rabbati log), lashinyoria delishandera belaaz:
targum: Amar Adonai tzevaot elaha deyisrael ha ana masar al itregushat alakkesanderaya veal paro veal mitzrayim veal taavataha veal malkeha veal paro veal demitrachatzin alohi:

rashi: Ezov. min yarak sheyyesh lo givolin:
Aguddat ezov. shelosha kelachin keruyin agudda (shabbat 109):
Asher bassaf. bakkeli, kemo sippot kesef:

Min haddam asher bassaf. lamma chazar ushenao? shello tomar tevila achat lishlosh hammattanot, lechach neemar od asher bassaf, veshettehe chol netina unetina min haddam asher bassaf, al kol haggaa tevila (mechilta):

Veattem lo tetzu vegomer. maggid, shemmeachar shennittena reshut lammashchit lechabbel, eno mavchin ben tzaddik lerasha (sham); velayla reshut lamchabbelim hu, shenneemar "bo tirmos kol chayto yaar" (tehillim 104):

targum: Kidnan amar Adonai ha ammaya atan mitzippuna vihon kenachal megabber veyivzun ara umelaah kirvaya udeyatvin behon vitzavchun bene enasha vilelun kol yatve ara:
Kal tzivchata mechoronayim biza utevara rabba:
Beta derashie yishtetze umashkena ditritze mafriach:
Behitat malchut mitzrayim itmesarat beyad ama deata alah mitzippuna:

bart: Chattat haof naaset lematta. michut hassikra. dichtiv (Vayikra 5) vehizza middam hachattat al kir hammizbeach vehannishar baddam yimmatze el yesod hammizbeach, kir shehashsheyarim shello mitmatztzin laysod, vezehu kir hattachton lematta michut hassikra. dei kir haelyon dehaynu min hachut ulemala, peamim shehu mitmatztze lassovev, kegon sheosehu lemala min hassovev, shehachut lematta min hassovev amma:
Vechattat behema lemala. dichtiv karnot, begufah shel keren:
Olat haof lemala. dichtiv (sham 1) umalak vehiktir venimtza damo, ma haketara berosho shel mizbeach, af melika umitztzuy berosho shel mizbeach:
Veshel behema lematta. dichtiv bah yesod:

Veim shinna baze uvaze pasul. hay defasul im asa maase chattat haof lemala, davka vahazzaa. aval hammelika shel chattat, af lemala keshera, dimlika bechol makom bammizbeach keshera. veolat haof let bah hazzaa ki im mitztzuy, veim asaah lematta, pesula:

Seder kinnin shel chova echad chattat veechad ola. kegon zav vezava veyoledet, vetumat mikdash vekadashav, ushemiat kol ala, uvittuy sefatayim, dechullan meviin ken bedallut, ella shezzav vezava meviin ken ben bedallut ben baashirut. veaf al gav deikka kinnin shel ger dehen chova ushenehen olot, lo chayesh tanna alayhu, mishshum delo shechiche kulle hay:
Bindarim unedavot kullan olot. lefi sheen bain beneder unedava ella olot ushelamim bilvad, veen ofot baim shelamim, hilkach nedarim unedavot shebbeofot kullan olot:
Bamme devarim amurim. shechozrim min hammaaracha, veyesh sheen zazin mimmekomam. bemilchemet harshut:

Aval milchemet mitzva hakkol yotzim. milchemet eretz yisrael umilchemet amalek hakkol modim shehi chova vehakkol yotzim bah. umilchemet bet david shehi lirvacha leharechiv gevul yisrael velakachat mas mehaammim kegon milchemet aram naharayim vaaram tzova, hakkol modim shehi reshut. lo nechleku tanna kamma verabbi yehuda ella bemilchama shennilchamim yisrael im oyvehem kede shello yitgabberu alehem veyatzeru lahem. tanna kamma kare lah milchemet reshut vesover sheen adam rashshay lehitbattel min hammitzva kede lehillachem bemilchama kazo. verabbi yehuda savar sheggam zo milchemet mitzva, meachar shehu lehoshia et yisrael miyyad sonehem, vehaosek bemitzva patur min hammitzva. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Ed echad omer raiti veed echad omer lo raita. uchegon shebbau shenehem bevat achat, [az] hayu orfim. aval im ba echad techilla veamar raiti et hahoreg, vehemnuhu keve tere, shehattora heeminathu dichtiv (sham) lo noda mi hikkahu, ha noda afillu al pi ed echad en orfin, af al pi shebba ed echad achar kach vehichchisho, eno neeman hashsheni, sheen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim:
Ed echad omer raiti ushenayim omrim lo raita hayu orfim. uchegon shehashshenayim vehaechad pesule edut hen, devifsule edut halech achar rov deot:

Hattachtona chamesh. michutz lechotel hammesibba shehu hakkotel hachitzon shel hakkodesh hayu yetziim, dehaynu gezuzetraot makkifim et habbayit mishshalosh ruchot maarav tzafon vedarom, vehayu hayyetziim hallalu tachtiyyim sheniyyim ushelishim. hayyatzia hattachtona chamesh baamma rachbah, veharoved shealeha dehaynu hattikra sheal hattachtona shehi haritzpa shel hattichona, shesh baamma rachbah, lefi shekkotel hammesibba haya holech umetzer kelappe mala, ucheshehiggia el haroved sheal gabbe hattachtona haya nichnas lifnim amma achat, veal otah amma habboletet hayu netunim korot hayyatzia. nimtzet hayyatzia hattichona rechava amma achat yoter min hattachtona, dehaynu otah amma shennichnas hakkotel lifnim. vechen keshemmaggia laroved sheal gabbe hattichona shehi haritzpa shel shelishit, haya hakkotel metzer venichnas lifnim amma achat, kede sheyyaniach rosh hakkora al otah amma, shekkotel hattichona bolet veyotze lachutz yoter mikkotel haelyona, venimtzet hayyatzia haelyona rechava amma yoter min hattichona ushete ammot yoter min hattachtona. vezehu shenneemar (Melachim 1 6) ki migraot natan labbayit chutza levilti echoz bekirot habbayit, kelomar haya megarea umechasser boovi hakkotel mibbachutz amma achat baroved shel hattichona, veod amma acheret baroved shel haelyona, kede sheyyihye lo makom lasum bahem rashe hakkorot shel haroved, kede shello yitztarech leechoz bekirot habbayit laasot chorin bakkotel velitchov sham rashe hakkorot:
Kitruma vadday. rabbi eliezer letaameh deamar sheani omer sea shennafla hi sea shealta:
Enah medammaat ella lefi cheshbon. vehassea shehigbiah en bah ella chelek echad mimmea teruma, vehashshear chullin:

Echad measara. yachol leharebot ulehafrish teruma, hoil veashkechan shem teruma bemakom acher shehi echad measara. veim ribba yoter en shem teruma al oto ribbuy, vehu chullin hattevulin lemaaser, umedumma batteruma. vezo hi takkanato, sheyyaasennu terumat maaser lemakom acher veyittenehu lallevi sheyyaasennu terumat maaser al maaser tevel shello, vehallevi yitten lo chullin keneged oto ribbuy. veha dekaamar yaasennu terumat maaser lemakom acher velo amar yaasennu teruma lemakom acher, lefi sheen tormin shello min hammukkaf, aval terumat maaser mafrishin otah shello min hammukkaf:

Mechetza chullin umechetza teruma. desavar yachol adam laasot chatzi kiryo teruma, dichtiv (Devarim 18) reshit degancha, dayyo lareshit sheyyihye chaddagan, [reshit hi teruma], vedagan hu hashshirayim:
Ad sheyyeshayyer sham chullin. lo vainan rak sheyyihyu sheyareha nikkarin. vahalacha kerabbi tarfon verabbi akiva:
Parach. perida achat mizzo lazo:

Posel echad bahalichato. mimmakom shennifrash. ufasul hu atzmo o acher bemakom shennitarev. dichshepparcha ferida achat mishshene kinnin lishne kinnin acherim, hare shalosh peridot levad vechamesh peridot levad, umishshalosh peridot eno yachol lehakeriv rak shetayim, achat ola veachat chattat, sheim yaase shetayim mehen olot nimtza shehukba hashshelishi shennishar veoto shepparach lechattat, velo yuchal lehakeriv shuv mechamesh peridot ki im shete chattaot, kedin chattat shennitarva vechova deamrinan beferek kamma deen kasher ella minyan chattaot shebbachova. i nammi, en lehakeriv hashshelishi hannishar, dechayshinan shemma yakrivu oto shepparach bachamesh peridot veyaasuhu chattat, vachavero shennishar bashshalosh peridot nammi yaasuhu chattat, venimtzeu shete chattaot mikken echad. vechen min hechamesh peridot eno yachol lehakeriv rak shete chattaot ushete olot, dechi avid shalosh chattaot o shalosh olot, dilma avid lehu mishshene kinnin shel ishsha achat, veen din shene kinnin ella bishte chattaot ushete olot. vehayenu defasul hu o acher bemakom shennitarev, ufosel [echad] kenegdo mimmakom shepparach venifrash mishsham:

Chazar posel echad bachazarato. chazar ufarach echad meotam hechamesh peridot letoch ellu hashshalosh, shennimtzeu atta arba peridot mikkan vearba peridot mikkan, posel echad bachazarato mimmakom shennifrash veyatza mishsham, vehu o acher pesulim bammakom shemmitarev sham, veen yecholim lehakeriv ella achat chattat veachat ola min haarba shebbechan, veachat chattat veachat ola min haarba haacherim. dedilma otah perida shepparcha shenit hi meotam shene kinnin veenah otah shennitarva vah techilla, venisharu sham shalosh peridot min hashshene kinnin veotah shepparcha sham rishona, vechen bammakom hashsheni. vei avid bemakom echad shete olot veachat chattat, yehe nikba oto shepparach latztzad hashsheni lechattat velo yuchal lehakeriv sham rak chattat achat, dedilma kol hashshalosh chattaot shennaasu mikkan umikkan yihyu mishshene kinnin shel ishsha achat. hilkach ose vechol makom ola achat vechattat achat, o shete olot vechattat achat betzad ze vechattat achat betzad ze, o shete chattaot veola betzad ze uvatztzad hashsheni ola achat. veim chazru venitarvu yachad, leolam lo yihyu lahem pachot mishshene kinnin shehem kesherim:
Tetze vetire vaeder. kishar chullin:
Kippera sefekah. hi asta et shellah:
Veachar kach nimtza hahoreg hare ze yehareg. dichtiv besof parashat egla arufa (Devarim 21) veatta tevaer haddam hannaki mikkirbecha:
Ani reitiha shennitmet. beotah setira, shehi al pi edim lerabbi yehoshua, o al pi of happoreach lerabbi eliezer:
Lo hayta shota. deed echad neeman bah af lehafesidah ketubbatah, sheraglayim laddavar:
Af lefaslah mikketubbatah. shello tishte velo tittol ketubbatah:
Yevimtah. eshet achi balah:
Uvat balah. meishsha acheret:

Hare ellu neemanot. leedut zo, af al pi shehen pesulot lechol shear edut shehu leraatah, lefi shehattora heemina kol edut sheyyesh bah. umihu lo lefaslah mikketubbatah, hoil vesonot otah, ella shello tishte:

Medammeot kakketanna shebbishtehen. keshiur hashsheniyya shehi ketanna shebbishtehen, veim yesh bachullin mea keneged hakketanna en naasim medumma, ella notel min hachullin keshiur ellu hashshete terumot shennaflu vahen venotnan lakkohen, vehashshear chullin kemo shehayu:
Ellu neemarin. parashat sota. dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) veamar el haishsha, bechol lashon shehu omer:
Uvidduy maaser. biarti hakkodesh min habbayit kulei, omer bechol lashon sheyyirtze, dichtiv (Devarim 26) veamarta lifne Adonai‏ elohecha, bechol lashon sheatta omer:
Keriat shema. dichtiv (sham 6) shema yisrael, bechol lashon sheatta shomea:
Utefilla. tzibbur shemmitpallelin, mitpallelin bechol lashon. aval yachid eno mitpallel ella bilshon hakkodesh:
Uvirkat hammazon. dichtiv (sham 8) uverachta, bechol lashon sheatta mevarech:

Ushevuat haedut ushevuat happikkadon. bechol lashon shehishbium velo hodu, chayyavin. shevuat haedut yalfinan la dichtiv bah (Vayikra 5) veshama kol ala, bechol lashon sheatta shomea. ushevuat happikkadon gamar techeta techeta mishshevuat haedut:

Terumat shenehem teruma. hayenu ditrumat kol echad mehen chetzyah teruma vechetzyah chullin, nimtza keshettarmu shenehem mechamishshim sein ze sea veze sea, shello kadsha teruma ki im chatzi sea beshel ze vachatzi sea beshel ze, kol echad kefi chelko:

Im taram harishon kashshiur. echad mechamishshim, kashshiur shennatnu chachamim, terumato teruma. vahalacha kerabbi yose, dilferushe miltayhu dachachamim kaate. veit dimfarshe im taram harishon keshiur ma shettaram chavero achar kach terumato teruma, dachazinan dahava nicha leh lehaich batraa bema shettaram harishon, shehare hayta dato maskemet immo beshiur hatteruma. uferush rishon nira beenay ikkar:
Sea teruma temea shennafla lemea chullin tehorim. vehasheta hatteruma ola beechad umea velo naase hakkol medumma, vehachullin tehorim lo huchsheru lekabbel tuma velo timmeatan hatteruma temea:

Terom vetissaref. keshem sheim hayta teruma tehora taale veteachel, kach hattemea terom vetissaref. vehay tissaref dumeya deterakev, sheasur lehanot mimmenna beshaa shessorfah, dei sharyat leh lehanot mimmenna ate lemechlah, desavur shehi mutteret al yede vittul:
Taale veteachel nikkudim. beyovesh, kulleh kidfarshinan leel. vahalacha kachachamim:
Umesibba. kemin mechilla umeara:
Shebbah hayu olim legaggot hattaim. umippene shehaole bah ole derech hekkef veyored derech hekkef, karuy mesibba:
Velulin. arubbot sheosim baaliyyot:
Meshalshelim et haummanim. moridin otam bechevel betoch hattevot, kede shello yehanu biriyyat bet kodesh hakkodashim, ella metakkenin ma shetztzarich bilvad veolin:
Megura. otzar sheogrim bo hattevua:
Vekippeah. hesir ma shellemala, targum vayyitztzef habbarzel (Melachim 2 6) vekafa farzela:

Im yesh bakkippuy taale beechad umea. mefaresh bayrushalmi dehachi kaamar im yesh bakkippuy im ma shettachtav echad umea taale, verabbi eliezer letaameh deamar hattachtonot maalot et haelyonot, veka mashma lan deaf al gav dekippeah vegale dateh shello nitarva im hattachtonot, af al pi chen hattachtonot mesayyeot levattel:
Verabbi yehoshua omer lo taale. rabbi yehoshua letaameh deamar leel sheen hattachtonot mesayyeot levattel:

Sea teruma vechulei. siyyuma demilleteh derabbi yehoshua hi, vehachi kaamar, kevan delo taale ketzad yaase, yakpienna. yasir ma shetztzaf lemala umeat saviv lah ad sheyyeda shehesir kullah, vehashshear hakkol chullin:

Im ken lamma amru. matnitin parech al milleteh derabbi yehoshua. im ken beeze makom amru teruma tzericha echad umea, kevan sheyyesh takkana bekippuy. umeshane besheen yadua im nivlela hassea bammegura achar shennafla al pi hammegura, i nammi mittechilla en yadua lehechan nafla. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Uvekeren maaravit deromit. lematta baamma shel yesod hayu shene nekavim:
Shehaddamim hannittanim al yesod maaravi. kegon sheyare haddam shel chattaot happenimiyyot, shelleachar kol hammattanot haya shofech sheyare haddam al yesod maaravi:
Veal yesod deromi. sheyare haddam shel chitzoniyyot:
Yordin. derech otan nekavim, umitarvim beammat hammayim shebbaazara, umishsham yotzin lenachal kidron. uvaale ginnot hayu konim otan min haggizbarim lezabbel bahen et hakkarka:
Lo va leyadenu ufetarnuhu. belo mezonot:
Velo reinuhu vehinnachnuhu. belo levaya:

Echad lazo ushenayim lazo kulei. parach min harishona perida achat lashsheniyya, miyyad nifsal oto yechidi shennishar barishona, dei yaasennu chattat yehe nikba oto shepparach leola velo yuchal lehakeriv bashsheni uvekinnin acherim shennitarev bahen rak mechetzyan olot, kemo ola shennitarva vechova. vechi farach min hashsheniyya lashshelishit, shemma miggufah shel hashsheniyya parach, veoto shepparach min harishona nishar sham bashsheniyya, veeno yachol laasot min hashsheniyya rak shete feridot achat chattat veachat ola, dei avid shete olot, shemma min happeridot shel guf hashsheniyya yaase veim ken yihye nikba oto shepparach bashshelishit lechattat velo yuchal laasot bashshelishit rak mechetzyan chattaot velo yoter. vechen ki farach min hashshelishit larviit, shemma miggufah shel shelishit hava oto shepparach, velo nishar bah rak chamesh peridot uferida achat min hashsheniyya shennitarva vahen, veeno yachol laasot bashshelishit rak shete chattaot ushete olot mippene oto shennitarev barviit. vechen ki farach min harviit lachamishit en kasher barviit ella shalosh chattaot veshalosh olot. vechen mechamishit lashshishshit, yaase vachamishit arba chattaot vearba olot. vechen mishshishshit lashsheviit en kasher bashshishshit ki im chamesh chattaot vechamesh olot, dei avid shesh olot yehe nikba oto shepparach bashsheviit lechattat velo yuchal laasot bashsheviit ki im sheva chattaot belo shum olot. vechi hadar min hashsheviit ufarach echad bashshishshit, shemma lo hu oto shepparach battechilla mishshishshit, ella miggufah shel sheviit parach venifselu vashsheviit shete feridot, veen kasher ki im shesh chattaot veshesh olot, dei avid sheva chattaot yehe nikba oto shepparach bashshishshit [uvaacherim] leola, velo yuchal lehakeriv rak olot mechatzi happeridot, vechetzyan haacherim pesulim kedin ola shennitarva vechova. vechi farach min hashshishshit lachamishit nifsal bachazara zo od ken echad, veen kasher bashshishshit ki im arba chattaot vearba olot, deshemma min hashshishshit parach miggufah achat bashsheviit veachat bachamishit bachazara, velo nishar lah ki im eser peridot miggufah, vei avid chamesh chattaot vechamesh olot dilma hashshete feridot shepparchu mimmenna yihyu kerevim olot shetehen veim ken yaasu veshishsha kinnin sheva olot, o yihyu asuyin shetehen chattaot, veen yecholim laasot beshishsha kinnin ella shesh olot veshesh chattaot. vechen mechamishit larviit. umerviit lashshelishit. umishshelishit lashsheniyya, en bashshelishit ki im shete feridot achat chattat veachat ola. veim tomar, velama hifsida hashshelishit shetayim, shehare meotan shepparchu vashsheniyya vachazara lo yakrivu, deha katane hashsheniyya en lah kelum, vahava lan lememar bashshelishit shene kinnin uvashsheniyya en bah kelum, o bashsheniyya ken echad uvashshelishit ken echad. veyesh lomar, kevan devishar kinnin mervii vaelach nifselu shene kinnin echad bahalicha veachar bachazara, gazrinan kemo chen bashshelishit. aval bashsheviit lo nifsal ki im ken echad, delo halach mimmenna rak perida achat bachazara, veillu vahalicha lo nifsal bah kelum velo nechsar mimmenna davar:

Parach vechazar. lav arishona usheniyya kae, dechevan deen lahem kelum ella metim, im parach echad mehem ben shear kinnin yamutu chullam keditnan besamuch veim parach mibben hammetot lechullam kullam yamutu. ella kae ashshelishit shepparach mimmenna larviit, umerviit lachamishit, umechamishit lashshishshit, umishshishshit lashsheviit, vechazar mishsheviit lashshishshit ad hashshelishit, hare min hashsheviit chaser shete feridot, achat bachazara rishona veachat bachazara sheniyya. veen kasher bashsheviit rak chamesh peridot leolot vechamesh peridot lechattaot, dei avid shesh olot, shemma hashshetayim shehalchu mimmenna yihyu kerevin olot, hare shemone olot, veen bashsheva kinnin rak sheva olot. umin hashshishshit chaser arba peridot, shetayim bifricha vachazara rishona, ushetayim bashsheniyya, venisharu shene kinnin kesherim, dei avid shalosh olot, shemma arba shehalchu mimmenna yihyu olot, hare sheva olot, veen bashshishsha kinnim rak shesh olot. vechen hachamishit en kasher bah ki im echad leola veechad lechattat. uchemo chen kashya vechan kevan deharviit en lah kelum haya yachol lehakeriv bachamishit shalosh olot veshalosh chattaot, dahare otan shehalchu varviit enan kerevot, ulefi ze shehachamishit en lah ella achat haya yachol lehakeriv barviit shete olot ushete chattaot. ella gazrinan bechol pericha vachazara shene kinnin [gezera vazo attu vazo]. vechen ki farach vechazar paam shelishit en lahem kelum levad hashsheviit sheyyesh lah arba, kemo chen gazrinan bechol pericha vachazara shene kinnin:

Veyesh omrim hashsheviit lo hifsida chelum. perush, bifricha vachazara shelishit. ella leolam yakrivu mimmenna chamishsha kinnin, deshalosh peridot parchu mimmenna lechol hayyoter venisharu vah rak achat esre feridot, veyaase mehem chamesh chattaot vechamesh olot, kevan deaf hashshishshit en lah kelum. vehacha lo gazrinan bifricha zo kemo bishar kinnin, dechevan deenah mafsedet bappericha beshum paam, lo gazru al hachazara. veen halacha keyesh omrim:
Uvaakevo shel am. besofo shel am, shemmeshammerim shello yachzeru haacharonim laachorehem lanus:
Zekifim. gibborim memunnim lechach sheim yippol echad min hannilchamim yaamiduhu veyizkefuhu:
Vaacherim meachorehem vechashshilin shel barzel bidehem. lishmor shello yanusu:
Kashshilin. kardomot shel barzel:
Lekappeach et shokav. lachattoch et shokav:
Shettechillat nisa nefila. lashon mesoras hu, shettechillat nefila nissa:

Teenim shechorot maalot et hallevanot. teena shel teruma, shechora o levana, shennafla lemea teenim shel chullin, chetzyan shechorot vechetzyan levanot, kullan mitztarfin levattelah, sheim haya rotze haya dorsan umearvan hakkol beyachad. veim shechora nafla, maale achat min hashshechorot, veim levana, maale achat min hallevanot, vehashshear chullin keshehayu:

Iggule devela. develot teenim hannidrasim beiggul, gedolim maalim et hakketannim, im yesh sham chamishshim iggulim ketannim veesrim vachamishsha iggulim gedolim, veechad min haggedolim kishnayim min hakketannim, venafal letochan iggul katan shel teruma, mesayyeot kullan levattel. vechen iggulim umalbenim. iggulim hem hannidrasot beiggul, malbenim, teenim hannidrasot betzurat ribbua kemin defus sheosim bo hallevenim merubbaot:
Verabbi eliezer oser. im shechora nafla hashshechorot asurot, veim levana nafla hallevanot asurot, vechen bigdolim uketannim, veiggulim umalbenim, haddomin leotah shennafla asurim:

Beyadua ma nafla. shechora o levana, en maalot, lefi sheyyachol leechol haacherot, vechevan demuttarot hen en mesayyeot levattel. aval im en yadua im shechora nafla o levana nafla, kevan dechullan besafek issur, maalot zo et zo. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Ed omer nitmet veed omer lo nitmet. oke chad lahade chad, vahare hi bisfeka veshota. vedavka ki atu bahade hadade, aval baze achar ze, kesheamar harishon nitmet, have meheman kevitre, vehashsheni haomer lo nitmet have leh chad, veen devarav shel echad bimkom shenayim:

Ushenayim omrim lo nitmet. kelomar lo nitmet befanecha, shekkeshebbata umatzat shennisteru yachad gam anu hayinu immecha uvefanenu lo nitmet, hare nistallek haed uvatlu devarav mippene hashshenayim, vahare hi bisfeka im nitmet kodem shebbau ellu umetzaum, ulefichach shota. veashmuinan tanna behane tere bave dematnitin devifsule edut halech achar rov deot ben lekulla ben lechumra, kelomar ben lehashekotah ben shello lehashekotah:
Kotel haulam. ovi kotel haulam letzad mizrach chamesh ammot. vechen kotel hahechol avyo shesh letzad mizrach:
Vetocho. chalalo shel hechol arbaim amma:

Veamma teraksin. kotel hammafsik ben hahechol leven kadshe hakkodashim karuy teraksin, al shem shessoger al haaron vehalluchot shennittenu besinay. terak belashon arammi segira, kemo teruke galli [berachot koach.]. sin, sinay. veavyo shel kotel ze, amma. velo hichriu bo chachamim i kedushshato kikdushshat penim o kikdushshat chutz, lefichach asu bevayit sheni shete parochot, achat chitzona veachat penimit, uvenehen avir amma, liklot benehen avir mekom hakkotel shehaya avyo amma:

Kotel hahechol shesh. kevar perashnu leel shello haya kotel hahechol shebbetzad maarav avyo shesh, ella ovi kotel hahechol im hammakom happanuy shebbeno uven hakkotel hashsheni shechutza lo haya shesh ammot. voovi kotel hashsheni shekkaruy ta im hammakom happanuy shebbeno uven hakkotel hashshelishi shesh ammot. voovi hakkotel hashshelishi shekkaruy kotel hatta im hammakom happanuy shebbeno uven hakkotel harvii hachitzon haya chamesh ammot. usheloshet hammekomot happenuyin shebben arbaa ketalim hen hattaim. vaalehen taim acherim, keotah sheshshaninu lemala bammaarav shelosha al gabbe shelosha ushenayim al gabbehen. vechen mitztzafon ledarom kotel hammesibba chamesh kulei, kullan im hechalal shebben kotel lechotel, hakkol kemo shepperashti leel:
Chamesh esre amma min hatztzafon. shekkotel haulam avyo chamesh amma, vehaulam eser ammot latztzafon vechen laddarom:
Bet hachalifot. al shem hassakkinim sheggonzim sham, karuy bet hachalifot, shekken bilshon romi korin lassakkinim haggedolim chalafim:
Tzar meachorav. letzad maarav: verachav millefanav. letzad mizrach. velo itparesh li heach, shehare mea al mea haya beshave:
Pitcho shel hechol. shetayim bifnim. boovi hakkotel shekkelappe penim:

Ushetayim bachutz. beavyo shekkelappe hachutz. sheavyo shel kotel hahechol haya shesh ammot, ulesof amma chitzona shel ovi hakkotel hayu haddelatot hachitzonot echad limin happetach veechad lismolo, kol delet mehen rachbah chamesh ammot, ucheshehayu neulot hayu nogot zo vazo vesotmot rochav chalal happetach sherachbo eser ammot, ucheshehayu niftachot letzad penim mechassot chamesh ammot shel ovi hakkotel. ushetayim delatot acherot kemiddot ellu hayu kevuot besof ovi hakkotel letzad penim, ucheshehen niftachot mechassot chamesh ammot mippo vechamesh ammot mippo merochav kotel hahechol bifnim, vesham lo haya hakkotel tuach bezahav kemo shear habbayit, lefi shello haya nire:

Itzteramita. luchot shel perakim mechubbarot al yede chulyot, vehen niftachot, uchesherotze nichpafot venichpalot zo al zo. kach hayu kol haddelatot hallalu ben shellifnim ben shellachutz mechubbarot al yede chulyot, ulesof chatzi amma shel ovi hakkotel hayu kevuot, ben haddelatot shebbifnim ben otan shebbachutz, vechamesh ammot shel ovi hakkotel mafsikot ben haddelatot hachitzonot laddelatot happenimiyyot. vechol delet haya chamesh ammot mechubbar mishshete luchot, kol luach shete ammot umechetza, ucheshenniftach haddelet hachitzon letzad penim haya chetzyo nichpaf venichpal ze al ze, umechasse meovi hakkotel ammatayim vachetzi, vechen haddelet hakkavua bifnim keshenniftach letzad chutz haya af hu nichpaf venichpal umechasse haammatayim vachetzi shennisharu meovi hakkotel:
Shenneemar ushetayim delatot laddelatot shetayim. alma kol delet vedelet hayta chaluka lishtayim:
Sea teruma temea shennafla lefachot mimmea chullin. ditruma temea nammi ola beachat umea:

Yerakevu. dei efshar lakkohen leachlah, mishshum teruma temea. veha delo tenan yiddalku, mishshum dechayshinan dilma addemadlik lehu ate behu lide takkala veate lemechol minnayhu, mishshum dedimmua kil lehu leinshe velo mizdahare veh kulle hay:
Im tehora hayta otah sea. vegam hachullin tehorim, yimmachru lakkohanim bidme teruma, sheddameha pechutim lefi sheen lah ochlim merubbim, vegam im nitmet lo chazya laachila:
Chutz middeme otah sea. shetztzarich littenah lakkohen:
Veim lemaaser rishon. tahor shello nittela mimmennu terumat maaser nafla, yevakkesh min hallevi sheyyachalifem lo bechullin, veyaasem hallevi terumat maaser al tivlo:
Veim lemaaser sheni vehekdesh tehorim nafla. yippadu veyochal deme hammaaser birushalayim, vehaddimmua yimkor lakkohanim bidme teruma chutz middeme otah sea:

Veim temeim hayu. hachullin vehammaaser rishon shennafla vahen teruma tehora, dehashta lo matze limavdinhu terumat maaser al makom acher, mafrish alav terumat maaser veyimkerennu lakkohanim, veyochlum hakkohanim nikkudim, perush beyovesh, kemo yavesh haya nekudim (Yehoshua 9):
O kelayot. ki hechi delo titkashar hatteruma hattehora sheyyesh bah lekabbel tuma, dechol ochel shello va alav mashke mishshiva mashkim eno muchshar lekabbel tuma:
O yilloshu veme ferot. kegon me tutim verimmonim, delo machshere:

O yechallekum leissot. sheyyitten pachot mikkabbetza bechol issa veissa, deochel shehu pachot mikkabbetza eno mekabbel tumat ochalim, veeno mittamme tumat ochalim. vei kashya may shena missea teruma temea shennafla bechullin tehorim deamrinan yerakvu mishshum deose hakkol teruma venechshav kitruma temea utehora shennitarvu, veim ken teruma tehora vechullin temeim nammi shennitarvu yechashvu kitruma tehora utemea shennitarvu veyihyu asurim baachila. veyesh lomar delo dami, dilel hanach chullin naasu kitruma leaser lezarim mikkoach teruma temea, hilkach lakkohanim nammi asire kedin teruma temea, aval hanach chullin dehacha en naasim teruma ella mikkoach teruma tehora, hilkach sharyan lakkohanim kitruma tehora:

Veellu sheen zazin mimmekoman. dehanach dilel holchim ad haggevul vesham shomin divre chohen, vechozrim min hammaaracha letoch eretz yisrael, veen chozrin levattehen ella oskim lesappek mayim umazon laholchim lammilchama. veellu en zazin mimmekoman vaafillu lalechet ad hassefar velashuv al pi kohen:
Habbone vayit vachanacho. velo dar bo adayin shana. vechen hannotea kerem vechillelo, vaadayin lo avra shana reviit shelema alav:
Naki yihye leveto. bishvil beto:
Yihye. leribbuya hu. hosif lecha hakkatuv havaya acheret lihyot kazo:
Ilane serak. kegon arazim veshikmim sheenam osim peri:
Vehammachazir et gerushato. veersah, eno chozer, sheenah chadasha lo, ukera ketiv ishsha chadasha:
Almana. veersah kohen gadol, eno chozer bishvilah, dichtiv velo lekachah, vehaya efshar lomar velo lakach, may lekachah, shettehe reuya lo lilkicha:
Al mechono. setaro uvenao kemidda rishona. eno chozer, delav chadash hu, vegara mehallokeach vehayyoresh:
Habbone vet levenim bashsharon. makom hu sheshshemo sharon, veen hakkarka shello yafa lilvenim, velo have davar shel keyama, shehayu tzerichin lechaddeshah shene peamim kol sheva shanim:
Birchot kohen gadol. beyom hakkippurim, leachar shekkalta avodat hayyom kore vattora umevarech shemone berachot:
Chazzan hakkeneset. shammash hakkeneset shettorach iske hakkeneset alav lehachenis ulehotzi lehafeshit et hatteva ulehachin [hakkol]:
Rosh hakkeneset. al piv nechtachin divre hakkeneset, mi yifros al shema, mi yaftir bannavi, mi yered lifne hatteva:
Segan. hammuchan tachat kohen gadol. sheim yeera bo pesul yeshammesh tachtav:
Vehassegan lechohen gadol. vechullan mishshum kevodo shel kohen gadol, dichtiv (Mishlei 14) berav am haderat melech:
Vechohen gadol omed umekabbel. mikkelal deyoshev haya, shema minnah beezrat nashim haya kore. dei beezrat yisrael kayma lan en yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilvad:
Vekore achare mot. shehu misseder yom hakkippurim:

Veach beasor. shebbefarashat shor o kesev, dismucha hi lefarashat achare mot veyachol liglol sefer tora lesham beod shehammeturgeman metargem pasuk acharon shel parashat achare mot, veen kan shahut kede sheyyafsik hammeturgeman:

Vegolel et hattora. veaf al pi sheadayin lo kara beasor shel chummash happekudim, yikra otah al pe velo yiglol sefer tora lesham, mippene shehu rachok veyesh shahut sheyyafsik hatturgeman veikka genay latztzibbur. velikrot bishne sifre tora i efshar, lefi sheen adam echad kore bishne sifre tora batztzibbur, mishshum pegamo shel sefer tora harishon:
Yoter mimma shekkariti lifnechem. ma sheani atid likrot od al pe, al tomru shechaser min hassefer hazze lechach eni gollo sham. vechol kach lamma, shello lehotzi laaz al sefer tora:
Al hattora. beracha shelleachareha:
Veal haavoda. retze Adonai‏ elohenu:
Veal hahodaya. modim anachnu lach:
Veal mechilat avon. atta vechartanu, shechotem bah melech mochel vesoleach laavonotenu:
Veal hammikdash. shettishre shechina bevet hammikdash, vechotem bah baruch atta Adonai‏ shochen betziyyon:
Veal hakkohanim. sheyyekubbal karbenotehem beratzon. vechotem bah mekaddesh hakkohanim:
Veal shear hattefilla. sheyyehu yisrael noshain meoyvehem. vechotem bah ammecha yisrael tzerichim yeshua baruch atta Adonai‏ shomea tefilla:
Echad habbone veechad hallokeach. bayit banuy, shehare etzlo hu chadash:
Veechad hannotea chamishsha ilane maachol. divhachi have kerem, shetayim keneged shetayim, veachat yotzet zanav:
Vaafillu mechameshet minim. mitztarfim:
Meshuach milchama. vedibber el haam bilshon hakkodesh. neemar kan (Devarim 20) vedibber el haam, veneemar lehallan (Shemot 19) moshe yedabber, ma lehallan bilshon hakkodesh, af kan bilshon hakkodesh:
Lechol koshel. kol hakkoshlim sheenan yecholin lalechet beraglehen:
Hagafat terisin. hakkaat hammaginnim zo bezo lehashemia kol uleayyem:
Hakkalgassin. maklot sherashehen akumim umakkin bahem al gabbe avanim vehem menattezim al haoyvim:
Shovach. sar tzava hadadezer bishmuel (2 10):
Bechova uvindava. shennitarvu kinne chova shemmiktzatan chattaot umiktzatan olot im kinne nedava shekkullan olot:
Aval bechova shennitarva zo vazo. ken setuma shel yoledet o shel zava shennitarev beken shel yoledet o shel zava acheret:

Mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. umakriv mehaarbaa hameoravim shenayim bilvad, echad leola veechad lechattat velo yoter, dei avid shete olot shemma yaase otan mikken echad, vechol ken setuma hu echad ola veechad chattat:

Hammuat kasher. im nitarev ken echad setuma bishne kinnim acherim o bishlosha, eno yachol lehakeriv ella ken echad, perida achat lechattat uferida achat leola. aval shete olot lo matze avid, shemma yikkach hakken shehu mevorar techilla leyoledet achat sheeno yachol laasot mimmennu ella echad chattat veechad ola. vechen im nitarvu asara kinnin bemea, eno makriv mikkullan ella asara kinnin, miktzatan chattaot umiktzatan olot, vehashshear pesulin, vezehu hammuat kasher:
Ben mishshem echad. leda veleda, ziva veziva, mishshete nashim o meishsha echat:
Ben mishshene shemot. leda veziva, ben mishshete nashim ben meishsha achat. kedimfaresh veazel:

Ushene fishpashin. shene petachim ketannim echad mimin shaar haggadol shel hechol veechad missemolo, rechokim ketzat min hashshaar. oto shebbaddarom ketiv sagur yihye lo yippateach, beshel atid, umissetama kach haya bevet olamim:

Ufatach et happishpash venichnas. mishsham latta. vehi lishka achat happetucha lahechol. umin hatta nichnas lahechol, veholech bachalal hahechol ad hashshaar haggadol shebbesof ovi hakkotel mibbifnim, ufotcho uva lo el shaar hashsheni shebbesof ovi hakkotel mibbachutz, veomed bifnim ufotcho:

Rabbi yehuda omer betoch avyo shel kotel haya mehallech. kasavar demin hatta lo haya nichnas lahechol, ella min hatta haya mehallech betoch avyo shel kotel ad shennimtza omed ben shene hashshearim, ufoteach et delatot shel shaar hachitzon mibbifnim, udelatot shel shaar happenimi mibbachutz:
Bet shammay osrim. desavre teruma temea shennitarva bithora enah ola beechad umea, kedimfaresh taama lekamman:

Leachar shehodu. bet shammay ledivre vet hillel. mishshum dehikshu lahem bet hillel levet shammay, uma teruma tehora shehi bemita etzel hazzarim ola, temea shehi baase etzel kohen lo kol shekken, vechazru vet shammay lehorot kedivre vet hillel:
Terom vetissaref. vehashshear muttar:
Avda vemiutah. kevan dehakkol teruma veen kan gezel hashshevet, afillu litrom en tzarich. vahalacha kachachamim:

Taale veteachel. beha mode rabbi eliezer deaf otah sea neechelet, mishshum dilel teruma temea nafla, af al pi shennitbattela bachullin hattehorim, mikkol makom keshemmagbihah shem teruma aleha vechozeret lishmah harishon. aval hacha dithora nafla, af al pi shehachullin hayu temeim, keshemmagbihah chazra leshem teruma tehora kemo shehayta:

Kara shem. vetzarich litrom uleasser mittocho, veeno yachol lehaferish alav mimmakom acher. veaf al gav derachmana karye litruma reshit uvainan sheyyihyu sheyareha nikkarim, kevan deamar betocho, mashma beemtza hakkeri tehe hatteruma, veha ikka sevivav shehem sheyareha nikkarim:
Ad sheyyomar bitzfono o vidromo. af al gav divtocho mashma beemtzaito, lo have makom mesuyyam, vahare hu keillu lo amar kelum ad sheyyomar bitzfono o vidromo. vechen halacha:
Terumat hakkeri mimmennu alav kara shem. delo vainan sheyareha nikkarim:

Issur maaser ze vechulei. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov paleg arabbi shimon deamar terumat maaser ze betoch hakkeri kara shem, vekaamar ditrumat maaser ze betocho kodem shehufrash hammaaser lo kara shem, aval leachar shehufrash hammaaser im amar terumat maaser alav kara shem. velet hilcheta kechad minnayhu ella kachachamim bilvad:
Afillu echad beribbo yamutu chullan. velo vatle verubba, devaale chayyim chashive velo vatle:

Chattat shennitarva vechova. ben yona o tor shel chattat shennitarva bishne kinnin shel chova, dehaynu kinnin setama shel yoledet o shel zava, shekkol ken mehen hu echad ola veechad chattat, venimtza atta chamesh peridot meoravot yachad:

En kasher ella minyan chattaot shebbachova. veeno yachol lehavi meellu hechamesh peridot rak shete chattaot bilvad, shezzehu minyan hakkasher bishne kinnin shel chova. dei avid shalosh chattaot, shemma min hashshene kinnin avid lehu velo min hammeoravot bahen, umishshene kinnin en yecholim laasot rak shete chattaot. velo matze avid afillu ola achat, deshemma yikkach hachattat hammeorevet:
Vechen ola. ben yona o tor shehufrash leshem ola:
Shennitarva vechova. bishne kinnin setama:
En kasher ella minyan olot shebbachova. kidfareshna leel gabbe chattat:
Ben shehachova merubba vehannedava muetet. kegon shekken echad meforash shehen olot, nitarev im kamma kinnin setama shel yoledet o shel zava shekkol ken mehen echad chattat veechad ola:
Ben vechulei. kegon ken echad setuma, shennitarev bechamma kinnin shel olot. vekarinan leolot meforashot nedava, mishshum dindarim unedavot kullan olot keditnan beresh pirkin:
Ketzad. kemo minnayin:
Ulehallan hu omer. babberachot ukelalot shel har gerizzim:

Ma aniyya haamura lehallan bilshon hakkodesh. dichtiv (sham 27) veamru el kol ish yisrael kol ram, uchetiv hatam (Shemot 19) vehaelohim yaanennu bekol, ma lehallan bilshon hakkodesh, af kan bilshon hakkodesh:
Shebbeshomron. etzel shomron:
Mikkan umikkan. al heharim:
Beshivim lashon. bichtav shel shivim ummot, vechol harotze lelamdah yavo veyilmod. shello yihye pitchon pe laummot lomar lo haya lanu mehechan lilmod:
Et haavanim. satru et hammizbeach leachar sheheelu haolot vehashshelamim:
Velanu vimkoman. bevet melonam baggilgal, vesham hekimu et haavanim:
