Ayin yafa echad mearbaim. mi shehu nediv lev vetorem beayin yafa mafrish echad mearbaim:
Vehabbenonit echad mechamishshim. lav divre vet shammay ninhu ella tanna kamma kaamar la. umeayin yafa devet shammay atta lamed ledivrehem ayin raa uvenonit af al gav delo tane la bematnitin:
Veala veyado echad mishshishshim. kegon shettaram meomed veala veyado echad mishshishshim vehu ayin raa:
Chazar vehosif chayyav bemaasrot. dichvar nifteru veen shem teruma chal al ma shemmosif, hilkach hattosefet hazzot haveya tevel gamur vechayyevet bemaasrot:
Mishshishshim veechad. kegon shehayu vakkeri shishshim veechad sein veala veyado sea, otah sea teruma:

Veyachazor veyitrom kemo shehu lamud. [im hu ragil] litrom echad mishshishshim yafrish adayin echad mishshishshim bassea, veim hu ragil litrom echad mechamishshim nimtzeu denisharu adayin achat esre sein shello nitremu:
Bemidda uvemishkal. kelomar oto motar shehu torem, muttar litrom bemidda uvemishkal uveminyan. delo amru litrom meomed (leel 81 47), ella bitchillat hatteruma:
Af shello min hammukkaf. desavar rabbi yehuda en tzarich litrom min hammukkaf ella bitchillat teruma. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Mukkaf. karov vesamuch uveoto makom atzmo:
Taim. leshachot:

Chamishsha asar batztzafon. lekamman befirkin ki chashiv mitztzafon ledarom shivim amma, ka tane kotel hammesibba chamesh, vehammesibba shalosh, kotel hatta chamesh, vehatta shesh, vechotel hahechol shesh. uchenegdan kachashiv baddarom. velav lememra doovi kotel hammesibba voovi kotel hatta voovi kotel hahechol shelletzad tzafon haya kach, ella ovi hakkotel im hechalal shebbeno uven hakkotel hashsheni hu mone, uvechamesh shel kotel hammesibba veshalosh shel mesibba vechamesh shel kotel hatta veshesh shel hatta veshesh shel kotel hahechol, bechol echad meellu hachamishsha hayta lishka achat dehaynu ta, hare chamishsha taim batztzafon. uchenegdan baddarom. veal ellu hachamishsha hayu benuyin chamishsha acherim, veod chamishsha al gabbehen, hare chamishsha asar taim latztzafon vachamishsha asar laddarom. vechen bammaarav kachashiv lekamman befirkin kotel hahechol shesh vehatta shesh vechotel hatta chamesh, bechol echad mehem haya lishka, shello haya hakkotel av shesh ella hakkotel im hatta shebbo haya shesh, vehatta [haacher] shechutzah lo haya shesh, vechotel hatta haacher shechutz lahem im hatta shebbo haya chamesh, hare shalosh leshachot. veshalosh leshachot acherot benuyot al gabbe ellu hashshalosh, ushetayim al gabbehen, hare shemona taim lammaarav:

Veechad lappishpash. latta sheyyesh bo happishpash hatztzefoni, shebbeoto ta nichnasim lahechol. usetam matnitin kerabbanan deamre leel nichnas latta umin hatta lahechol. delo kerabbi yehuda deamar betoch avyo shel kotel haya mehallech:
Ketzad. leferushe milleteh derabbi akiva kaate:
Uvezo rabbi eliezer machmir. beha detaninan leel, aval bemay devaena lememar lekamman have ippecha:
Kedato shel baal habbayit. lefi sheyyesh torem beayin yafa, veyesh beayin raa, veyesh bevenonit:
Pichet asara. vetaram mearbaim:
O hosif asara. vetaram mishshishshim:
Terumato teruma. dechevan divechad mishshiure chachamim taram, yachol lememar leh ana lehachi amadticha:
Veim nitkavven lehosif. shehaya yodea dato shel baal habbayit uvemitkavven hosif, afillu echad, en terumato teruma:

Lishkat happarva. adam mechashshef sheshshemo parva bana otah lishka al yede mechashshefut, venikret al shemo. kach matzati. verambam katav, shehaya choter bakkir kede lirot mishsham heach haya kohen oved haavoda veneherag sham:

Veal gaggah haya vet hattevila lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim. chamesh tevilot shettovel kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim keshehu meshanne mibbigde zahav levigde lavan umibbigde lavan levigde zahav, kullam hayu al gag bet happarva, lefi shehayta mekuddeshet bikdushshat haazara. utevilot habbaot mechamat yom hakkippurim bainan bemakom kadosh kedichtiv (Vayikra 16) verachatz et besaro vammayim bemakom kadosh. chutz mittevila rishona sheenah baa bishvil yom hakkippurim, sheaf shear kol yemot hashshana en adam tahor nichnas laazara ad sheyyitbol, hilkach tevila rishona hayta bachol al gabbe shaar hammayim, hu shaar hashshelishi shebbaddarom, umayan shel mayim haya mashuch sham baamma habbaa meen etam, vesham haya tovel tevila harishona:
Mesibba. binyan avanim maalot megulgalot vesovvot laalot legag bet happarva derech hammesibba:

Rabbi yose omer kulei. lav mishshum desavar rabbi yose yesh berera venema dichshehikriv hakkohen ken echad leshem achat mehen huvrar haddavar lemafrea demittechilla bishat lekichat hakken haya ken ze shellah, ella mefaresh baggemara beferek bakkol mearvin [eruvin daf lo] derabbi yose mayre beshehitnu vishat lekicha sheyyuchal hakkohen laasot ken sheyyirtze leshem ezo ishsha sheyyirtze. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Bamme devarim amurim. ha defaleg rabbi akiva leel veamar terumat shenehem teruma:
Beshello dibber. shello natal reshut mechavero litrom ella taram middato:
Aval hirsha. shennatan baal habbayit reshut litrom, terumato teruma:
Bittel. im leachar shemminna shaliach litrom bittel shelichuto leachar shehalach hashshaliach millefanav:

Chutz. bealim amme haaretz shehiskiru poalim chaverim kede lehaferish teruma betohora, rashshaim litrom ad shello yiggeu vo habbealim amme haaretz vitammeu et hatteruma, mippene shehen metammeim et haggat, shehabbealim amme haaretz miyyad keshehitchilu haddorchim lidroch vehalchu vaggat sheti vaerev enam nizharim yoter milligga begittan umetammeim otah, lefi shehem choshvim shemmiyyad keshehitchilu lidroch hifrishu hachaverim teruma gedola. hilkach mafrishim hachaverim haddorchim min hayyayin kede shiur teruma hatztzericha lechol haggat miyyad keshehalchu vah sheti vaerev, sheim yavou bealim vitammeu haggat kodem sheyyigmeru yesh lahen yayin mezumman lehaferish al hakkol betohora:

Vetabbaot hayu bitzfono shel mizbeach. lefi shello hayu koftim et hattamid keditnan bemassechet tamid, hitkin yochanan kohen gadol esrim vearba tabbaot leesrim vearbaa mishmerot kehunna, vehayu kevuot baritzpa asuyot kemin keshet shehayu machnisim bahen tzavvar behema bishat shechita venoatzim rosh hattabbaat baaretz. vehayu litzfono shel mizbeach, lefi shekkadshe kadashim shechitatan batztzafon:
Shemona ammudim nannasim. ammudim shel even nemuchin:
Ureviin shel erez. chatichot merubbaot shel erez hayu al haammudim:
Veunkelayot. keen mazlegot, ntzynysh belaaz:
Hayu kevuin. beotan reviin shel erez, vetolin bahen habbehema:
Ushelosha sedarim. shel unkelayot zo lemala mizzo hayu bechol chatichat etz, litlot behema gedola o ketanna:
Al shulchanot shel shayish. shealehen medichin hakkeravayim, lefi shehashshayish mekarer umetzannen veshomer habbasar shello yasriach:
Egla arufa bilshon hakkodesh. ma shehazzekenim omrim yadenu lo shafchu et haddam hazze vehakkohanim omrim kapper leammecha yisrael vegomer, bilshon hakkodesh huzkeku leamran:
Shenneemar ki yimmatze kulei. uveoto parasha neemar veanu veamru, veneemar lehallan (Devarim 27) veanu haleviyyim veamru, ma lehallan bilshon hakkodesh, af kan bilshon hakkodesh:
Hayu yotzim. uvaim sham umoddim min hechalal letzad haayarot shessevivotav leda ezo kerova:
En bet din shakul. en bet din asuyin sheyyehe efshar lachlok shave beshave, ella sheyyehe harov letzad echad lekayyem achare rabbim lehattot. (Shemot 23):
Bammedina omer otah shalosh berachot. shemafsikin hakkohanim ben pasuk lefasuk, veonim hatztzibbur amen:
Uvammikdash beracha echat. lefi sheen onim amen bammikdash veen kan shum hefsek:
Kichtavo. beYod hei:

Bechinnuyo. beAlef dalet. sheen mazkirin hashshem kichtavo ella bammikdash bilvad, shenneemar (Shemot 20) bechol hammakom asher azkir et shemi avo elecha uverachticha, sares hammikra vedarshehu, bechol hammakom asher avo elecha uverachticha, dehaynu bammikdash, sham azkir et shemi:

Keneged kitfehen. mippene shetztzarich nesiat kappayim, dichtiv vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayvarchem, uchetiv (Devarim 18) hu uvanav kol hayyamim, ma hu binsiut kappayim, af banav binsiat kappayim kol hayyamim:
Uvammikdash. shemmevarchim et haam bashshem hammeforash ushechina lemala mikkishre etzbeotehem, magbihim yedehem lemala merashehem:
Sheen magbiah yadav lemala min hatztzitz. mippene shehashshem katuv bo. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Ze karuy teruma vereshit. bikkurim keruyin teruma, deamar mar [pesachim lach:] uterumat yadcha (Devarim 12) ellu bikkurim dichtiv behu (sham 26) velakach hakkohen hattene miyyadecha. ukeruyin reshit, reshit bikkure admatcha (Shemot 23). teruma keruya teruma, et mishmeret terumotay (Bamidbar 18), ukeruya reshit degancha (Devarim 18):
Bikkurim shehen bikkurim lakkol. leshon bikkurim daresh, lechach karinhu rachamana bikkurim. i nammi mishshum dichtive befarashat ki tissa ad shello nitztauu al hatterumot:
Sheyyesh bo reshit. divmaaser rishon yesh bo terumat maaser, vehatteruma keruya reshit, lefichach din hu sheyyakdim rishon lashsheni:

Ken setuma. shello feresh zo chattat vezo ola. velo mibbaya meforeshet, difshita sheim parach haechad yikkach zug lashsheni kevan shehen nifrashim ze mizze vechol echad shemo alav. ella afillu setuma sheadayin hem yachad veomdim lehitparesh vesalka datach amena sheim parach haechad yamut hashsheni, kamashma lan:
Leven hammetot. leven kinnin shemmishpatan sheyyamutu chullam, kegon chattat shennitarva veola ditnan behu beferek kamma yamutu chullam:
Leven hakkerevot. leven kinnin setumot haomdot likkarev:
Pasul ufosel echad kenegdo. lefi shehu setam velo nitparesh im chattat im ola, lefichach eno fosel ella echad kenegdo, kedimfaresh veazel:
Ken setuma. shello feresh ezo chattat veezo ola:

Veken meforeshet. sheyyadua shezzo chattat vezo ola. vehacha mayre shennitarvu shete happeridot yachad achar shehayu meforashot vehasheta en yadua ezo chattat veezo ola, vehachi muchach bassefa dekatane o shepparach min hameforeshet rishon lassetuma yamutu chullam, veim lo nitarvu feridot hameforashot zo vazo ammay yamutu, veim haola farcha, hachattat hannisheret tikkarev, veken hassetuma yakrivu vah ola achat mippene haola shennitarva vah. ella mayre shennitarvu feridot hameforashot zo vazo, veim nitarva ferida achat min hakken hassetuma letoch hameforeshet, yikkach zug lashsheni veyafrish echad chattat veechad ola, vehashshelosha shennitarvu yachad yamutu chullan. chazar echad min hashshelosha shennitarvu venitarev im hayechidi hannishar bassetuma, o bitchillat happericha nitarev echad min hameforashot lassetuma, vehayenu rishon dekaamar, kelomar shebbitchillat pericha halach echad venitarev bassetuma, yamutu chullan, dechevan shepperidot hameforashot nitarvu yachad enan kerevin od, vechi farach echad mehen bemakom acher hayenu echad min hammetot shepparach leven hakkerevot, yamutu chullan:

Hammafrish miktzat teruma umaasrot. kegon shehaya lo mea sein tevel vehotzi mehen sea teruma uvedato lehaferish adayin hashshear, chozer umotzi meoto hakkeri atzmo ad sheyyashlim shene sein keshiur hatteruma, dehattevel hu sheyyaale veyado velo ma shekkevar metukkan:

Aval lo lemakom acher. im yesh lo mea sein acherim shel tevel eno yachol lehaferish alehen meellu shehotzi miktzat terumatan, dilgabbe acherim talinan dilma min hametukkan hu motzi alehen velo min hattevel shebbo, verabbi meir share af lemakom acher. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Beoto hakkeren. shel maaravit deromit:
Shebbo yordin lashshit. lechalal shettachat hammizbeach keneged mekom hannesachim:

Vechevesh haya lidromo shel mizbeach. kemin gesher meshuppa veasuy midron shebbo olin veyordin min hammizbeach. shello haya efshar laalot lo bemaalot mishshum shenneemar (Shemot 20) velo taale bemaalot al mizbechi: sheloshim ushetayim. arko haya natun middarom letzafon, verachbo mimmizrach lemaarav shesh esre amma:
Urevuva. kemin challon chalul. veamma al amma haya, uvakkevesh atzmo lemaaravo haya omed:
Revuva. kemo nevuva, leshon nevuv luchot:
Notnim pesule chattat haof. sheyyihyu sham ad sheyyavou lide notar veachar kach yetzu levet hasserefa:
Rabbi eliezer omer mittibburo. kasavar ikkar chayyuta vetibbureh hu:
Rabbi akiva omer mechatmo. ikkar chayyuta mechatmo hu, dichtiv (Bereshit 7) kol asher nishmat ruach chayyim beappav:

Mimmekom shennaase chalal mitztzavvaro. deen karuy chalal ella min hatztzavvar, kedichtiv (Yechezkel 21) al tzavvere challe reshaim, hilkach mimmennu hayu moddim, kedichtiv el hechalal. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Kol haazara. kol hekkef haazara, shebbetoch oto hekkef nivna habbayit letzad maaravo, vehechatzer vehammizbeach bemizracho:
Orech mea ushemonim vasheva. min hammizrach lammaarav:
Al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh. min hatztzafon laddarom:
Mekom derisat ragle yisrael. vehi hannikret ezrat yisrael. umekom derisat ragle hakkohanim keruya ezrat kohanim:
Hammizbeach shenayim usheloshim. meforash leel resh perek 3:

Hahechol mea amma. ovi kotel ulam, vachalalo shel ulam, voovi kotel hahechol, vachalalo, veamma teraksin, vachalal bet kadshe hakkodashim, vechotel hahechol lammaarav, vehatta vechotel hatta, hakkol mea amma kammeforash befirkin dilel:
Veachat esre amma achore bet hakkapporet. mikkotel hachitzon shel hechol letzad maarav ad hakkotel maaravi shel azara haya achat esre amma shel chalal im ovi hakkotel, karuy achore bet hakkapporet:

Nimtza rosho bemakom echad. hasheta lo mayre tanna leinyan medida. demiddekatane sefa meayin hayu moddin, mikkelal deresha lav bammedida askinan. ella bemet mitzva kana mekomo askinan, dehecha denimtza rosho bemakom echad vegufo bemakom acher, molichin rosho etzel gufo vekovrin oto bammakom shennimtza hagguf, degufeh beducheteh nafal veresha hu denayed, divre rabbi eliezer:
Rabbi akiva omer molichin hagguf etzel harosh. deresha hecha denafel nafel vegufeh rahet veazel. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Shehaya vedin. shello yehe neeman bah ed echad, im lo miggezerat hakkatuv:
Edut harishona. setira:
Sheen osartah issur olam. ella ad shettishte:
Enah mitkayyemet befachot mishshenayim. kidvainan lememar miggezera shava, verabbi yehoshua hi:
Edut haacharona. tuma:

Kol edut sheyyesh bah. neeman bah, dichtiv veed en bah, vechol ed haamur battora setam eno ella shenayim, middeitzterich kera lomar (Devarim 19) lo yakum ed echad beish, shema minnah deed shenayim bammashma, ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv echad. vehachi kaamar kera, tere let bah ella chad, vekaamar vehi lo nitpasa, leosrah, alma ed echad meheman:
Shete kuppot. bechol achat chamishshim sea:

Veen yadua leezo mehen nafla. ushetehen asurot missafek, mesayyeot zo et zo levattel, veim ratza lehaalot sea mizzo maale, mizzo maale, mechetza mizzo umechetza mizzo maale. ushete kuppot afillu hen bishne vattim veen yadua leezo mehen nafla sea shel teruma, maalot zo et zo, mippene sheddarkan lehitpannot, vehen mittaltelot mimmakom lemakom, ufeamim shemmitarvot zo im zo. aval shete megurot, sheenan mittaltelot, bizman sheshshetehen bevayit echad, maalot zo et zo, veim hen bishne [vattim] en maalot zo et zo:
Rabbi shimon omer afillu hen bishte ayarot. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Hachi garsinan rum maala chatzi amma veshilchah amma, amma amma veroved shalosh, amma amma veroved shalosh, haelyona amma amma veroved arba. rabbi yehuda omer haelyona amma amma veroved chamesh. kach katav rabbi baruch shemmatza benuschaot yeshanot meduyyakot. vehachi perushah, rum, gova hammaala, chatzi amma, kemo shehayu kullan:
Veshilchah. dehaynu meshech rochav hammaala, shezzehu midrach haregel, haya amma. umaala sheniyya ushelishit, kol achat haya shilchah amma, vehayenu amma amma dekatane:

Veroved shalosh. maala reviit haya rachbah shalosh ammot. veroved dekatane, hayenu shura shel ritzpa, kemo mukkaf revadim shel even, al haroved harvii shebbaazara. lefi sheharitzpa hayta rechava belo maala, umishshum hachi lo amar shilchah shalosh, ella roved shalosh, kelomar shurat haritzpa:
Veamma amma. kelomar maala chamishit veshishshit, kol achat haya shilchah amma:
Veroved shalosh. maala sheviit haya rachbah shalosh ammot:

Haelyona amma amma veroved arba. perush, hammaala haelyona shehi hammaala shel shetem esre leachar arba maalot shehaya lechol achat amma, hammaala haelyona hayta rechava arba ammot ad haulam. nimtzeu kol hammaalot tesha esre ammot min harishona ad haulam. veshalosh ammot rochav shel ritzpa chalaka haya min hammizbeach ad techillat hammaalot, hare esrim ushetayim ammot ben haulam velammizbeach:
Rabbi yehuda omer haelyona vechulei‏ roved chamesh. ad haulam. desavar lesof shete ammot shel mizbeach matchilot hammaalot:
Ad sheyyihyu fiv velibbo shavin. dichtiv (sham 23) motza sefatecha tishmor, uchetiv (Shemot 34) kol nediv lev, ha ketzad, bainan gomer belibbo umotzi visfatav:
Shennafla achat mehen. agudda achat kayyotze vahen, veenah nikkeret mibbenehen. veotah agudda hayta chetzyah chullin vechetzyah teruma:

Shehayu sham mea ushene chatzayim. im hachetzi shel teruma shebbah. veashmeinan rabbi yose sheen haagudda shechetzyah teruma medammaat ella lefi cheshbon teruma shebbah, velo amrinan shehaagudda chullah tedamma, kevan shehi teruma meorevet bechullin:
Chamesh amalteraot. korot metzuyyarot umechuyyarot:
Shel milat. shel ilan sheggedelim bo afatzim shekruyin milin. kidamrinan begittin [daf 19] chayshinan shemma beme milin ketavo:

Hattachtona. hakkora hattachtona mushkevet al mashkof happetach lerachbo shel petach shehu rachav esrim amma, vehakkora odefet al happetach amma mizze veamma mizze, nimtza arkah esrim ushetayim. vekora sheniyya shellemala hemenna odefet al harishona amma mizze veamma mizze, nimtza arkah esrim vearba. vehashshelishit esrim vashesh, veharviit esrim ushemone, vachamishit sheloshim:
Venidbach. shura. kemo nidbachim di even gelal (Ezra 6):
Ben kol achat veechat. chamesh korot ellu lo hayu nogot zo vazo, ella shura shel binyan shel avanim hayta ben zo lazo:

Bashshemini. beshana sheminit shel shemita sheavra, shehi motzae sheviit zo. bemotzae yom tov rishon, dichtiv (Devarim lo) bechag hassukkot, shomea ani afillu beyom tov acharon shel chag, talmud lomar sham bevo kol yisrael leraot, mittechillat chol hammoed:
Agrippas hammelech. mizzaro shel horodus haya, uveyamav nechrav bayit sheni:
Zalgu enav demaot. shehammikra hazze pesalo min hammalchut:
Achinu atta. sheimmo miyyisrael:

Vekore mittechillat elle haddevarim ad shema. shebbevaetchannan. umechabber im parashat shema parashat vehaya im shamoa, sheyyesh befarashat shema kabbalat malchut shamayim uvefarashat vehaya im shamoa kabbalat ol mitzvot. umedalleg, vekore asser teasser. umishsham medalleg vekore ki techalle laser, mippene shehu zeman asif umattenot aniyyim vehaferashat terumot umaasrot. veaf al pi shepparashat hammelech ben asser lechi techalle laser haya kore otam yachad, shello lehafesik bemaasrot. veachar kach berachot ukelalot, shehen kabbalat gezerot voonashim shel tora. vechozer vekore parashat hammelech, som tasim alecha melech:
Lishkat haggola. al shem bor shekkaru sham ole gola:
Abba shaul omer. otah lishkat haetz hi hayta lishkat kohen gadol. vehi lishkat parhedrin ditnan beresh yoma, shiva yamim kodem yom hakkippurim mafrishin kohen gadol mibbeto lelishkat parhedrin:
Vegag shelashtan shave. keruy echad lishlashtan:

Sham hayta sanhedri gedola shel yisrael yoshevet. betzad hachol shebbah. lefi shellishkat haggazit hayta chetzyah bakkodesh vechetzyah bachol, uvechetzyah shel kodesh lo haya efshar lassanhedrin lashevet, sheen yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilvad, dichtiv (Shmuel 2 7) vayavo hammelech david vayeshev lifne Adonai:
Bedores litra ketziot. litra shel teenim yeveshim shel teruma:
Al pi hakkad. shel chullin, veharebe kaddin yesh:

Veen yadua. beeze kad derasah, uvechol kad yesh mea litrot shel chullin, afillu en kan mea kaddin, share rabbi eliezer, veaf al pi sheyyadua hu shehallitra shel teruma hi befi hakkad veenah meorevet im hachullin, roin otan keillu nifredu mimmekoman venitarvu hachullin batteruma, veolin beechad umea. verabbi yehoshua savar kevan deenah meorevet en hattachtonot mesayyeot levattel et haelyonot, ella hashshulayim muttarim vehappumim asurim, ad sheyyihyu sham mea chaddin veyitbattel pi chavit ze bemea fumin, vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Mikra vikkurim. shehaya kore mearammi oved avi (Devarim 26) ad sof happarasha:
Vachalitzat yevama. hi omeret (sham 25) meen yevami lehakim leachiv shem beyisrael lo ava yabbemi, vehu omer lo chafatzti lekachtah, veachar hachalitza omeret kacha yease laish:
Berachot ukelalot. sheamru yisrael behar gerizzim uvehar eval:
Birkat kohanim. nesiat kappayim:
Birchot kohen gadol. beyom hakkippurim achar avodat hayyom shellifnay velifnim hu kore et happarasha battora, umevarech shemone verachot hammeforashot bematnitin:
Ufarashat hammelech. hi parashat hakehel, kedimfaresh besof pirkin:
Ufarashat egla arufa. (sham 21) yadenu lo shafchu et haddam hazze, kapper leammecha yisrael vegomer:
Parashat meshuach milchama. (sham 20) vehaya kekaravchem vegomer‏ shema yisrael attem kerevim hayyom vegomer:

Shenneemar meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher. hachi kaamar af al pi shehu over belo taase shenneemar meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher, af al pi chen ma sheasa asuy. meleatcha ellu habbikkurim shemmitmalleim babbikkur, vedimacha zo teruma, umaaser rishon nammi yesh bo terumat maaser. lo teacher, lo teshanne hasseder:

Hakkalkala. hassal shemmoddim bo lehaferish hammaasrot uterumat maaser, sheen mafrishim otan ella bemidda uveminyan uvemishkal, keditnan (avot 81 56) veal tarbe leasser omadot. aval teruma gedola en mafrishim otah ella meomed keditnan leel (81 47):
Meshaarin et hakkalkala. leda ma sheyyikkansu vah min happerot:
Babbakkurot. bizman shehapperot bevikkurehen hen bemilluan vehakkalkala mechila mehen pachot mimma shehi mechila mehen besof hakkayitz, shekkevar hitchilu lehitztammek vehen tzenumot dakkot:

Uveemtza hakkayitz. shehen mevushshalot veenam metzummakot, hakkalkala machazeket min happerot yoter mimma shemmachazeket mehen keshehen mevukkarot bimloan, ufachot mimma shehi machazeket mehen besof hakkayitz keshekkevar nitztammeku. hilkach meshaarin bishlosha zemannim hallalu:
Uvasseyafot. perot shebbesof hakkayitz:
Hammone meshubbach. min hammotzi beomed:
Vehammoded meshubbach vechulei. vedavka bemaasrot uvitrumat maaser, aval lo vitruma gedola kedifrishit:
Teruma ola beechad umea. sea shel teruma shennafla lemea sein shel chullin, shehem ben hakkol echad umea, notel achat mehen venotnah lakkohen, vehashshear chullin kemo shehayu:

Bemea vaod. im nafla sea shel teruma letoch tisha vetishim sein shel chullin umashshehu yoter mittishim vetisha, veze hammashshehu en lo shiur, hoil veyesh kan mea veod mashshehu, notel sea achat venotnah lakkohen, vehashshear chullin keshehayu:

Kav lemea sea shetut lamdammea. im nafla sea shel teruma betishim vatesha shel chullin vekav yoter, shehakkav hu shetut lassea shel teruma hamedammaat, shehassea shishsha kabbim, az notel sea achat vehashshear chullin keshehayu. aval im hayu hachullin pachot mittishim vetisha vekav, hakkol medumma, veyimmachru chullam lakkohen bidme teruma chutz middeme sea shel teruma shebbah. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer sheen teruma ola befachot meachat umea, desatam lan tanna kevateh bechamma duchete. vehakkol modim sheen hatteruma ola bemea bilvad, vechol shekken befachot mimmea, dichtiv bitrumat maaser (Bamidbar 18) mikkol chelbo et mikdesho mimmennu, davar sheatta torem mimmennu im nafal letocho mekaddesho, vehayenu echad mimmea, demimmea sein mafrishin asara lemaaser rishon, umeotan asara sea litrumat maaser, veamar rachamana sheim chazra otah sea letishim vetisha mekaddashtan venaase hakkol medumma:
Shello yivatu. shello yittu hakketalim lippol mechamat gavhan, vehayu hakkelonasot hallalu hannimshachim mikkotel ze lechotel ze somchim shene hakketalim shello yippelu:
Veroin et haatarot. shebbachallonot shel hechol:

Kol mi shehu mitnaddev. zahav lahechol, verotze shehazzahav atzmo shehitnaddev yitnuhu bahechol lefi shehaya kullo metzuppe zahav, haya ose meoto zahav shemmitnaddev kidmut gargir o ale o eshkol vetole bah:

Venimnu aleha shelosh meot kohanim. mikkoved hazzahav merubbe shehaya bah, hutzrechu shelosh meot kohanim letaltelah ulefannotah mimmakom lemakom. veze echad min hammekomot sheddibberu chachamim leshon havay, delav davka shelosh meot kohanim, velo nitkavven rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok ella lehodia shezzahav harebe hitnaddevu sham:
Nimtza samuch lassefar. etzel gevul haggoyim:
Lo hayu moddim. dichtiv ki yimmatze chalal, perat lemamtzi et atzmo, shessamuch ligvul haggoyim keillu himtzi atzmo lemita hu:

Leir sheen bah bet din lo hayu moddin. en moddin ella meir sheyyesh bah bet din. hachi kaamar, nimtza samuch leir sheen bah bet din, en moddin lah, ella leir sheyyesh bah bet din moddin, ezo ir sheyyesh bah bet din kerova lo. vei lo hadar tanye, hava amina en moddin kelal, talmud lomar velakchu zikne hair, mikkol makom, dehay hair kera yetera hu, dematze lemichtav vehaya hair hakkerova el hechalal veyatzu zekeneha:
Mechuvvan. metzumtzam, sheen zo kerova lo mizzo afillu melo chut:
Shetehen meviot shete agalot divre rabbi eliezer. veen ken halacha, ella shetehen meviot egla achat beshuttefut. vehachi amrinan baggemara bivchorot:
En yerushalayim mevia egla arufa. dichtiv (Devarim 21) baadama asher Adonai‏ elohecha noten lecha nachala lerishtah, perat lirushalayim shello nitchalleka lishvatim:
Bammegura. baotzar, kedichtiv (Chagai 2) haod hazzera bammegura:

Venatan sea leven levi. matnitin ayre befoel chaver habba lisod etzel baal habbayit veeno maamino al hammaasrot, veraa happoel et baal habbayit noten mimmegurato sea leven levi usea leani. rabbi meir omer deoto poel yachol leechol min hammegura shemone seim, demissetama betorat maaser rishon natan lallevi uvetorat maasar ani natan leani, vahare yesh kan shemone seim metukkanim umeat yoter. veaf al pi shello raahu mafrish teruma gedola, lo nechshedu amme haaretz al hatteruma:

Vachachamim omrim lo hifrish baal habbayit ella lefi cheshbon. seudda zo sherotze happoel leechol etzlo, vehashshear mattana bealma hu deyahev lallevi veleani, hilkach en happoel yachol leechol etzlo ad sheyyichlu shemone sein kedivre rabbi meir, ella otah seudda shehaya lo leechol etzlo vetu lo. perush acher venatan sea leven levi usea leani vehalchu lahem, ucheshebba lehaferish shemone sein min hammegura veleechol otam al semach hashshene sein shennatan leven levi velani veeno yodea im otan shene sein kayyamim im lav, rabbi meir omer mafrish shemone sein veochlan al semach otan shene sein shennatan leven levi velani bechezkat shehen kayyamim. vachachamim omrim eno mafrish ella lefi cheshbon hakkayyamim, im kol hashshene sein kayyamim mafrish alehen shemone sein umeat yoter, veim en kayyamim ella chetzyan eno mafrish alehem ella arba sein, lefi cheshbon ma shennimtza mehen kayyamim kach mafrish alehem velo yoter. vahalacha kachachamim:
Veyasfu hashshotrim. al divre kohen:
Bekishre hammilchama. keshemitkashsherin laamod tzefufin shello yefarkum oyvim:

Lefichach. shehayyare zehu hayyare meaverot shebbeyado, talta tora bevana venata veeres lachzor biglalan, kede sheyyitlu bechach hachazara velo yitbayyesh lomar alav meaverot shebbeyado hu yare vechozer:
Rabbi yose omer almana lechohen gadol vechulei. lerabbi yose haggelili afillu avar al divre sofrim chozer. ulerabbi yose ad sheyyaavor al divre tora, dumeya dealmana lechohen gadol:
Mibbikat bet karem. hayu meviim otan:
Min habbetula. karka shello chafru sham meolam:
Vehappegima. poselet baavanim, bechol davar. vaafillu lo nifgemu bevarzel:
Umelabbenim otan. bassid, paamayim bashshana:
Rabbi omer kulei. lo paleg attanna kamma, ella mosif lomar divchol erev shabbat hayu mekannechim otan bemappa mippene haddamim:
Lo hayu sadin oto bechafim. ammilteh detanna kamma mehaddar, keshehayu melabbenim otan besid paamayim bashshana, lo hayu sadin otan bechappot shel bannaim shergilim lasud bo:
Veanta veamra kacha. eno tzarich lelammedah bigzera shava, shemmeatzmah hi lemeda, veanta veamra kacha, kallashon hazze tomar:
Nifteru zikne yerushalayim. sheenan bain ella limdod, kedichtiv veyatzu zekenecha veshoftecha umaddu:
Af al pi sheeno etan kasher. shello neemar etan leikkuva ella lemitzva:
Bekofitz. sakkin gadol:
Meachoreha. mimmul arpah:
Mekomah asur. leolam:
Umuttar lisrok sham pishtan. avoda sheenah begufah shel karka, dichtiv (Devarim 21) asher lo yeaved velo yizzarea, ma zeria meyuchedet shehi begufo shel karka, af kol avoda shehi begufo shel karka:
Lenakker sham avanim. lesattet sham avanim:
Mea al mea. mea orech umea rochav:
Otem. binyan atum vesatum lihyot yesod labbayit, shealav maamidin hakketalim:
Amma kiyyur. hakkora hattachtona shel tikra hayta avyah amma. ulefi shehayta tucha bezahav umetzuyyeret tziyyurim naim nikret kiyyur:

Veammatayim bet dilfa. hakkorot haelyonot hannishanot al hakkora hattachtona haya avyan shete ammot, vehen keruyin bet dilfa, lefi shehannesarin shel tikra mechubbarin al yadan. targum bammachberet, bevet lofe. veen litmoah heach hayta hakkora hattachtona shehakkol nishan alehem avyah amma achat bilvad vehakkorot haelyonot sheen sovlot massa kol kach haya avyan shete ammot, lefi shehakkora hattachtona mittoch shehayta rechava beyoter boovi amma hayta chazaka uveria vichola lekabbel habbinyan shealeha, aval hakkorot haelyonot shello hayu rechavot ella tefach o pachot tzerichot lihyot avot yoter. i nammi, hayu hakkorot haelyonot avyan shete ammot kede leharechik hattikra min hakkora hattachtona, lefi shehi metzuyyeret tziyyurim naim, veim hayta hattikra semucha lah lo hayu tziyyureha nirot venikkarot kol kach:
Tikra. hannesarim shennotnin al hakkorot hayu avyan amma:
Maaziva. hattit vehaavanim vehassid shennotnin al hannesarin:
Kale orev. tas shel barzel chad kemin sayif vegavho amma haya munnach al gabbe hammaake, kede shello yanuchu haofot alav, lefichach nikra kale orev, shemmechalle haorvim mishsham:

Hannachri vehakkuti terumatan teruma. im hifrishu teruma min hattevua shellahen, aval im taram hannachri mishshel yisrael bishlichuto en terumato teruma, kiddarshinan mikken tarimu gam attem (Bamidbar 18) ma attem bene verit af sheluchachem bene verit:
Vachachamim omrim yesh lo. vahalacha kachachamim:
Terumat hannachri medammaat. im nafla lefachot mimmea naasa hakkol medumma veasur lezarim:
Vechayyavin aleha chomesh. zar sheachalah bishgaga meshallem keren vechomesh:
Verabbi shimon poter. mechomesh, aval mode hu dimdammaat. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
